name: 180 Degrees Consulting at UC Irvine
description: 180 Degrees Consulting at UCI is the world's largest university-based social impact consultancy. We provide socially conscious organizations around the world with high quality, pro bono consulting services. The branch at UCI is primarily dedicated to help socially conscious organizations in and around Orange County.

name: Academic Web Technologies Support
description: EEE+ and UCI Canvas support for students, faculty, and staff

name: Academy of Managed Care Pharmacy at UCI
description: To promote sound managed care pharmacy principles through education and professional development of its student pharmacist members.

name: Accounting Association
description: The Accounting Association at the University of California, Irvine is devoted to build relationships between students and professionals within the accounting business world. We achieve this by providing opportunities for students to learn about the accounting profession as well as facilitate the recruiting connections, growth and knowledge required for success in the accounting industry.

name: ACEing Autism at UCI
description: ACEing Autism at UCI is on a mission to help children with autism to grow, develop and benefit from social connections and fitness through affordable tennis programming, uniquely meeting individual needs while filling a national void for this growing and underserved population.

name: Achieving College Excellence - Social Ecology
description: The Achieving College Excellence (ACE) program at the School of Social Ecology aims to support new students as they transition to life at UCI. ACE supports incoming students by provided them with peer mentor support, access to academic counseling, and peer networking opportunities. Our mission is to develop a sense of belonging to our campus by promoting academic success and community building.

name: Active Minds at UCI
description: Active Minds at UCI mobilizes students to advocate for mental health and drivepositive change. We discuss mental health topics, promote access to campus helping services, and plan campus events. Active Minds is a national non-profit organization founded in 2001 by Alison Malmon, then a junior at the University of Pennsylvania, following the suicide of her older brother, Brian, one year earlier. Brian, also a college student, had been experiencing depression and psychosis for three years but had concealed his symptoms from everyone around him. It is a goal of Active Minds to de-stigmatize mental disorders. Active Minds is the only student organization working to utilize the student voice to change the conversation about mental health on college campuses. By developing and supporting chapters of a student-run mental health awareness, education, and advocacy group on campuses, the organization works to increase students' awareness of mental health issues, provide information and resources regarding mental health and mental illness, encourage students to seek help as soon as it is needed, and serve as liaison between students and the mental health community.

name: Acts College Ministry
description: Acts College Ministry is a college fellowship that aims to love God and to love people. Acts College ministry is comprised of a network of cell groups on different campuses throughout Orange County, meeting throughout the week. A cell group is where honest friendship, Bible study, sermon discussions,  constant prayer, and compassionate care are emphasized. It is within these dynamic cell groups where the core of our evangelism and discipleship take place.

name: Acts2fellowship at UCI
description: Acts2Fellowship is an undergraduate Christian fellowship that welcomes students from all walks of life and backgrounds. We hope to be a place where we learn that the Bible is relevant and personal, and the claims of God are not mere stories but personal realities. We also hope to be a home-away-from-home! We meet as a group for weekly Bible studies, usually on Fridays, to learn what the Bible says about our lives. Along the way, we eat good food, have fun together, and have times to answer timeless questions while building up a sense of family in our group.

name: Actuarial Society at UC Irvine
description: Actuarial Society at UC Irvine is a network of ambitious and motivated individuals interested in actuarial science. Our society offers numerous resources for members including internship opportunities, exam preparation workshops, and networking events with actuaries in Southern California.

name: Advancing Black Students in Medicine
description: ABSM @ UC Irvine is a student run initiative with a mission to empower Black students on UC Irvine’s campus by equipping them with the necessary skills to thrive in their academic & healthcare aspirations. By dismantling obstacles faced by Black students and fostering connections with diverse medical pathways, we aim to revolutionize the journey to healthcare.

name: Aerodynamix A Cappella (formerly Aerodynamix Acappella - AD)
description: Aerodynamix is one of the all-gender a cappella groups formed on campus! With many talentedindividuals from various musical backgrounds, AD is a breath of fresh air for the a cappellagenre. It is our hope that Aerodynamix makes music that inspires, entertains and impacts.

name: Afghan United Association at UCI - AUA
description: AUA is a student-run organization dedicated to creating a space for individuals interested in upholding Afghan culture and ideals, creating community and tight-knit bonds amongst one another, and organizing philanthropic endeavors to help our people back home. It is a club open to anyone willing to participate regardless of their background.

name: African Graduate Students Association
description: AGSA shall aspire to build a community of mutual support for graduate African students at UCI. This includes promoting academic excellence, mental wellbeing, social and cultural exchange and enhancing the experiences of African students at UCI. AGSA will operate in three arms: networking, mentorship, and capacity building for students of African descent. This includes bridging the gap between academics and postgraduate career in the US for African students.

name: Agape at UCI
description: As the mission of Agape at UCI, we strive to establish an inclusive and nurturing environment for Chinese-speaking students and English-speaking students who seek to learn and understand the teachings of the Bible in Chinese at UC Irvine. Our organization is dedicated to fostering spiritual growth by providing a platform for students to deepen their understanding and practice of Christian faith, grounded in the teachings of Jesus Christ as outlined in the Holy Bible. Through a variety of activities and events, we aim to promote personal development, fellowship engagement, and meaningful connections with other students who share a common spiritual heritage.

name: Ahlul-Bayt Student Association
description: The Ahlul-Bayt Student Association (ABSA) at UCI is a vibrant community dedicated to providing a welcoming and nurturing space for all students seeking social and spiritual guidance rooted in the profound teachings of the Ahlul-Bayt, the blessed family of the Holy Prophet (PBUH). Our primary mission is to foster a sense of belonging and unity among students of diverse backgrounds who share an interest in the spiritual wisdom, moral values, and historical legacy exemplified by the Ahlul-Bayt. ABSA UCI serves as a hub where students can explore, learn, and grow together while embracing the teachings of the Ahlul-Bayt as a source of inspiration and guidance in their academic, personal, and spiritual journeys.

name: AI Safety at UCI
description: Our mission is to advance the understanding and development of interpretable and aligned artificial intelligence systems. We are dedicated to addressing the long-term risks and potential harms associated with AI, as we approach the possibility of artificial general intelligence (AGI). Recognizing the profound uniqueness of human intelligence and the existential risks posed by unchecked AI advancement, we commit ourselves to ensuring that AI technologies align with human values and contribute positively to society. Learn more at https://aisafetyuci.com/

name: Alkalima
description: In the Name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Alkalima aims to bring a better understanding of UC Irvine student related issues from a Muslim perspective in hopes of creating positive change on campus. Alkalima provides a forum for conscientious students to illuminate topics that are often overlooked, yet are important to both student groups and the campus community as a whole at UC Irvine. Essentially, Alkalima represents a new kind of force guided by principles of Islamic morality, justice, equality, and social responsibility that we hope to create and inspire within the context of a sometimes politically passive and socially indifferent campus environment.  The kind of magazine we aim to produce is unique not only in its content, but in its vision. We strive to shift from the stereotypical, apathetic, and insular college experience, and instead move towards gaining a deeper understanding of not only community and domestic issues, but also of international topics as well. By questioning societal norms and expectations, we make it Alkalima's goal to bring back serious intellectual dialogue about the critical issues that students find important, necessary, and impactful.  As Allah calls upon us in the Qur'an, "O you who believe! Stand out firmly for justice, as witnesses to Allah, even though it be against yourselves, or your parents, or your kin, be he rich or poor, Allah is a Better Protector to both (than you). So follow not the lusts (of your hearts), lest you may avoid justice, and if you distort your witness or refuse to give it, verily, Allah is Ever Well-Acquainted with what you do\" (4:135), we at Alkalima seek to embody this verse through our publication, and in our daily lives.  Alkalima is published with support from Campus Progress, a division of the Center for American Progress. Online at CampusProgress.org.

name: Alpha Chi Omega
description: Alpha Chi Omega is a national women's organization that enriches the lives of members through lifetime opportunities of friendship, leadership, learning, and service. Each member values character, personal development, academic interest, leadership, and both financial and social responsibility. As a national fraternal organization, part of our mission is to change the conversation and exceed expectations. Alpha Chi Omega demonstrates active leadership both inside and outside the greek community, and all around UC Irvine. No matter our individual course, we are women of tremendous courage and character.   Alpha Chi Omega continually strives to seek the heights as we fight against domestic violence, our national philanthropy. Our work comes in many forms at both the local and national levels. We like to spread awareness, prevention and education to victims and their children.

name: Alpha Chi Sigma
description: Alpha Chi Sigma is a national professional organization dedicated to the formation of a strong community between individuals in fields in which Chemistry is a principle science. Our purpose is described by the Three Objects of the Fraternity:  1. To bind its members with a tie of true and lasting friendship.  2. To strive for the advancement of chemistry both as a science and as a profession.   3. To aid its members by every honorable means in the attainment of their ambitions as chemists throughout their mortal lives.  To these ends we host professional and social events and accept new members studying in Chemically related fields to join us building a strong community here at UCI.

name: Alpha Epsilon Delta Pre-Health Honor Society - AED
description: Alpha Epsilon Delta is the National Health Pre-professional Honor Society dedicated to the encouragement and recognition of excellence in pre-professional health scholarship. Our Society welcomes all students engaged in the pursuit of a professional development, provides a forum for students with common interests, and extends a program of service to benefit the college/university community. If you are interested in pursuing a career in medicine, pharmacy, dentistry, optometry, physical therapy, and nursing please come talk to us.

name: Alpha Epsilon Omega Fraternity, Gamma Chapter
description: The goal of Alpha Epsilon Omega at the University of California in Irvine is to create an environment where bonds are made and strengthened between its members. Ultimately these bonds are to serve as powerful networking tools during and beyond our college years. Alpha Epsilon Omega promotes the Armenian history, language and culture on campus by hosting a variety of events and extending membership to men from all ethnic backgrounds. Our organization provides leadership experience by placing members in leadership positions. Alpha Epsilon Omega will support its members in reaching the highest standards of achievement in all aspects of their lives.

name: Alpha Epsilon Pi (AEPi)
description: Alpha Epsilon Pi was founded to provide opportunities for the Jewish college man seeking the best possible college and fraternity experience. We have maintained the integrity of our purpose by strengthening our ties to the Jewish community and serving as a link between high school and career.

name: Alpha Eta Mu Beta (AEMB)
description: Alpha Eta Mu Beta is the National Biomedical Engineering Honor Society. The purpose of this organization is to recognize and promote academic excellence in the field of Biomedical Engineering, and to unify these highly qualified individuals amongst themselves and with their faculty.

name: Alpha Gamma Alpha, Inc
description: Alpha Gamma Alpha was founded in 2002 by Melissa Hosboyar, Arpie Jivalagian, Alenoush Terzian, and Melineh Terzian. Through common goals, beliefs and visions for Alpha Gamma Alpha, these four young ladies were able to pull together and expand the sorority to its second campus. The Beta Chapter was founded in the Fall of 2003 at the University of California, Irvine. The Beta Chapter continues to expand its presence in the Irvine community by participating in various Greek events as well as demonstrating its continuous passion and dedication to philanthropic causes both in the Irvine community and the Armenian communities. Alpha Gamma Alpha is dedicated to fostering the interests of ambitious women, with Alumni going on to pursue careers in the fields of law, medicine, psychology and business.

name: Alpha Kappa Alpha Sorority, Inc. - AKA
description: Alpha Kappa Alpha Sorority, Incorporated (AKA) is an international service organization that was founded on the campus of Howard University in Washington, D.C. in 1908. It is the oldest Greek-lettered organization established by African-American college-educated women.  Since its founding over a century ago, Alpha Kappa Alpha's mission has been to cultivate and encourage high scholastic and ethical standards, to promote unity and friendship among college women, to study and help alleviate problems concerning girls and women in order to improve their social stature, to maintain a progressive interest in college life, and to be of "Service to All Mankind."  Alpha Kappa Alpha Sorority, Incorporated Lambda Sigma chapter at the University of California, Irvine was founded on August 7th, 1977.

name: alpha Kappa Delta Phi - aKDPhi
description: Alpha Kappa Delta Phi Sorority, Inc. fosters the making of successful leaders by assisting and challenging our members to reach their maximum potential. We strive to maintain the highest levels of integrity and innovation in the promotion of sisterhood, philanthropy, scholastic excellence, and Asian-Awareness in the community while creating lifelong relationships.

name: Alpha Kappa Psi
description: Alpha Kappa Psi is a co-ed professional business fraternity open to students of all majors. Based on the core principles of brotherhood, integrity, knowledge, service, and unity, we collectively strive to improve each member's personal and professional development, as well as contribute to the UCI campus and society as a whole.

name: Alpha Omega at UCI
description: Welcome to the Alpha Omega Christian Movement!We are a group of college students devoted to loving God and his people. We strive to live in obedience to the Bible and teach others about Jesus and his word. We are here to provide spiritual and relational support to any and all students as they navigate college. We have a number of fun events, Bible studies, and Bible Discussions on and off campus, all around Orange County.You can get a glimpse of us on our Instagram @alphaomegaoc or contact us for more information!

name: Alpha Phi International Fraternity
description: Alpha Phi International Fraternity is a membership organization dedicated to promoting sisterhood, cultivating leadership, encouraging intellectual curiosity and advocating service. Alpha Phi develops character for a lifetime. The Eta Kappa Chapter of Alpha Phi at the University of California, Irvine was founded on May 17, 1988 by a group of bright, energetic women. Today, their legacy lives on in our members. Whether you are a scholar, an athlete, or a class leader, Alpha Phi's develop strong character through our devotion to philanthropy, academics, campus leadership, and social networking.

name: Alpha Phi Omega
description: Alpha Phi Omega is a co-ed National Service Fraternity, originally founded by Frank Reed Horton at Lafayette College in 1925. Inspired by the Boy Scouts of America, Horton felt there should be a collegiate organization that would strengthen men in the ideals of personal growth, tolerance, clean living, active leadership and support of the community. Alpha Phi Omega was born in this spirit and built upon the principles of Leadership, Friendship, and Service. Today at UC Irvine, the Rho Rho chapter of Alpha Phi Omega carries on this tradition, building friends and leaders within the UCI student body and completing over 1500 hours of community service per term.

name: Alpha Sigma Phi
description: "To Better The Man"To provide values-driven brotherhood experiences through life.We are a Fraternity founded upon the values of character. Our Values, once secret but made public in 2006, are what make us unique. Our Values call us to better ourselves through our actions and words. These are the values that we espouse:SILENCEHe has the strength to embrace silence and the will to build an interior life founded upon an honest desire to truly listen to others. Trust in silence transcends the gulf that is created when men feel the need to compete in action or rhetoric. He is introspective and self-reliant.CHARITYHe is charitable in the broadest sense of the word. A man who strives for a life of charity and service is more patient, kinder, and more forgiving of the flaws of others. A charitable man sacrifices of himself to help others and seeks no recognition in return. He is humble, reverent, and generous.PURITYHe consistently strives for purity of mind, body, and soul. The man who is pure of thought, word, and deed does not shrink from adversity or lofty goals. There is no self-pity, rationalizations, or apologies. He is moral and a gentleman in the finest sense of the word.HONORHe lives a life of personal integrity, thereby accruing honor. An honorable man lives up to promises made to others and to himself. A man of honor is not vain, and is willing to endure scorn or ostracism rather than conform to the pressures of peers, superiors, or the fashion of the day. He is ethical, honest, and trustworthy.PATRIOTISMHe loves his country, remaining consistently engaged in its affairs. He seeks to know his country and to pass that knowledge on to others. He is devoted to the principles of personal freedom, justice, and civic responsibility embedded in the U.S. Constitution that have made our country. He is loyal, proud, and humble.Thus our purpose is to Better the Man through the creation and perpetuation of brotherhood founded upon the values of character: Silence, Charity, Purity, Honor, and Patriotism.

name: Alpha Tau Delta
description: Alpha Tau Delta, Fraternity for Professional Nurses, is a professional nursing organization, committed to providing an inter-fraternal spirit of cooperation by offering an opportunity for nurses to promote their personal and intellectual growth through education, networking, scholarships, guidance and a collective responsibility to the fraternity. Alpha Tau Delta seeks to achieve an environment that fosters excellence of individual performance, advancement of education, character enrichment and leadership.

name: Alpine Club
description: The primary purpose of the Alpine Club is to foster a community of individuals who share a passion for mountaineering, climbing, and other alpine activities. This club serves as a platform for students to connect, go on outdoor adventures, grow as individuals, and share the stoke. We organize outdoor adventures, training programs, and social events that bring members together to explore the challenges and rewards of alpine pursuits.

name: Alzheimer's Buddies at UCI - ABUI
description: Alzheimer's Buddies at UCI (ABUI) is a volunteer organization open to students interested in interacting with and forming relationships with individuals who have Alzheimer's disease living in memory care facilities. This organization is committed to leading the intergenerational movement responding to the social isolation and disengagement experienced by people in the intermediate to late stages of Alzheimer's Disease. Volunteers will have the opportunity to interact 1-on-1 with a buddy through activities and conversation.

name: Amateur Radio Association at UCI - ARA
description: The Amateur Radio Association @ UCI (ARA @ UCI) is a public service and hobby club created to serve current licensed and prospective amateur radio enthusiasts on and around campus.  The purpose and objectives of ARA @ UCI are: To promote, educate and participate in traditional radio activities of Amateur radio. To provide a communications capability and technical knowledge for the community, especially in times of emergency. To promote social interaction and cooperation among our members and other enthusiasts in the community.

name: American Academy of Environmental Engineers and Scientists at UCI
description: The American Academy of Environmental Engineers and Scientists (AAEES) Student Chapter at the University of California, Irvine is a professional student organization dedicated to preparing its members for successful careers in environmental engineering and science. We aim to foster a collaborative environment for students interested in related fields through research opportunities, volunteer initiatives, career preparation and industry outreach, and peer connection.

name: AMERICAN CRIMINAL JUSTICE ASSOCIATION ALPHA SIGMA PHI CHAPTER at UCI
description: 1. To improve criminal justice through educational activities.2. To foster professionalism in law enforcement personnel and agencies.3. To promote professional, academic, and public awareness of criminal justice issues.4. To encourage establishing and expanding higher education and professional training in criminal justice.5. To provide a unified voice for professionals and students of criminal justice.6. To promote high standards of ethical conduct, professional training, and higher education within the criminal justice field.

name: American Fisheries Society Student Subunit at UCI
description: The mission of this student subunit is to inclusively educate and involve both graduate and undergraduate students in the economic, cultural, and ecological importance of local fisheries and to engage students in aquatic stewardship of local resources and professional development opportunities.

name: American Heart Association Healthy Hearts at UCI
description: Our mission is to advance health and hope for everyone by empowering students to engage in community outreach, research advocacy, fundraising, and wellbeing initiatives. Through education, service, and collaboration with healthcare professionals, we strive to promote cardiovascular health, inspire future leaders in medicine and science, and support the lifesaving mission of the American Heart Association.

name: American Indian Student Association (AISA)
description: The American Indian Student Association (A.I.S.A.) was founded in 1974. A.I.S.A.'s purpose is to support the academic and social education of American Indian Students at UC, Irvine and throughout the community. Initially providing a comfortable environment for Native American Students and Faculty in addition to promoting awareness to the campus community by sharing our cultural heritage. All UCI students are welcome.

name: American Institute of Aeronautics and Astronautics Student Branch at UCI (AIAA)
description: The AIAA Student Branch at UCI's mission is to help bridge the gap between UCI engineering students and the professional aerospace industry, regardless of major, socioeconomic status, or other factors. This may be done through involvement with other AIAA Student and Regional branches, hosting career, networking, informational, and community events, and supporting opportunities for student involvement through on-campus research and engineering design projects.

name: American Institute of Chemical Engineers (AIChE)
description: Our main goals are:  - To promote the professional development of our members through programs and relations with other student chapters and organizations, and with the parent body, The American Institute of Chemical Engineers.  - To contribute to the development of Chemical Engineering at University of California Irvine through activities involving faculty, industry professionals, and students.

name: American Lung Cancer Screening Initiative at UCI
description: The mission of the American Lung Cancer Screening Initiative is to promote lung cancer screening for people who are at high-risk of developing lung cancer. We work alongside a national network of physicians, students, and screening centers and promote lung cancer screening through outreach, service, education, policy advocacy, and research.

name: American Medical Student Association at UCI - Undergraduate Chapter - AMSA
description: The American Medical Student Association is committed to improving health care and healthcare delivery to all people; promoting active improvement in medical education; involving its members in the social, moral and ethical obligations of the profession of medicine; assisting in the improvement and understanding of world health problems; contributing to the welfare of medical students, interns, residents and post-MD/DO trainees; and advancing the profession of medicine and healthcare.

name: American Medical Women's Association Undergraduate Division at UCI
description: This organization was formed to help overcome the specific challenges faced by womenpursuing a career in medicine although membership is open to any pre-medical students. The group allows a safe, non-competitive forum for pre-health students to network and discuss issues such as professional school prerequisites, education, and family challenges.The mission statement of the American Medical Women's Association undergraduate Division is to empower, educate, and support pre-medical and pre-health students to advance within medicine.We will achieve this by promoting service projects that benefit the community, while instilling leadership and awareness, fostering valuable alliances with current medical students and practicing female physicians, encouraging and advocating for aspiring other undergraduate students, offering opportunities to gain insight about women's issues that help aid and commit them to improving women's health, and offering forums that provide the knowledge, insight, and perspective that will further aid women through their progression in the medical profession.

name: American Nuclear Society - Student Chapter at UCI (formerly American Nuclear Society)
description: The American Nuclear Society - Student Chapter at UCI  is a student section of a national organization aimed at spreading information about nuclear science and technology.

name: American Pharmacists Association/California Pharmacists Association - Academy of Student Pharmacists at UCI
description: The mission of the APhA Academy of Student Pharmacists (APhA-ASP) is to be the collective voice of student pharmacists, to provide opportunities for professional growth, to improve patient care, and to envision and advance the future of pharmacy.

name: American Red Cross Club at UCI
description: Guided by the fundamental principles of the American Red Cross and its mission to prevent and alleviate human suffering in the face of emergencies by mobilizing the power of volunteers and the generosity of donors, the American Red Cross Club at UCI, will learn, practice, and exemplify humanitarian values through mission-related service projects.

name: American Society of Civil Engineers (ASCE)
description: ASCE at UCI is an organization that strives to create a welcoming environment in which all of the Civil & Environmental Engineers at UCI can gather to exchange ideas, form friendships, and develop professionally.

name: American Society of Mechanical Engineers at UCI
description: Our purpose is to provide a space for students interested in mechanicalengineering to discuss topics and apply practical knowledge in areas pertaining to engineering.ASME at UCI also serves to help mechanical engineering students develop professionalnetworks with established companies.

name: Anakbayan at UCI
description: To empower and unite Filipino youth and students to fight for national democracy in the Philippines.

name: Anime Club at UCI (formerly Anime Community Club at UCI)
description: The purpose of the Anime Club at UCI shall be to provide its members and allies apositive and non-political environment to cultivate and pursue a shared interest in Japaneseanimation and its related mediums. This purpose shall be affirmed with respect to the normativeenvironment of social inclusiveness on-campus.

name: ANTartiqc PATH
description: Anteaters for Artificial Intelligence and Quantum Computing in Medicine is a student-run organization made for students with interest in the field of healthcare. Our purpose is to integrate artificial intelligence with medicine and pathology to transform customized medicine and diagnostic accuracy. ANTartiqc Med strives to close healthcare disparities by democratizing access to professional medical services worldwide in order to enhance patient outcomes and accelerate innovation in global healthcare delivery. We are committed to building AI-driven tools that are ethical, inclusive, and clinically validated, while also enabling equitable care across diverse populations and health systems.Our team is currently developing a program called the Alois Machine-Memory Assisted Initiative, an AI-driven system that leverages targeted gamification techniques to monitor and enhance patient progression in Alzheimer’s care. Alois MMAI’s platform uniquely integrates cognitive science, machine learning, and user-optimized design to deliver interventions that are effective, engaging, and accessible. Together, we envision a future where artificial intelligence drives breakthroughs in medical progression, revolutionizing the field of healthcare

name: Anteater Adventure Club
description: Founded to make the enjoyment of nature as accessible and fun as possible!! We do it all for our general members!! We have events like outdoor movie/karaoke, night hikes, camping, and more planned but always take suggestions!!

name: Anteater Artists (formerly Animation Anteaters)
description: Anteater Artists is designed to unite artists of all levels to learn about the principles of animation. The goal of this club is to produce animated shorts and experience a production pipeline. All members will be encouraged to contribute story assets for the shorts. This is the club for artists interested in storyboarding, character design, visual development and layout, and animation. We aim to become a team that cooperates and progresses together in the arts.  What we do in the club: - provide an environment to share our passion for art, provide constructive criticism, and learn from each other - strive to expand our skills as individuals and as part of a team - create portfolio-ready animation and art pieces  Club goals: - develop fundamental skills of drawing (such as composition, sketching) - learn the principles of animation - produce a complete animated short and similar projects throughout the year.

name: Anteater Catholic (formerly University Catholic Community at UC Irvine)
description: To accompany and guide the Anteater Catholic community to a deep, dynamic, and personal encounter with Jesus Christ, seeking truth, beauty, and goodness as they belong, believe, and become who God created them to be.

name: Anteater Combat Engineering (formerly Anteater Combotics Engineering)
description: Anteater Combat Engineering (ACE) is an undergraduate combat robotics team, dedicated to designing and competing in competitive robotics from 1lb to 30lb weight classes. Comprised of passionate students from various engineering disciplines, ACE aims to push the boundaries of robotic engineering through hands-on experience, teamwork, and participation in competitions.

name: Anteater Emergency Medical Services
description: Anteater Emergency Medical Services' (AEMS) mission includes providing standby Basic Life Support (BLS) medical care and lifesaving education to the campus community, as well as providing a path for its members to become licensed and competent health care providers (EMT-B), gain clinical patient care experience, and learn more about how EMS and Emergency Medicine systems function, as it is connected with the Department of Emergency Medicine at the UCI Medical Center.  AEMS provides standby BLS medical services at a variety of on-campus events through California EMT-certified volunteers from the student population. In addition, AEMS comprises student members who plan to become or are currently completing coursework to become an active EMT volunteer for the organization. AEMS has taught more than 1000 students, staff, and other community members how to control life-threatening bleeding through the nationally accredited Stop the Bleed campaign, which includes tourniquet application and wound packing. AEMS has joined more than 250 colleges nationwide with collegiate EMS organizations.

name: Anteater Express
description: Anteater Express is a committed team of anteaters dedicated to providing safe, reliable and cost-conscious transportation.  We do this with the highest quality of customer service delivered with pride, passion and spirit, which we call Bus Love.

name: Anteater Fitness Initiative
description: Anteater Fitness Initiative is a student-run organization that aims to promote fitness within UCI. It represents students who are willing to create an open environment where all individuals can learn about the basic requirements to achieve their fitness goals whether it be to learn how to exercise, gain a desired physique, or meet new gym partners. This organization aims to promote healthier physical bodies through fostering a supportive environment that is willing to assist and educate college students who are aiming to improve themselves.

name: Anteater Gymnastics Club
description: The purpose of this organization is to promote physical fitness, confidence, discipline, and teamwork through the practice and instruction of gymnastics. Our mission is to provide a safe, inclusive, and inspiring environment where individuals of all skill levels can learn, grow, and excel in the sport of gymnastics.

name: Anteater History Club
description: The purpose of the Anteater History Club is to deepen the understanding and appreciation of history among the students of UCI. By providing educational enrichment through seminars, workshops, and guest lectures from distinguished scholars, the club aims to enhance the academic environment for students passionate about historical studies. It also promotes cultural awareness by organizing events that showcase diverse historical cultures and perspectives, thereby fostering a more inclusive and educated view of the global past.

name: Anteater Involvement Fair (Administration)
description: AIF Admin Site

name: Anteater Linux User Group at UCI
description: ALUG@UCI serves to bring Linux and open source enthusiasts together to talk about the latest Linux and open source developments, collaborate on open source projects, and provide a shared space for them.

name: Anteater Military Association
description: This organization's mission is to align the past, present and future members of the US military in order to give current cadets the best understanding of the profession they will soon be joining, provide Veterans with a way to share their experience and knowledge in a way that will have a lasting impact on the future of the Armed Forces, and to create a connection with the Air Force Cadets on campus in a casual and student life oriented outlet.

name: Anteater Mock Trial
description: Anteater Mock Trial is a student-run organization founded to teach students trial advocacy. Mock Trial gives undergraduate students an opportunity to learn firsthand about the work of trial attorneys, to understand the judicial system, to develop critical thinking, and enhance communication skills.

name: Anteater Moot Court (formerly Moot Court at UCI)
description: A method of teaching law and legal skills that requires students to analyze and argue both sides of a hypothetical legal issue using procedures modeled after those employed in state and federal appellate courts.

name: Anteater Music Production (formerly Anteater Student Audio Production)
description: AMP is an organization centered around and focused on music production that aims to teach awider audience about music production through a Digital Audio Workstation (DAW). It is open to allstudents of all levels of experience.

name: Anteater Origami Club
description: To create a fun and friendly environment for anyone to practice origami, regardless of skill level. Whether you are advanced or a beginner, everyone can find a place here.

name: Anteater Photography Organization (APO)
description: The Anteater Photography Organization (APO) is a club for students with an interest in the photographic medium to come together to express their creativity and enrich their knowledge amongst a friendly community of their peers. APO offers students the opportunity to exhibit their interest in art, connect with other students, and create and share their work. APO provides learning experiences in the field of photography through topic-specific events that aim to engage and challenge students to become well-versed in the field. APO recognizes the unique abilities and skill levels of each individual student and encourages members to explore various aspects of photography, fostering an environment where members can challenge each other and grow together, ultimately becoming better at what they do.

name: Anteater Sim Racing club
description: ASR’s mission is to provide the UCI community with an alternative affordable entrance into motorsports. We strive to educate, unite, and integrate UCI affiliates into the Sim Racing Community while breaking away from the elitist nature of motorsports.

name: Anteater Smile Project at UCI - ASP
description: The Anteater Smile Project is a student-led group that aims to help make dental care more accessible for underserved (low-income) communities by carrying out volunteer projects and community service events, organizing fundraisers and donations campaigns to help fund free and low-cost dental clinics, and creating educational content about dental care and related topics.

name: Anteater Strategy Group
description: Equip students to solve real Tech, Media, and Telecom problems through client projects, structured training, and data-driven insights.

name: Anteater Tetris Club at UCI
description: TetrisUCI brings together students who share a passion for Tetris and other block-stacking games in the same genre. As one of the most iconic and enduring games of all time, Tetris is renowned for enhancing spatial reasoning, pattern recognition, and focus. Our mission is to create a welcoming community where Tetris players of all levels can connect, learn, and compete. Through regular biweekly meetings, members can enjoy casual play sessions, analyze strategies, and exchange tips with other players on campus. The club also aims to participate in the 2026 Collegiate TETR.IO League as well as future competitive events.

name: Anteater Trading
description: Anteater Trading empowers students to understand, analyze, and participate in financial markets through hands-on education and practical trading experience. We provide members with the tools, skills, and professional development needed to pursue careers in trading and finance. Our long-term vision is to cultivate a collaborative trading team that practices across multiple asset classes, including futures, options, and crypto.

name: Anteater TV
description: AnteaterTV: Visual Media created for students, by students. Anteater TV is the only student-run visual media organization on the UCI campus. ATV strives to create fun and engaging entertainment, produce professional documentaries, cover events and share community knowledge at UCI through our production of written, photo, and video content.

name: Anteater Undergraduate Law Review
description: The Anteater Undergraduate Law Journal is dedicated to promoting scholarly engagement among students interested in the study and discussion of legal issues. It aims to provide a respected platform for the publication of superior undergraduate research and commentary on significant legal and policy emphasizing the importance of legal scholarship.

name: Anteaters Beach Club
description: Hello! We are the Anteaters Beach Club :) Join us to meet new people, explore the shore, watch sunsets, and play all sorts of beach games! Feel free to check out our discord where we make weekly club announcements, schedule hang-outs, and explore all the beaches around us: https://linktr.ee/anteaterbeachclub

name: Anteaters Engaged in Building
description: Anteaters Engaged in Building strives to provide  a space for systemic dialogue on social issues pertaining to students on campus. Through panels, workshops, and guest speakers members will be able to. The club purpose is to bring together community members, researchers, organizers, and stakeholders to support and promote innovative programming, research, and ideas aimed at examining social inequality, jettisoning false beliefs in the hierarchy of human value, and addressing structural barriers to belonging and thriving. This club advances a just and inclusive society through community-centered collaboration to stimulate transformative change. Students will have a space to be educated on issues directly related to them and discuss how they can contribute to change.

name: Anteaters for Animals
description: Anteaters for Animals (AFA) is a club dedicated to raising awareness about and advocating for the rights of non-human animals. The members of AFA strongly believe that animals are not ours to use for food, clothing, entertainment, experimentation, or any other non-consensual act that is forced upon non-human animals. Through campus community and outreach, volunteering at animal-centered facilities, and engaging the public with the vast ideas of veganism and animal liberation, our members try to be the change they wish to see in the world in regards to non-human animals.  We also aim to provide our campus and community with the knowledge that they need to critically think about their food and lifestyle choices, so that they may be well-equipped to make the most ethical, environmentally conscious, and healthy choices for themselves and those around them.

name: Anteaters for Autism
description: Anteaters for Autism is an organization focused on acceptance, raising awareness, volunteering, and fundraising for individuals with autism. Throughout the academic year we engage in different activities, events, and discussions to fulfill our focus. Our organization hopes to educate our UCI community and Orange County, and do our part in improving the community climate for people with autism.

name: Anteaters For Life
description: The purpose of Anteaters for Life will be to defend the rights of the most vulnerable in society. The short term goals will be to engage all UCI students with a passion for advocating for life, and to educate students that all life is valuable and needs to be protected from the moment of conception. We aim to make sure the womb remains the safest place anyone could be. The long term goals will be to continue to provide opportunities and resources for all UCI students interested in respectfully engaging in advocating for the lives of the unborn.

name: Anteaters For Suicide Prevention
description: The mission of Anteaters for Suicide Prevention is to promote literacy and awareness about crisis management and provide resources available for students at UCI. We hope to empower students and build confidence in becoming a resource to others dealing with depression and suicidal thoughts. A goal of Anteaters for Suicide Prevention is to provide opportunities for students to gain certifications and training to better assist peers and others in need. We will serve as a peer support group for those volunteering for crisis lines or other suicide prevention movements. Through this, we hope to foster a community of students who are eager to get involved, prepared to help those in need, and equipped with resources for themselves and others.

name: Anteaters Sprinkling Happiness at UCI
description: This organization was formed to express members' interest in baking, develop baking skills and utilize organization members' talents to make various baked goods for underserved youth in our community. This group is meant to give every and all UCI students interested in baking an outlet to meet with like-minded people and learn from each other on how to be better bakers, while simultaneously serving the community.Over the course of the school year we will complete a number of community service projects, primarily through the network of For Goodness Cakes, a non-profit organization where volunteers bake various desserts to celebrate special occasions for youth living in foster care, homeless shelters, and other alternative living agencies. It is through these projects, as well as meetings and other club functions, that members will serve their community, improve their baking skills, and foster a network of peers similar to them.

name: Anteaters Tzu Ching
description: Anteaters Tzu Ching is a collegiate chapter of the Tzu Chi Foundation. Tzu Ching directly translates to "Compassionate Youths" committed to actively participating in community service. While Tzu Chi Foundation is based upon Buddhist philosophies, people of all religions, gender, and races are equally respected.  To follow the missions of promoting medicine, education, charity, and humanities, Anteaters Tzu Ching actively participate in medical outreaches, food banks, and tutoring programs in an effort to aid those in need and to help them escape the ongoing cycle of poverty.  In addition to service, Anteaters Tzu Ching aims to promote vegetarianism and environmentalism.

name: Anteaters' Habitat for Humanity
description: Our mission is to bring people together to build homes, communities, and hope. As a campus chapter of Habitat for Humanity® of Orange County, we strive to make a world where everyone has a decent place to live, and somewhere they can call home, with the help of passionate volunteers.

name: Anthill Village Community Garden Club
description: Our community garden is a place where people who enjoy gardening come together to work the soil and share their knowledge and experience with other gardeners. Our gardeners include UCI students, faculty, staff, and members from the community. Originally established in 1985, the garden has been located near three different UCI student housing complexes, most recently Arroyo Vista Housing. In June 2008 the garden was relocated to a new site next to Palo Verde Graduate Student Housing. The club name was changed to Anthill Village Community Garden.The purpose of this organization is to oversee the use and management of the land assigned to the Anthill Village Community Garden by the University.

name: Anthology Yearbook
description: Welcome UCI students, staff, faculty, and especially the Class of 2022 to our award winning yearbook page! The 2020 UCI Anthology Yearbook was officially inducted into the Walsworth Gallery of Excellence. It is a prestigious honor to reach the top echelon as one of the most distinguished yearbooks in the country. Join us in celebrating this huge accomplishment as we commend our team's outstanding work and commitment to excellence.

name: Anthropology Club at UCI
description: The Anthropology Club at UCI aims to foster a vibrant community of students passionate aboutexploring human cultures, societies, and histories. We are dedicated to creating a collaborativeand inclusive environment where members can engage in meaningful discussions, participate inopportunities, and gain insights into the diverse world of anthropology. Through workshops,guest lectures, cultural events, and hands-on experiences, we strive to connect academicknowledge with real-world applications while celebrating the richness of human diversity.

name: Anthropology Graduate Group for Research and Organization - AGGRO
description: The mission of the Anthropology Graduate Group for Research and Organization (AGGRO) is to foster a sense of belonging and community among the anthropology graduate student body. With regular social and academic events, AGGRO aims to provide a platform for anthropology graduate students to connect, collaborate, and advance in both their academic, professional, and personal pursuits. With writing groups, research partnerships, student led conferences, workshops, social gatherings, and more, AGGRO seeks to support anthropology graduate students and create a safe space for academic innovation and interdisciplinary thought. These spaces aspire to be a key resource in shaping future scholars by fostering a supportive and inclusive academic environment that will advance the next generation of anthropological knowledge.

name: Antleader Mentorship Program
description: The Antleader Mentorship Program (AMP) is a student-led, student-run leadership-focused mentorship program in collaboration with the Associated Students of the University of California Irvine (ASUCI). The primary purpose of AMP is to assist incoming first-year students in transitioning to the University of California, Irvine and developing leadership qualities.

name: ANTrepreneur Center
description: Whether a UCI Student is just curious to experience the process of entrepreneurship, have a idea burning inside them, or have already formed a company, the ANTrepreneur Center's mission is to provide a safe place where they can start. Book a meeting with us today : https://cglink.me/2eo/m1377

name: Ants in Your Plants Garden
description: The Ants in Your Plants Garden is a student led garden in Arroyo Vista Housing. We are a group of dedicated students who love being outdoors and seeing the wonderful plants and organisms that thrive in the garden. The primary mission of the garden is to provide UCI students an opportunity to learn about food systems through volunteering and workshops. It’s a student effort to fight food insecurity on campus and promote sustainable practices. In addition to educational and recreational uses, the garden grows produce to be donated to the FRESH Pantry at the UCI Basic Needs Center. The Garden is supported in collaboration by ASUCI Garden Commission (IVP), UCI Housing, UCI Sustainability Resource Center (SRC), and the UCI Basic Needs Center.

name: API Staff & Faculty Association
description: The API Staff & Faculty Association aims to build connection through the lens of advocacy, empowerment, leadership, and community. Our goal is to provide opportunities to engage in meaningful spaces and build a sense of belonging related to identity and social justice topics within our community and beyond.

name: Applied Investment Research Group
description: Applied Investment Research Group (AIRG) aims to provide business-oriented UCI students with an accessible platform for investment strategy and portfolio management learning and quantitative research opportunities. In doing so, AIRG prepares students with relevant experiences for a career in the field of financial services, including asset/wealth management, hedge fund, investment banking, consulting, etc.  The primary activities includes:  1. Conducting quantitative financial research on various types of investment vehicles, including stocks, bonds, options, etc. 2. Constructing & managing a research-based investment portfolio in a simulated trading environment. 3. Developing algorithmic trading strategies and backtesting.

name: Arabic Language and Culture Club
description: The Arabic Language and Culture Club (ALCC) is dedicated to fostering a deep appreciation and understanding of the Arabic language, its diverse cultures, and rich history.The ALCC also hopes to provide its members with a background in Arabic with opportunities to use and improve their Arabic language skills.

name: Archery Club at UCI
description: Archery Club at UCI is a recreational and competitive club sport that competes in barebow, bowhunter, compound, and recurve divisions. The club competes on both regional and national levels and has never failed to put at least one athlete on the podium in every competition since its establishment in 2006. All prospective teammates, experienced or not, are more than welcome to join every Tuesday, Thursday, and Friday in the Back Court Gym of the Anteater Recreation Center (ARC). All practices are $5 each until the $55 cap per quarter.  All interested students and faculty are encouraged to give archery a shot! For questions, feel free to email archery@uci.edu!

name: Armenian Pre-Health Society at UC Irvine
description: This organization is dedicated toward educating Armenian Undergraduate Students regarding different healthcare occupations by hosting guest speakers (doctors, medical students, health administrators, etc.) and providing valuable tools and resources to guide students through the processes of graduate school admissions, standardized tests, and getting involved in research.

name: Armenian Pre-Law Students Association at UCI
description: The Armenian Pre-Law Students Association is a multicultural organization that aims to create a supportive and inclusive community for students interested in pursuing a legal career. The purpose of such a club is to provide a space where individuals from diverse backgrounds can come together to explore and discuss legal issues, share experiences, and gain insights into the field of law. Moreover, The Armenian Pre-Law Students Association shall raise efforts to bring about awareness about legal structures and the law of the country Armenia and the Armenian Community in the Irvine area, while promoting positive social interactions with experienced Armenian lawyers and lawmakers. Overall, the goal of a multicultural Armenian Pre-law organization is to foster an inclusive environment that prepares its members for success in their legal pursuits while celebrating and embracing diversity within the legal community.

name: Armenian Students Association (ASA)
description: The Armenian Students Association at UC Irvine is a student organization dedicated to preserving and promoting Armenian culture, heritage, and community on campus. We aim to foster a strong sense of identity and unity among Armenian students through cultural, educational, and social programming. ASA also works to raise awareness about Armenian issues within the broader UCI community and build connections with the local Armenian population. Through our events and initiatives, we create a welcoming space for students to engage, learn, and grow together.

name: Art Club Collective (formerly AntARTers ART Club)
description: We're a 💖SOCIAL ORG👁️ for Women🚺 & the LGBTQ+🏳️‍🌈 community that's art-oriented!We accomplish this through families, bigs and littles, weekly socials, and more! ­You do NOT have to create art or be an artist to have a valued place here!­ Just a love for art-oriented things, an eye for aesthetics, and a desire to be around other people who share those interests. The crux of our org is creating a space and opportunities for deep social connections with art-oriented people. Nowhere else on campus will you find such a large group of people who get excited going to art walks, enjoying concerts, having wine and paint nights, photoshoots, hiking/seeing nature, plants, carving pumpkins, costume parties, and more. We've founded a place for those people to mingle and build strong friendships.Visit our Instagram(@artclubuci)(www.instagram.com/artclubuci/) to find an email signup form to get added to the intro

name: Art History Undergraduate Association (AHUA)
description: The mission of the Art History Undergraduate Association is to encourage undergraduates in shared interest and passion for art by connecting them to a network of faculty, alumni, and students. We seek to create art-filled environments that are both engaging and relevant. A main objective for this year is to organize events throughout the academic year that will grant opportunities for students to interact with art on a more intimate level, through museum trips, games, and our annual art show. Our doors are open to anyone with even a passing interest in art, and we hope to inspire a lifelong love of art in all those we encounter by making it more accessible to the UCI community in fun, interactive ways.

name: Artificial Intelligence at UCI
description: AI@UCI aims to build a community where all UC Irvine undergraduate and graduate students with a curiosity for artificial intelligence can cultivate their understanding of a rapidly evolving field of computer science. From application-based, beginner-friendly workshops to long-term, member-driven projects, there's a way for students of all experience levels to get involved first-hand in the dynamic world of AI.

name: Arts Student Affairs
description: The Claire Trevor School of the Arts Student Affairs Office provides Arts students services in academic counseling, orientation, study plans, transfer course evaluations, schedule changes, and degree checks.

name: Ascend at UCI
description: Our Mission is to develop, support, and empower Pan-Asians throughout their careers with a network for growth and advancement that enables our members to serve our vibrant communities to the best of their abilities.

name: Asian American Christian Fellowship at UCI - AACF
description: The mission of Asian American Christian Fellowship (AACF) is to reach into the university and collegiate community, primarily to those who are Asian Pacific Americans, with the life-changing message of Jesus Christ.

name: Asian American Journalists Association at UCI
description: The mission of AAJAUCI is to foster a dynamic and inclusive community for individuals interested in journalism, media, and communication. Our overarching purpose is to empower and support Asian American journalists and media professionals, while also promoting diversity and inclusion within the broader field of journalism. The organization shall be broad in its scope, allowing flexibility to adapt to the evolving landscape of media and journalism, with the primary goal of providing a platform for education, collaboration, and networking.

name: Asian Pacific American Law Student Association (APALSA)
description: Asian Pacific American Law Student Association (APALSA) at UCI Law is a political, community service, academic, and social organization dedicated to serving the Asian and Pacific Islander American (APIA) communities at the UCI School of Law, in Southern California, and in the greater community at large. We define the communities as broadly encompassing, but not limited to, East Asians, Pacific Islanders, South Asians, and Southeast Asians, and including immigrants and U.S.-born individuals. The mission of APALSA is to promote awareness, discourse, and activism on key social justice issues facing Asian and Pacific Islander Americans, as well as other historically underrepresented groups. APALSA aims to recognize and celebrate diversity by disaggregating the APIA identity in an effort to foster cross-cultural understanding, inclusivity, and unity within the APIA community. APALSA is committed to activities that increase the access to justice and legal services of APIA communities as a way to effect practical change. In remembering the cross-racial solidarity movement at various UC campuses in the 1960s, APALSA seeks to accomplish this mission by working collaboratively with other like-minded organizations at UCI, in Orange County, and around the country. APALSA provides a community-driven network for APIA students at UCI Law and is open to all UCI Law Students.

name: ASL Club at UCI
description: The ASL Club at the University of California, Irvine is dedicated to fostering an inclusive community where students of all backgrounds can learn, practice, and celebrate American Sign Language (ASL) and Deaf culture. Through education, cultural engagement, and collaboration with the Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing (D/HH) community, we strive to promote accessibility, allyship, and linguistic humility on campus and beyond.

name: Association for Computing Machinery at UC Irvine - ACM
description: Members of ACM @ UCI enjoy computer science and puzzles. We study algorithms and compete in international and prestigious programming contests like "ACM ICPC", "IEEExtreme", and "Google Codejam". The overall mission of our club is to maximize of our understanding of computer science topics and problem solving and learning skills that one would not generally learn in a classroom setting. In recent years, we've consistently fielded one of the top 3 teams in ICPC Southern California. We are also branching out into programming competition related to machine learning and data science.

name: Association for Computing Machinery Special Interest Group in Graphics at UCI
description: To promote, teach, and foster a community around computer graphics and vision.

name: Association of Latino Professionals for America
description: To empower and develop Latino students as leaders of character for the nation in every sector of the global economy.

name: Association of Muslims In Politics and Law
description: We strive to help young American Muslims achieve their future professional goals within politics and law.

name: Association of Women in Mathematics at UC Irvine
description: The purpose of the Association for Women in Mathematics is to create a community in which women and girls can thrive in their mathematical endeavors, and to promote equitable opportunity and treatment of women and others of marginalized genders and gender identities across the mathematical sciences.

name: Astronomy Club at UCI
description: The Astronomy Club at UCI is an organization open to all majors on campus. We strive to create a humble and friendly environment for those who are interested in the wonders of the cosmos and the beautiful science of Astronomy and Astrophysics. Astronomy Club is a new and ever-evolving club on campus with access to multiple high-end telescopes available for members to view through. Astronomy related events like Astro Trivia and Rocket Launching take place throughout the year. Trips to observatories and campgrounds like Polamor Observatory and Griffith Observatory also take place. For those interested in advancing their knowledge about Astronomy and Astrophysics, Astronomy Club at UCI hosts guest speakers who are currently doing research in the Astro field here at UCI such as graduates and professors. We also like to teach our members about the constellations, stars, and other night sky objects!

name: Athletics Academic & Student Services
description: The University of California at Irvine and the Department of Athletics has made a commitment to the academic progress of our Student-Athletes and we make every effort to provide a comprehensive network of academic and life skills support for the Student-Athlete's use in the pursuit of a degree. With the academic and life skills support programs offered within our department and the resources available on campus, student-athletes are capable of achieving their dreams and goals both academically and athletically.We serve 400 student-athletes in 18 varsity sports. Due to the size of the department and the number of students we monitor, we as an academic and student services staff, can deal effectively with problems and come up with solutions rapidly while maintaining close contact with our student-athletes, coaches and professors alike. This flexibility allows an aggressive approach to providing services to our student-athletes, as evidenced by our Study Table and Grade Check programs.

name: Athletics Men's Water Polo
description: Intercollegiate Men's Water Polo Team

name: Athletics Women's Water Polo
description: Intercollegiate Athletics Women's Water Polo Team

name: Avahita at UCI
description: We are a student-run, competitive undergraduate organization dedicated to promoting cultural awareness through the different and diverse forms of classical Indian dance. We host weekly practice sessions where students have the chance to collaborate with their fellow UCI peers who have similar backgrounds.

name: Awaken
description: We seek to advance the gospel of Jesus Christ at UCI. As Paul the Apostle writes, "How then will they call on him in whom they have not believed? And how are they to believe in him of whom they have never heard? And how are they to hear without someone preaching? And how are they to preach unless they are sent? As it is written, 'How beautiful are the feet of those who preach the good news!' But they have not all obeyed the gospel. For Isaiah says, 'Lord, who has believed what he has heard from us?' So faith comes from hearing, and hearing through the word of Christ."

name: AWS Cloud Club at UCI
description: The mission of the AWS Cloud Club at UC Irvine is to help students learn cloud computing in a simple, hands-on, and supportive way. The club creates a welcoming space where students can explore AWS tools, practice real-world skills, and learn by building projects together. Through workshops, guided labs, group projects, and guest talks, the club connects classroom learning with practical experience. Our goal is to help students gain confidence, develop technical skills, and prepare for careers in cloud, software, data, and other technology fields—regardless of their prior experience.

name: B-Boys Anonymous
description: B-Boys Anonymous was founded in 1999 by Mark Kamimoto as an open practice environment for freestyle dancers on campus. Originally known as the Breakdance Club at UC Irvine, BBA allows students with common interests in dance to express themselves through music and movement. The club's focus is to promote the love and knowledge of all forms of freestyle dance. Today, BBA currently serves as UC Irvine's premiere freestyle dance club that is also heavily involved in the Irvine Dance Community (IDC) with the annual hosting of events such as All IDC and the Spring Quarter Dance Festival, as well as quarterly battles. Through all of the development and growth that BBA has experienced since its founding, the club's initial focus remains. At BBA sessions, we strive to teach the foundation of freestyle dance and the history of Hip Hop culture to students willing to learn and be apart of its developing scene in the UC Irvine community.

name: Badminton Club at UCI
description: Our purpose is to create an environment in which badminton players can meet, play (recreational or competitive), and socialize. We also wish to expose badminton to a wider population and create a competitive environment for players who wish to improve and challenge themselves. We compete in the Southern California Collegiate Badminton League and in the USA Badminton Collegiate Nationals, along with many travel tournaments. Our players range from a wide variety of skill level and backgrounds. We aim to create a community of badminton players that will stick together and challenge each other to improve.

name: Baha'i Club at UCI
description: The mission of the Baha'i Club at UCI is to foster unity, promote spiritual growth, and cultivate a spirit of service among students of all backgrounds. We aim to create an inclusive environment that encourages independent investigation of truth, promotes interfaith dialogue, and supports the application of Baha'i principles to address contemporary challenges. Through educational programs, social activities, and community service initiatives, we strive to contribute positively to campus life and the wider community, while nurturing the intellectual and spiritual development of our members.

name: Ballet Folklorico de UCI
description: Ballet Folklorico de UC Irvine is a student run organization that welcomes students, alumni, and community members to participate and learn about a variety of different Mexican histories and traditions through dance and music.  As a multicultural organization, we strive to promote and educate others on Mexican histories and cultures, while also engaging and interacting with the diversity surrounding us on the UC Irvine campus and the community. BFDUCI aims to create an inclusive and non judgemental community for all students of any race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, color, disability, national origin, age, or marital status. We plan to cultivate an environment so that members feel comfortable with freely expressing who they are, whether it be through dance & music or other creative means.

name: Ballroom Dance Club at UCI
description: The Ballroom Dance Club at UCI was established to create a welcoming space where students can begin or continue their journey in ballroom dancing. Regardless of skill level, age, or background, BDC at UCI transcends the typical definitions of a dance team and strives to achieve long-term goals of fostering friendship and understanding by building a community through expression—exploring communication beyond the limits of language. In collaboration with ballroom dance teams from other UC campuses (e.g., UCLA, UCSD) and private colleges, BDC at UCI pursues short-term goals of participating in and hosting collegiate ballroom dance competitions, performances, and showcases. Through these events, BDC at UCI  also aims to give back to the Orange County community by raising funds to support various charities and organizations that are meaningful to its members. BDC at UCI welcomes all UCI undergraduate students and maintains a zero-tolerance policy for any form of discriminatory behavior.

name: Bangladeshi Student Association- BSA
description: The Bangladeshi Student Association (BSA) fosters unity among Bangladeshi students while promoting our culture within our diverse community. We create a welcoming platform, connecting students through cultural activities for personal growth. Our short-term goals include organizing festivals and cultural performances and preserving and sharing our heritage with others. In the long term, we hope to collaborate with other associations and institutions, promoting cross-cultural understanding and appreciation for Bangladesh's vibrant heritage, along with potential fundraising for humanitarian causes in Bangladesh. Our club welcomes any individuals who have an interest in the rich culture and traditions of Bangladesh. We welcome everyone, regardless of their background or ethnicity, eager to learn, share, and promote cultural diversity.

name: Bare Bones Dance Theater
description: Bare Bones Dance Theater is a student-run, on campus organization that encourages and supports an artistic meeting of the minds. Through the production of an annual dance concert, the undergraduate dancers, choreographers, production team, and the larger community collaborate to produce a professional theatrical experience. In addition, the organization seeks to extend its artistic endeavors beyond the University of California, Irvine by hosting outreach performances and workshops for local high school students. Lastly, BBDT hosts professional artists from the greater Los Angeles area to teach dance workshops for reduced rates, providing students the opportunity to be exposed to the performing arts. BBDT welcomes undergraduates of all majors from UCI to participate and share their creative abilities to enrich UCI and the Orange County Community.

name: Basic Needs Center ( FRESH Basic Needs Hub )
description: We understand that meeting the basic needs of our students greatly impacts their mental and physical health, academic performance, work productivity, and holistic success. The UCI Basic Needs Center offers emergency food and toiletries, connects students to critical on and off-campus resources, and provides educational opportunities for students to take personal responsibility for their wellness and the well-being of their communities. We are a home for all students, a collaborative space for innovative solutions, and an advocate for social justice and equity.

name: Be Known Movement at UCI
description: Our purpose is to raise people who wholeheartedly love Jesus and release God's restoration and Kingdom revival into their spheres of influence.

name: Be Well OC
description: The Be Well OC Mobile Response Team comprises two Crisis Intervention Specialists (CIS) who provide on-campus assessment and crisis stabilization services for mild to moderate behavioral health needs (7 days per week, 8 am-8 pm PST). Crisis Intervention Specialists are specifically trained in community assessment and stabilization best practices to effectively intervene for those experiencing mental health or substance use challenges. Calls for service can be sent to the non-emergency line at 949-824-5233. The Mobile Response model utilizes a voluntary approach that fosters trust and long-term engagement with clients and community members. Mobile team members collaborate with campus and community partners to connect clients with the right services, which may include non-medical transportation to support access to appropriate resources. Students and faculty can find information about resources and programs online at: https://bewelloc.org/mobile-response/

name: Beach Volleyball Club at UCI
description: Our group aims to grow the beach volleyball community. We organize community recreational, competitive, and travel play for both men's, women's, and co-ed beach volleyball. Please follow our Instagram @bcvb_uci for runs.

name: Beall Applied Innovation
description: UCI Beall Applied Innovation brings campus-based inventions and entrepreneurship together with Orange County's vibrant business community to support job creation and economic growth.

name: ANTrepreneur Center
description: Whether a UCI Student is just curious to experience the process of entrepreneurship, have a idea burning inside them, or have already formed a company, the ANTrepreneur Center's mission is to provide a safe place where they can start. Book a meeting with us today : https://cglink.me/2eo/m1377

name: Wayfinder Incubator
description: Wayfinder is a highly structured incubator, through UCI Beall Applied Innovation, that connects UC-affiliated startups with essential resources needed to launch, grow and succeed.Housed inside the Cove @ UCI, our collaborative team of business leaders, entrepreneurs, investors and technology transfer experts eat, sleep and drink innovation. Using our combined experience, we help fine-tune a strategic process that leads innovation with both commercial promise and the potential to meet real needs, from formation to funding.

name: Beall Butterworth Competition
description: Beall Student Design Competition at The Henry Samueli School of EngineeringOffered to encourage the creation of new technologies, or solutions to current design problems that have the potential for commercialization. Ideas and products are evaluated on their technological merits as well as potential to impact the marketplace. Students are encouraged to submit new product ideas that involve the development of hardware and devices. Products that entail integration are acceptable as long as there is a substantial development effort.The competition is open to all UCI students. Teams must be composed of at least two (2) students, one (1) of which must be enrolled at The Henry Samueli School of Engineering.Butterworth Product Development Competition at the Donald Bren School of Information and Computer SciencesIs a product development competition designed to encourage the creation of new technologies with potential for commercialization. Ideas and products are evaluated on their technological merits and potential to impact the marketplace. Students are encouraged to submit new products that involve the development of software and systems. Products that entail integration are acceptable as long as there is a substantial development effort.The competition is open to all UCI students. Teams must be composed of at least two (2) students, one (1) of which must be enrolled at the Donald Bren School of Information and Computer Sciences.

name: Believers United in Leadership & Business
description: ABA shall exist to build a tight-knit community of Christian undergraduate business students and professionals committed to living out Gospel-centered fellowship. Through experiential activities, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we seek to integrate faith with business excellence.

name: Berean Christian Club
description: We are a Bible-centered and gospel-centered organization that seeks to glorify Christ through fellowship, accountability, and outreach at the UCI campus. Our functions include weekly college Bible studies, campus evangelism, and English Corners to outreach to International students.

name: Best Buddies at UCI
description: The mission of Best Buddies at UCI is to establish a global volunteer movement that creates opportunities for one-to-one friendships, integrated employment, leadership development, and inclusive living for people with intellectual and developmental disabilities (IDD). We do this by matching student volunteers in mutually enriching friendships with persons with intellectual and developmental disabilities.

name: Beta Alpha Psi
description: Beta Alpha Psi is an honorary organization for financial information students and professionals. The primary objective of Beta Alpha Psi is to develop and foster a passion for learning in the field of business information.
