This includes promoting the study and practice of accounting, finance and information systems; providing opportunities for self-development, service and association among members and practicing professionals, and encouraging a sense of ethical, social, and public responsibility. The Beta Alpha Psi Nu PI Chapter was established as an official chapter at UCI in 2016. Nationally, as of 2016, there are 314 chapters on college and university campuses with over 300,000 members initiated since Beta Alpha Psi's formation.

name: Beta Beta Beta (Tri Beta) - Biology Honor Society
description: Beta Beta Beta (Tri Beta) is a national honor society that is dedicated to supporting undergraduates who are interested in the biological sciences and research. Membership includes the opportunity to apply for research grants, to attend district and national conventions, and more! The chapter at UCI will prioritize opportunities for students to grow as student-researchers and future leaders.

name: Bethel Grace Church
description: Our mission is to be a Christ-centered community that expands the kingdom of God.

name: Better Humans at UCI
description: Better Humans at UCI is a non-educational, student-led organization dedicated to combating the growing loneliness epidemic through authentic human connection and regular social interaction. Our short-term goal is to create safe, inclusive spaces where students can gather, meet new people, and engage in meaningful activities. Our long-term goal is to foster a healthier, more connected student body by promoting consistent interpersonal engagement as a pathway to improved mental health.

name: Beyond the Verdict
description: Beyond the Verdict is dedicated to advancing the understanding of the criminal justice system, with a particular emphasis on wrongful convictions and exonerations. Through our podcast and academic sessions, we illuminate the personal stories behind wrongful convictions and explore the complexities of the justice system. Our mission is to make these critical issues both accessible and compelling, bridging the gap between academic learning and real-world experience. By featuring insightful discussions with law enforcement professionals, legal experts, and advocates, we aim to foster a deeper, more nuanced understanding of the justice system, inspire empathy, and encourage positive change.

name: Bhagat Puran Singh Health Initiative at UCI
description: To provide basic health care screening and general health/nutrition advice to underserved and neglected communitiesTo fight heart disease and diabetes among the at-risk populations and promote general health knowledge to prevent chronic disease.To Promote Youth Advancement among underserved populations.To Promote Outreach among our members and in the community.

name: Bilingual Teacher Student Association at UCI - BTSA
description: This organization is open to ALL student and will focus on developing and supporting future educators with the mission to promote the importance of Bilingual Education. As well as thosewho are interested in learning more about Bilingual education and connecting with other future teachers. With the help of our Four Pillars: ACADEMICS, MENTORSHIP, SOCIALS& VOLUNTEERING. We hope to help ALL students. At Bilingual Teacher Student Association, we believe bilingual education is the future of education in the United States. With more and more dual immersion schools opening up around the state of California, BTSA wants to be a source of information for students who want to know more about bilingual education.

name: Biological Sciences Student Council (BSC)
description: To unify and serve undergraduates through the student-led promotion of academic resources,student advocacy and philanthropy in the larger community, as part of a greater effort to foster a campus space for intellectual discussion as well as personal and professional excellence, especially within the Biological Sciences community.

name: Biomedical Engineering Society at UCI (BMES)
description: Biomedical Engineering Society (BMES) at UCI is an organization that encourages exploration into the field of biomedical engineering. Our mission is to foster an inclusive community for students interested in biomedical engineering through mentorship, career building, hands-on project experience, and outreach. By building a network of undergraduate and graduate students, professors, and industry professionals, we aim to strengthen the biomedical engineering community in and around UCI.

name: Biomolecular Design and Modeling Club
description: The Biomolecular Design and Modeling Club is dedicated to exploring and promoting the advancement of students in computational biochemistry, machine learning–driven biomolecular design, and synthetic biology.​

name: BioSci Graduate Studies & Support
description: Graduate Studies & Support (GS&S) oversees centralized student services across all graduate programs in the Charlie Dunlop School of Biological Sciences, including interdepartmental gateway programs (e.g., INP, CMB). The unit provides strategic direction and operational leadership in graduate admissions and recruitment, financial support, academic progress, student employment, policy compliance, and student experience. We support programmatic consistency, equity, and excellence while ensuring alignment with university policies and broader institutional goals.

name: Biotechnology Society
description: We connect students with the people, knowledge, and experiences that bring biotechnology to life. Through engaging events, practical opportunities, and a welcoming community, we help members learn, collaborate, and take meaningful steps toward their future in science.

name: Birding at UCI - BAU
description: Birding at UCI is an Audubon Campus Chapter founded in 2023 that aims to foster an inclusive community of UCI students and faculty interested in birdwatching and the outdoors. We have partnered with various local and UCI-affiliated ecological organizations, including UCI Nature and Sea and Sage Audubon, to provide unique volunteering and educational experiences for our members.Email us at birding@uci.edu or refer to this linktree for more information: linktr.ee/birdingatuci

name: Black Campus Ministries at UCI
description: Centered on faith and justice, we guide students into lives of purpose, service, and leadership. We build community, teach Scripture, and inspire Christ-centered impact.

name: Black Faculty and Staff Association (BFSA) at UCI
description: BFSA at UCI is an organization whose mission is to promote a sense of kinship among African-American/Black faculty and staff members and those of the African Diaspora at the University of California, Irvine.

name: Black Graduate Student Network-BGSN
description: The group, formed in the mid 2000's, was established in response to the need for support among Black  graduate and professional students across the UC Irvine campus, who found themselves facing challenges relating to their ability to navigate the Irvine environment. The BGSN was designed to provide a sense of purpose for Black students here at UC Irvine. The goal was to create a space that would be resonant, supportive, nurturing and productive for Black graduate and professional students. As an organization looking out for the best interest of its membership, it strives to provide a sense of community and camaraderie.

name: Black Graduation Celebration
description: The Black Graduation Celebration ceremony at UC Irvine celebrates the achievement of our graduating undergraduate and graduate students in the traditions and customs that have been a foundation for the African American community. The ceremony not only symbolizes the bond of our community but also celebrates the unstoppable success of our future leaders with their families, mentors, and peers.

name: Black in Tech
description: Black in Tech (BIT) empowers Black students at UC Irvine to excel in technology by fostering community, providing resources, and promoting representation. We are committed to creating a supportive environment where Black students can connect, learn, and grow together, ultimately shaping the future of tech.

name: Black Law Society
description: Our purpose is to provide Black students with the knowledge necessary to make crucial decisions as they seek admission to law school, to deepen their understanding of their desired profession, and foster lifelong relationships.

name: Black Law Student Association at UCI
description: The purpose of BLSA is to utilize the collective resources of the member chapters to:  - articulate and promote the educational, professional, political, and social needs and goals of Black law students;  - foster and encourage professional competence;  - improve the relationship between Black law students, Black attorneys, and the American legal structure;  - instill in the Black attorney and law student a greater awareness and commitment to the needs of the Black community;  - influence the legal community by bringing about meaningful legal and political change that addresses the needs and concerns of the Black community;  - adopt and implement policies of economic independence;  - encourage Black law students to pursue careers in the judiciary; and  - do all things necessary and appropriate to accomplish these purposes.

name: Black Organization for Leadership and Development
description: We provide Black students with safe spaces to celebrate their identity while cultivating essential skills in order to be the leaders of tomorrow. We seek to create spaces that encourage members to lead in bold and unconventional ways in comparison to societal norms.

name: Black Psychology Student Association
description: The Black Psychology Student Association of UC Irvine seeks to provide a support network which focuses on preparing Black students at the University of California, Irvine (UC Irvine) to become successful and influential members of the psychological community; Along with creating an inclusive and non judgmental community for all students to learn and gain valuable opportunities to prepare them for graduate and professional schooling.

name: Black Student Union
description: It is the mission of the Black Student Union to create and promote a supportive and inclusive community, while also intellectually challenging the Black students on the campus of UC Irvine. This organization, established specifically for political reasons, works for a more humane and culturally relevant college experience for the students on this campus. The Black Student Union strives to provide educational, cultural and social programs which we hope will inspire our community to take action, through activism as well as outreach on and off of our home campus.  This organization serves as the umbrella for the other Black organizations on campus, with our ultimate goal being to provide a welcoming and united space for our community while also stimulating an awareness of political, economical, and social forces affecting the African Diaspora.

name: Blacksmithing Club
description: The purpose of the club is to introduce the art of blacksmithing to students with an emphasis on materials science. Understanding the how to make materials from forging metal is more than experimentation and also heavily focused on the science behind it. Every hit the metal endures, shapes it to a respectable strength and durability which can enhance the features of the product the student creates.

name: Blockchain at UCI
description: Blockchain at UCI's main aim is to spread blockchain technology to UCI, Orange County, and the surrounding LA Regions. We want to promote the decentralized way of distributing data among a large audience and show how blockchain can be used in a variety of fields. We want to bridge this gap between the industry and student population through opportunities for our members such as workshops, educational seminars, hackathons, conferences, and networking events so everyone benefits from blockchain. Finally, Blockchain at UCI aims to be the central hub for all blockchain in Orange County and surrounding LA regions.

name: Blum Center for Poverty Alleviation
description: The UCI Blum Center for Poverty Alleviation's mission is to promote social change and inspire the next generation of leaders to action with research on poverty alleviation. By collaborating across disciplines with students, faculty and practitioners, the UCI Blum Center rigorously explores systemic, geopolitical, technological and climate forces affecting poverty. The UCI Blum Center's innovative education programs, basic and applied research, and work in community development and policy-making engage future leaders to reduce the risks of poverty for vulnerable populations and improve humanity and its institutions. Undergraduate students are invited to participate in experiential opportunities, online courses, social enterprise competitions such as:• Global Service Scholars• Small Change, Better World• Online Education• Social Enterprise & Entrepreneurship• InSight Magazine

name: Book Club at UCI
description: The Book Club at UCI aims to facilitate meaningful connections through our shared love for books. We hope to hold quarterly book readings, discussions, and events (social, community service, etc) that will enrich our lives as students. Reading holds different values in different lives– hobby, passion, career, creative relief, therapy– and this club seeks to create a safe space for each.

name: Books Through Bars
description: Our mission is to provide reading materials to readers in prisons across the United States. We hope that each book we send out reaches someone who aspires to improve their well-being and contribute to others around them with emotional, social, and professional knowledge.

name: Bowling at UCI
description: Eager to level up your Bowling skills? Have a desire to knock down some pins as a hobby? Need an excuse to take a break from academics and hang out with friends? Join us for some games at Bowling at UCI! Whether you rarely bowl or are a professional bowler with multiple 300-point games, we hope to create the space for your to not only develop your skills but also play with other bowlers at UCI. Follow us at @bowlingatuci on Instagram to learn more. Happy bowling!

name: Boxing Club at UCI
description: Boxing Club at UCI is affiliated with UCI Club Sports and we compete in the National Collegiate Boxing Association. Our club seeks to provide the UCI community with an engaging and applicable way to stay in shape while forming connections with others. Whether you're an experienced boxer or a beginner looking to stay fit, boxing club will challenge you and give you the opportunity to create bonds.

name: Brain Exercise Initiative at UCI
description: We are a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization that uses simple math, writing and reading-aloud exercises as an intervention to improve cognitive function in those with Alzheimer's Disease.

name: Brazilian Jiu Jitsu Club at UCI
description: Purpose/Mission Statement * The purpose of the Brazilian Jiu Jitsu Club is to provide an easy-going social environment that gives undergraduate students an introduction to the techniques of Brazilian Jiu Jitsu. * No experience is necessary to become a part of this organization, but as a member of the organization you will receive professional hands-on experience. * This organization is driven by the passion and motivation of its members. The more work and effort you put into the hands-on experience, the more you will get out of it.  Events * Brazilian Jiu Jitsu will hold annual collegiate tournaments with local schools. * Organized training sessions with other club members. * Seminars with guest instructors.  * Social gatherings such as attending tournaments, beach parties and bbq's. Goals * To create a collegiate component to Brazilian Jiu Jitsu in order to provide students with a safe and affordable way to compete.

name: Brick Theatre Company
description: Brick Theatre Company aims to support and uplift the intersectional voices of the LGBTQ+ community through theatre. We strive to facilitate the creation of new works that truthfully represent the diverse voices in our community. We will maintain an open dialogue with our audiences so that we can educate and build connections that will uplift all of us.  We strive to ignite passion and compassion in ourselves and our audiences. We strive to become a welcoming home and expression of love and pride for all LGBTQ+ students on campus.

name: Bridges International at UCI
description: Bridges International at UCI is a club dedicated to serving international students at UCI. We are a group started by Christians to help International students to adjust and feel at home in Irvine. Our motto is providing a "Home Away from Home", through weekly English conversation program, Friday night dinners, fun events, and other spiritual resources.

name: BridgeUSA at UCI
description: Our mission is to counter the growing division and polarization by encouraging thoughtful conversations that prioritize respect, humility, and empathy. We aim to create an inclusive environment where all perspectives are welcomed and heard, as long as they are presented with civility and care.

name: Bridging The Gap at UCI - BTG
description: Our primary goal is to bridge the gap between socioeconomically disadvantaged students and careers in healthcare and research through an empowering culture of mentorship and service.

name: Brown Bag Theatre Company
description: Brown Bag Theater Company is an ensemble of artists & scholars who aim to produce equally engaging & captivating artistic work that reflects & empowers the Latinx communities. We create various opportunities for young Latinx individuals, and our allies, within the performing arts. At BBTC, we believe that the discipline of theatre is a cultural force capable of transforming our community and we bolster this belief whilst celebrating the richness & pride of Latinx culture.

name: built at uci
description: The purpose of built @uci is to provide an inclusive environment where students can explore their interests and strengthen their skills in any area they're passionate about, from crafting and design to technical building and problem-solving, through community meetings, workshops, and collaborative projects.

name: Burmese Student Association at UCI
description: The organization, Burmese Student Associate (BURSA) at UCI, is dedicated to the celebration of Burmese culture as well as to creating a welcoming and supportive space for Burmese students. The organization aims to share Burmese culture and spread awareness of current events of the country within the University as well as the greater Los Angeles area. BURSA will allow the opportunity for students to engage in social, cultural, and community-service-based activities.

name: Business Careers in Entertainment Club at UCI
description: The Business Careers in Entertainment Club (BCEC) at UC Irvine was established during the Winter quarter of 2018. BCEC is designed to help students explore and prepare for careers in the entertainment industry.  We're open to students of all majors, providing them with the professional development opportunities and network necessary to competitively pursue a career in entertainment. Whether you are interested in business development, finance, marketing, accounting, engineering, creative roles, or almost any other role in entertainment, BCEC can help you learn about those roles and/or strive to get them.

name: Business Law Society at UCI Law
description: The Business Law Society (BLS) is dedicated to bridging the gap between law students and the corporate and business sectors of the legal profession. The organization focuses on expanding professional networking opportunities by fostering connections with law firms, in-house counsel, and bar associations. BLS also aims to collaborate with other graduate programs and student organizations to host interdisciplinary events that promote the exchange of ideas and the development of meaningful professional relationships. In addition, the organization is committed to cultivating leadership skills and practical business acumen among its members through speaker panels, workshops, and targeted training sessions.

name: By Any Means at UCI
description: By Any Means (B.A.M.) is an organization dedicated to enriching the lives of the homeless by any means possible. We will cater to individual homeless shelters' unique needs, including supplying volunteers for particular programs or internships, collecting donations in the form of food, drink, or items and delivering donations to the shelters, and more. By Any Means will provide opportunities for volunteers to raise awareness for the homeless community, participate in/plan club events, and work with other organizations dedicated to helping the homeless.

name: Cal Animage Epsilon (formerly Anime Club-Cal Animage Epsilon)
description: To enrich students of UC Irvine with the language, culture and animation of Japan. And to unite people with similar interests in Japanese Animation.

name: California Initiative for Health Equity and Action
description: The California Initiative for Health Equity and Action (Cal-IHEA) is a state-wide research and policy center that supports the translation of research evidence into state health policy and public health practice to improve health equity in California.

name: CALPIRG - California Public Interest Research Group at UCI
description: Students have the power to shape the future we will inherit. We work with professional staff at colleges and universities to make sure our peers have the skills, opportunities and training they need to create a better, more sustainable future for all of us. Our chapters provide the training, professional support and resources students need to tackle climate change, protect public health, revitalize our democracy, feed the hungry and more. Students have been at the forefront of social change throughout history, from civil rights, to voting rights to protecting the environment. For nearly 50 years we’ve helped students to get organized, mobilized and energized so they can continue to be on the cutting edge of positive change.

name: CalTeach at UCI
description: The CalTeach Advisory Board recruits and cultivates community across and within cohorts to foster the collective well-being of future equity-focused teachers.

name: Cambodian Awareness Organization at UCI
description: Cambodian Awareness Organization is a group dedicated to bringing Cambodia into the forefront of public thought. We celebrate multiculturalism and diversity among members. With a focus on social networking, building leadership skills, and volunteer experience, CAO encourages involvement in the community as we seek to reach out to people both at home and abroad. In addition, we are building bridges between student Cambodian organizations throughout Southern California.

name: Camp Kesem
description: Camp Kesem provides a summer camp to kids whose parents have been affected by cancer through the support of student-run campaigns. Kesem is a nationwide community, driven by passionate college student leaders, that supports children through and beyond their parents cancer. Kesem is the largest national organization dedicated to supporting children impacted by a parent's cancer at no cost to families. Our innovative and fun-filled programs provide children with peers who understand their unique needs and create long-lasting impacts.

name: CampMed at UCI
description: CampMed at UCI aspires to inspire students who face low socioeconomic barriers to pursue higher education by providing exposure to undergraduate mentors, UC Irvine faculty, as well as healthcare professionals. CampMed at UCI is a student-run high school outreach program that was founded by UCI medical and undergraduate students in 1997. There was an increasing need for a local program that would target socio-economically disadvantaged high school students interested in pursuing higher education, particularly in the health science fields. Currently in its 27th year of existence, CampMed at UCI has reached out to over 5,000 high school students from Los Angeles and Orange County schools. In addition, the CampMed program has expanded to other UC campuses such as UCLA (2013), UC Riverside (2016), and UC Santa Barbara (2023).

name: Campus Planning & Sustainability
description: The mission of Campus Planning & Sustainability is to plan the use and physical character of campus land and its overall environment in order to maximize the use of campus land resources in support of the university's mission.

name: Campuswide Honors Collegium
description: The Campuswide Honors Collegium is a community of motivated learners dedicated to scholastic excellence and personal growth that is supported by the resources of a major research university. The unique opportunities provided by the Campuswide Honors Collegium for students to learn and engage with other talented and motivated students and with faculty in a supportive, learning community help students get the most out of their education and achieve ambitious goals.

name: Campuswide Honors Student Council (CHSC)
description: The Campuswide Honors Student Council, or CHSC, is an affiliate of the Campuswide Honors Program (CHP) that represents the students of the program. With over 3,000 alumni and 700 current members, the CHSC serves as the directing student leadership body for the Campuswide Honors community. We are dedicated to promoting academic excellence, developing strong student-faculty relations, and coordinating social, academic, and community service events for CHC students.

name: Cancer Research Institute
description: To share events sponsored by the Cancer Research Institute, an organized research unit in the Office of Research, with the students. The CRI also lists community events on behalf of the Chao Family Comprehensive Cancer Center.

name: Cards at UCI
description: Cards at UCI is dedicated to fostering a fun, inclusive community where students can learn, play, and connect through card and board games. Our mission is to introduce new card games, teach essential concepts in probability and statistics through gameplay, and create a relaxed social space for card enthusiasts to unwind from academic life.

name: CareTech
description: CareTech is committed to advancing healthcare through the development of innovative applications designed for early disease detection, utilizing cutting-edge technologies and artificial intelligence. Our mission is to leverage the collective expertise of UCI students to create impactful solutions that significantly enhance healthcare outcomes.

name: Cariño Student Outreach Clinic (formerly Outreach Clinic at UC Irvine)
description: Cariño Student Outreach Clinic is a non-denominational organization that is committed to delivering high-quality medical care to individuals who have limited access to health services and insurance. We moved our operation to The HUB OC Resource Center to better serve the Santa Ana, Orange and neighboring communities. We strive to provide comprehensive care to our patients by offering health care services, wellness education, social services, basic medications, referrals, and, if they are eligible, assistance in obtaining health care coverage. While we would like to serve everyone, our clinic is intended to catch those who fall between the cracks of the current healthcare system, the uninsured.

name: Catalyst Undergraduate Art Gallery
description: Catalyst Undergraduate Art Gallery is an undergraduate-run gallery in which motivated students of any major may display their artwork while also gaining curatorial experience. Catalyst strives to promote budding artists' careers and to create opportunities for students to share art and culture with the campus at large.

name: Cellular & Molecular Biosciences
description: The PhD program in Cellular & Molecular Biosciences at UC Irvine provides ideal training to launch the careers of talented researchers in diverse fields of biomedicine. With a multi-cultural student cohort, we strive to fulfill the dreams of students from many different backgrounds. The training environment is rigorous, but also cognizant of the need in life for a supportive and balanced lifestyle.

name: Center for Black Cultures, Resources & Research
description: The mission of the Center for Black Cultures, Resources, and Research (CBCRR) is to provide a just, safe, vibrant, inclusive, culturally supportive, and socio-ecologically sustainable space for Black Students, Faculty, and Staff. A home away from home where Black students can thrive and reach for their highest potential and hopefully discover their genius. The mission and work of the Center for Black Cultures, Resources and Research (CBCRR) is to create a home away from home for Black students, faculty, and staff at UC Irvine, to bolster and when necessary restore and rebuild a vibrant Black community on campus, to provide Black students from various walks of Black life and cultural experiences a place to center themselves within their cultural realities.

name: Center for Digital Transformation
description: The Center for Digital Transformation is a Center of Excellence at The Paul Merage School of Business at the University of California, Irvine. The Center (CDT) conducts and disseminates research on digital transformation. As a university-based center, it focuses on educating the workforce for success in a technology-intensive world.

name: Center for Epigenetics and Metabolism
description: The Center for Epigenetics and Metabolism (CEM) brings together researchers at UCI interested in epigenetics, chromatin remodeling and cellular metabolism by fostering research interactions, developing novel strategies, and informing the UCI community of the remarkable developments in the field. The CEM creates a physical, intellectual and organizational environment for the study of epigenetics and the relationship with cellular metabolism. The CEM has privileged relationships with other Centers of Epigenetics in Southern California.

name: Center for Excellence in Writing & Communication (Writing Center)
description: The Center for Excellence in Writing & Communication (The Writing Center) is a free resource for undergraduate and graduate students to get feedback on any writing from peer tutors and professional writing specialists.

name: Center for Investment and Wealth Management
description: The Center for Investment and Wealth Management is dedicated to providing students at UCI with the financial literacy skills they need to succeed in life.

name: Center for Neuropolitics
description: The Center for Neuropolitics contributes to the ongoing political dialogues by engaging the multi-disciplinary expertise of neuroscience, political science, neurology, psychiatry, psychology, and philosophy.

name: Center for Research on Teacher Development and Professional Practice (CRT)
description: The Education Center for Research on Teacher Development and Professional Practice (CRT) in the School of Education at the University of California, Irvine fosters collaborations among faculty, students, and practitioners on projects focused on a variety of aspects of teacher development and learning and on the study of teaching and teacher professional practice and of the systems in which these are embedded (including school and district leadership).

name: Center For Student Wellness & Health Promotion
description: We strive to be a leader in collegiate health promotion by focusing on the unique and relevant health needs and concerns of UCI students to support their academic success. We empower students to make informed decisions to support individual health and a healthy campus environment by providing comprehensive programs and coordinated services revolving around sexual and relationship health, alcohol and other drugs, diet and nutrition, emotional well-being, and overall wellness.

name: Center for the Neurobiology of Learning and Memory
description: The Center for the Neurobiology of Learning and Memory at UC Irvine is directed by Michael A. Yassa. It is the first institute in the world dedicated to the study of learning and memory. In 35 years since it was first established in 1983 by the UC Regents, with James L. McGaugh as its Founding Director, it has significantly transformed our understanding of the brain and how it stores information. It has long been heralded as the "Mecca of Learning and Memory" and has been at the forefront of brain science ever since its inception.The CNLM's mission is to "crack the memory code". This is only possible by using a multidisciplinary approach that breaks down the barriers between neuroscientists and bridges across levels of analysis. Research programs at the CNLM are completely integrated, from molecules to mind.

name: Central Asian Student Association at UC Irvine
description: The mission of the Central Asian Student Association (CASA) at UC Irvine is to create unity among students from Central Asian backgrounds by fostering our shared cultural heritage while building deep and lasting connections. CASA strives to represent the voices of Central Asian students officially within UCI and beyond.Our purpose is to celebrate and preserve the unique traditions, history, and values of Central Asia through diverse activities that connect members to one another and to the broader academic and cultural community.In addition to cultural enrichment, CASA aims to highlight and share the achievements of Central Asian students in fields such as science, technology, arts, and more. By showcasing these accomplishments, we inspire current and future generations while building value and collaboration among members. CASA also seeks to make its presence well-known and accessible to new students from Central Asia at UCI, serving as a welcoming and supportive resource for those joining our community.

name: Chabad at UCI
description: The primary purpose of Chabad at UCI is to provide an inclusive space for students at the University of California, Irvine to explore their Judaic roots within the framework of traditional Judaism. Our objectives include but are not limited to; educational, ritual, and social activities, in addition to counseling and spiritual guidance to individual students.

name: Chancellor's Excellence Scholars
description: Through a collaborative effort between Student Success Initiatives (SSI) and campus partners, the Chancellor's Excellence and Promise Scholars Program aims to support the advancement and holistic development of its students. Education partnerships make up a cohort of students, consisting of first-year students and transfers, who will receive support through intentional programming and advising to meet their academic, personal, and professional needs as they make their transition into UC Irvine.

name: Chao Family Comprehensive Cancer Center
description: The Center's overall Mission parallels that of our parent institutions, the University of California, Irvine and its health system, UCI Health: to DISCOVER, TEACH, and HEAL within the broad discipline of cancer medicine.DiscoverTo facilitate and promote interdisciplinary and transdisciplinary cancer research across UCI. To develop new knowledge about the causes, prevention, detection, treatment, and survival of cancer that shift scientific paradigms, change public policy and clinical practice, and eliminate cancer health disparities. TeachTo disseminate state-of-the-art cancer knowledge to cancer caregivers, patients and families, and the public. To train the next diverse generation of cancer researchers and care providers.HealTo deliver the highest quality multidisciplinary clinical care to cancer patients. To develop and sustain programs to alleviate the burden of cancer within our diverse community.

name: Charitable Humanitarian Acts Society at UCI - CHASO
description: CHASO is built upon the foundations of community and philanthropy. By uniting  healthcare, business, and art under a common cause, we strive to provide resources for  those underserved and raise awareness to societal issues. This chapter at UCI will focus on  upbringing and highlighting small businesses nearby, while also connecting networks of current and past Anteaters to fundraise for the greater good.

name: Charlie Dunlop School of Biological Sciences
description: The mission of the Charlie Dunlop School of Biological Sciences is to create new knowledge about biological processes and principles, to disseminate this information by educating students about factual knowledge and the experience of discovery, and to contribute to the public discussion about the nature and role of science in society. Research within the school encompasses all levels of biological organization, from molecular and biochemical to global biological processes. It encompasses both fundamental discovery and application in areas beneficial to society.

name: Chemistry Club at UCI
description: The Chemistry Club aims to provide support for undergraduates at the University of California, Irvine, interested in the chemical sciences; we will promote scholarship, instill a mindset of career professionalism, emphasize the value of outreach, and build a community of individuals who will bond and grow—personally, academically, and professionally—in the field of chemistry.

name: Chi Rho Omicron Inc - XPO
description: The mission of Chi Rho Omicron shall be to promote the understanding, enrichment, and appreciation of the Pilipino culture, history, and heritage through a brotherhood/family environment. To instill the desire for self-improvement, scholastic excellence, and the cultivation of civic responsibility.

name: Chicano/Latino Staff Association
description: "The Chicano/Latino Staff Association at UCI shall assist the University in the recruitment and retention of Chicano/Latino undergraduate and graduate students. It shall support the Chicano/Latino campus community by: (1)providing a social support network for Chicano/Latino staff and students; (2) serving as an advocacy group for the Chicano/Latino campus community; (3) encouraging and promoting the hiring and retention of Chicano/Latino staff at UCI; and (4) advocating and developing educational and social programs for staff at UCI."

name: Chicanos/Latinos for Community Medicine
description: Our mission is to cultivate an inclusive community of Latinx and underrepresented students committed to addressing health disparities through service, education, and advocacy for underserved populations by fostering a diverse network.

name: Chinese Alumni Association at UCI
description: Our organization aims to bridge the gap between incoming Chinese Anteaters and Chinese Alumni, who are willing to help students who studied abroad for the first time. By organizing workshops, group activities, and bonding events, we will hone students' life skills in living in the United States and achieving their pursuits. If you want to join a warm and supportive family, the Chinese Alumni Association is your best choice!

name: Chinese Association (CAUCI)
description: We, the members of the Chinese Association at the University of California-Irvine, establish this constitution to govern such matters as are within the jurisdiction of this organization.  The purpose of CAUCI shall be threefold: a ) To increase the awareness of Chinese culture among club members/ associates and the general community; b ) To promote social interactions and understanding among members; c ) To be of service to the campus as well as surrounding community.

name: Chinese Dance & Ballet Fusion at UCI
description: We are dedicated to blending the grace of Chinese dance with the elegance of ballet, uniting the artistic essence of East and West. Through movement, we transcend cultural boundaries, fostering a community where tradition meets innovation, and every dancer finds their unique expression.

name: Chinese Law Student Society
description: The purpose of this organization is to create a diverse learning environment and network for Chinese and other international students, facilitate conversations and promote awareness of Chinese-related laws and regulations, and assist member students and alumni in their career development.

name: Chinese Orchestra@UC Irvine
description: Our organization intends to foster the love for Chinese traditional music through performances, collaborations and outreach. We wish to provide an open, supportive environment where students of all backgrounds can grow their skills, share their knowledge, and contribute to the multicultural fabric of UCI. We wish to share the experience of Chinese traditional music and explore its nexus with modern/western music.

name: Chinese Students and Scholars Association (CSSA)
description: CSSA is an organization that helps Chinese students and scholars in the aspects of daily life, career development in the U.S. Ourselves, members of CSSA-UCI, are a group of Chinese students and scholars who are full of passion and enthusiasm for exploring the way to building deep communication channels between Chinese and other cultures and groups at UCI. We want to build well organized community in which people with different nationalities have mutual understanding in culture identity.

name: Chinese Union
description: Chinese Union (CU UCI) is a registered student organization at UCI founded by international students. we have been dedicated to serving the Chinese student community and supporting international students. CU UCI focuses on charity work, volunteer opportunities, and fostering cultural exchange within the campus community. CU provides valuable resources and networking opportunities for students. All active members receive a Volunteer Certificate as proof of their participation in CU's activities, and Executive Board members are recognized with a special certificate for their leadership roles.

name: Chinese Union in Computer Science - CUCS at UCI
description: Chinese Union in Computer Science mainly serves the Chinese students as well as other international students in the school of ICS, helps them improve the academic understanding and performance, enriches their extracurricular life and seeks intern/job opportunities for students. We hope that everyone can get great experience and valuable memory with CUCS.

name: Christian Legal Society Student Chapter at UCI School of Law (formerly Christian Law Students Association)
description: Christian Fellowship for UCI Law students.

name: Christian Students
description: Christian Students has been a registered club since 1974 at the University of California in Irvine. We hope that the club would serve as a gathering point for all students who are interested in pursuing the truth in the Bible and having fellowship with other students. We also organize other club activities to strengthen the bonds between members and to contribute to the overall atmosphere of student well-being and rapport on campus. If you are looking for a club that combines school life with spiritual life, then we invite you to join us!

name: Cine-Collective
description: Our mission is to encourage people to be familiar with what film has to offer and how to do it ourselves as well. We wish to explore every facet of the film industry while stimulating creativity on campus. We seek to establish a presence on campus that encourages all students to get involved in film discussion, understanding, and their production. This is a place for all people to engage/learn about how to make films together.

name: Circle K International at UCI
description: Circle K International (CKI) is a collegiate community service organization spanning the globe. We pursue our three tenets: service, leadership, and fellowship as we serve others. Circle K provides its members the opportunity to engage in communities both local and distant, with various colleges collaborating on projects across borders (often state and sometimes national) on a frequent basis. Additionally, the organization provides members with leadership opportunities and networking.  Circle K is part of the Kiwanis Family, which includes community service groups at multiple levels of education and more. There is K-Kids for elementary school, Builder\'s Clubs for middle school, Key Clubs/KIWINs in high school, Circle K in colleges, CAYP for young professionals, and Aktion for the physically and mentally disabled, all of which are supported by Kiwanis International.  Locally, Circle K at UC Irvine frequents community service projects all over. On a weekly basis we participate in helping out at Tabitha's Blessings, Save Our Youth, South County Outreach, Girls Inc., and Hemopet. During weekends, projects vary even more. However, we regularly volunteer for habitat restoration projects, like Second Sundays, various marathons and runs, community-wide food drives, and even animal-related service events, on top of any other events that need help in the area.  Our organization strives towards membership development and community outreach by organizing and hosting fundraising events for the following district-wide initiatives: Kiwanis Family House, Pediatric Trauma Program, and American Foundation for Suicide Prevention.  We are the leading global community-service organization on college and university campuses that enriches the world one member, one child and one community at a time.

name: Circle of Fifths
description: Circle of Fifths is a student-run a cappella group that creates a space for members to join together and sing. Prioritizing showmanship and brotherhood, Circle of Fifths is a group whose energy and closeness are reflected closely in their performances. Circle of Fifths performs at club events on campus and outside events to which they are invited, and provides a space for tenor & bass singers to create memorable music. In addition to performance, Circle of Fifths also competes in competitions.

name: Civil & Environmental Engineering
description: Our mission is to provide students with a broad, fundamental and flexible educational program and to expand engineering knowledge through an active and exciting undergraduate and graduate research program. The department is dedicated to providing life-long development, instilling a sense of professional responsibility, and serving our society. We provide an environment that promotes teamwork and values integrity and honesty in all efforts. Civil and environmental engineering is an inherently interdisciplinary field. As such, students select groups of courses in one or more related application areas, such as computer science, applied mathematics, urban and regional planning, economics, chemistry and management. The civil and environmental engineering curriculum leads to the B.S., M.S. and Ph.D.

name: Civil and Environmental Engineering Graduate Association
description: The association's mission is to promote unity among CEE graduate students through social events, and advance their academic and professional interests. The idea behind the CEEGA association is to facilitate the interaction between graduate students from different sub-disciplines in CEE department. In order to attain this goal, various social events (including Pizza parties, Trekking, Board games etc) and scientific/professional events (including Career Panels, Workshops, Field Visits, etc) will be organized during each academic quarter. CEEGA will also provide networking opportunities with industry professionals and hold events to develop better interaction between current students and CEE Alumni. In addition, CEEGA will support and encourage CEE graduate student activities and events proposed by CEE graduate students and that are pertinent to CEEGA's vision.

name: Clair De Lune A Cappella
description: Clair de Lune (CDL) A Cappella is an all-treble voice a cappella group at the University of California, Irvine.  CDL is composed of members from various ethnicities, social classes, and levels of musical proficiency who come together to share their love for music and performance both on and off campus. We prioritize inclusivity and are a fully functioning support system for one another and strive to motivate each member to flourish musically as we become more confident in finding our voice as individuals, as well as in the ensemble!

name: Claire Trevor School of the Arts
description: As UC Irvine's creative laboratory, the Claire Trevor School of the Arts explores and presents the arts as the essence of human experience and expression, through art forms ranging from the most traditional to the radically new. Our international and distinguished faculty work across a wide variety of art forms, partnering with others across the campus; our nationally ranked programs in art, dance, drama, and music begin with training but end in original invention.

name: Climate Resilience Club
description: Our mission is to promote meditative and mindfulness practices through a deep connection with the environment. We aim to facilitate collective action to address climate issues by organizing community cleanups, local initiatives, and environmental advocacy throughout the year to increase community ecological sustainability. Further, we are committed to advancing environmental education beyond our organization by collaborating with local climate change coalitions and field experts to educate our surrounding community.

name: Climbing Club at UCI
description: Climbing Club at UCI is dedicated to promoting rock climbing within the UCI community.  We achieve this by competing in the Collegiate Climbing Series (CCS) at the local, regional and national level competitions. We offer practices, training sessions, professional coaching, climbing specific clinics, and information meetings so everyone has the opportunity to increase their rock climbing knowledge and skill level.

name: Club Baseball at UCI
description: Help improve members' skills by allowing each individual to compete at a high level. Develop friendships through the shared love of the game. Ensure members grow as teammates and individuals in order to cultivate success on and off the field. Make sure to follow us @uciclubbaseball for important information (tryouts, games, socials), or email us clubbasebalatuci@gmail.com with any questions!

name: Club Italia at UCI
description: To encourage students to not only learn more about Italian Culture and Language in an open environment, but also to engage students in study abroad opportunities and travel.

name: Club Roundnet at UCI (formerly Spikeball at UCI)
description: Club Roundnet at UCI is dedicated to fostering a vibrant community centered around the enjoyment and promotion of the game of Roundnet known more often as Spikeball. This club sport provides a place for competitive players to grow and compete against other colleges. As a part of the Spikeball College Tour series there will be two sectionals along with various other tournaments we will train for. The club consists of open pick up, competitive practices, clinics, exhibition matches, and national tournaments.

name: Club Softball at UCI
description: This club is a fastpitch softball team who competes around Southern California and parts of Arizona. Members have ranges of experience, but some experience is preferred due to the competitive level.

name: Cognitive Science Association
description: CSA aims to empower students interested in cognitive science by building a closer-knit community, making the Cognitive Science Department and research happening on campus more accessible.

name: College Democrats at UCI
description: College Democrats at UCI is dedicated to informing the student body about important political issues affecting our university, city, state, and country.  We strive to foster intelligent political discussion and critical thinking on campus, connect students to their local communities and elected officials, and advance Democratic principles and policies of social, economic, and environmental justice.

name: College Republicans at UCI (College GOP)
description: College Republicans at UCI are dedicated to promoting political activism and providing a forum for debate here at UCI about issues concerning students, California, and the nation at large. We seek to bring together like-minded individuals in order to foster a greater sense of community. Whether you are a Republican or not, feel free to drop by and talk to us!

name: Commit the Change
description: We are an organization at UC Irvine that delivers high quality software for non-profit organizations while providing meaningful opportunities for students to develop tech with purpose.

name: Common Ground Dance Team
description: Common Ground Dance Team is an organization at UCI that is dedicated to growing as dancers and people, inspiring others through our performances at UCI and non-UCI events. Our mission, "Valuing the importance of well-being, self-expression, and inclusion; we strive to empower one another as a means to cultivate appreciation for our individualities - and although we may create, move, and live in different ways, one thing is for sure: DANCING IS OUR COMMON GROUND."

name: Communication Club
description: Communication Club seeks to foster a cultural and language exchangebetween UCI students and International ESL students. Through weeklyprogramming and the partnering of students, we aim to provide an outlet tothese international ESL students to make their experience at UCI better and topractice their English with fluent speakers.

name: Community Health Alliance of UCI
description: The Community Health Alliance (CHA) of UCI is dedicated to raising awareness about the health and food insecurity issues faced by the homeless and underprivileged communities in underserved areas of Southern California. Our organization provides structured community support through various community service initiatives.

name: Community of Diverse Empowerment in Computing
description: CODEC is dedicated to making technology accessible while fostering a supportive, confident, and inclusive community for students interested in this field. We strive to create an environment where every student, particularly those who are underrepresented, new to technology, or uncertain about their place in the industry, feels welcomed, valued, and empowered to grow.Our mission is to assist students in finding their community, discovering their paths in the tech field, and developing the confidence necessary to thrive both academically and professionally. We believe that a sense of belonging is essential for success and that diversity, curiosity, and collaboration strengthen not only individuals but the entire tech community.By providing a non-judgmental space where questions are encouraged and experiences are shared, we aim to alleviate feelings of isolation, intimidation, and inadequacy. The community and personal development fostered by CODEC will support students throughout their time at UCI and equip them for success beyond their academic journeys.

name: Community Table at UCI (formerly Episcopal Campus Ministry at UCI (Canterbury Irvine))
description: The community table at UCI organization consists of a community of fellowship and service. We are a recognized group at the University of California, Irvine and we serve students, faculty, and staff with an emphasis on addressing the food insecurities that may exist in the college community. We meet once a month to have a communal meal with the members of the organization during which we express any ups and downs that have happened in our lives with the goal of fostering a strong support system among members to enhance the college experience. We have several community events throughout the year which involve spiritual growth, giving back to the community, study sessions, self-improvement workshops, and more.

name: Competitive Sports
description: Club Sports at UCI are student-initiated and student-managed clubs that provide opportunities in recreational and competitive activities of interest to the student body.Participating in club sports provides an outlet for competing in athletics or learning new recreational activities.The Club Sports program offers a variety of sports for students to participate in and provides unique leadership and club management opportunities. The Club Sports program's purpose is to give all UCI students the opportunity to pursue specific sport and recreation activities with others who share a similar interest.

name: Conceptual Collective Plus
description: Our mission is to allocate a space for artists and non-art majors to have a space to create art, learn about art, and be published in unjuried publications and exhibitions. The goals of our organization is to publish periodical print and digital publications unjuried, host an accessible gallery show of submitted artworks unjuried, and to build a community of artists that can create together and receive feedback from each other.

name: Consumer Law Organization
description: The mission of this organization is to:1. educate UC Irvine students about consumer law issues as well as legal andlegislative advocacy;2. create networks between consumer law attorneys, advocacy organizations, andthe UC Irvine student body;3. foster community among student advocates whose interests intersect withconsumer protection; and4. promote consumer protection curriculum and clinics that provide trainingopportunities for students.

name: Conte Center @ UCI
description: Addresses how early-life experiences influence the brain and contribute to vulnerability to mental illnesses starting during adolescence.

name: COPE Health Scholars
description: The purpose(s) of this organization shall be to provide access to information about health care and the different careers in health care. Furthermore, the club is not only for the career, but to allow students to engage in community service, health-related education, and clinical experience. The club will also serve as a platform for the COPE Health Scholars program, affiliated with the clinical educational program, to advocate for improvements.

name: Coptic Orthodox Christian Club
description: To support fellowship on campus and to bring the experience of the Orthodox Christian Church through community life, prayer, service to others, and study of the Faith. Furthermore, Coptic Club @ UCI strives to nurture and strengthen love for Christ Jesus and His church in its fullness at this most critical juncture of life.

name: Cosmetic Chemist Society
description: The purpose of CCS is to promote research in the cosmetic industry to further the interests and recognition of aspiring cosmetic chemists. Through events and workshops, CCS will help students interested in the cosmetic industry to get connected with industry professionals, gain insight on and opportunities in the field, and learn about the chemical ingredients and their interactions in personal care products. CCS will be career and professionally focused, but the organization will also emphasize the creativity, educational, and social aspects of the cosmetic industry.

name: Create For Kids
description: At Create For Kids, we use the power of art to bring smiles to hospitalized children. We know that being in a hospital can be tough for kids and their families, which is why we provide a variety of creative activities to make their stay a little brighter. We believe that art is a vital component of the healing process, and we strive to create a nurturing environment that promotes creativity and smiles. Our volunteers are passionate about their work and are dedicated to making a lasting impact on children's lives.

name: Creative Media Network at UCI
description: The CMN’s mission is to foster a collaborative environment in which filmmakers, actors, writers, photographers, and all persons interested in the creative process can connect with one another through a streamlined and accessible network. The CMN will serve as a community through which the creative process can be shared. The CMN is completely led by and for UCI students and will focus on catering to their creative efforts, but all CMN resources will be available to anyone regardless of experience or university affiliation. Our initial goals for the organization involve its inception as a website for filmmakers, actors, and all other creatives to post job boards, advertise their skills, and promote upcoming projects or events. This site will also include a search function, which will allow collaborators to find and contact members who match their needs. Following this initial establishment, the CMN wishes to expand its scope and outreach through quarterly membership-recruitment activities and educational workshops, as well as social networking events for established members.

name: Creative Wellness Collective
description: The purpose of the organization is to provide a supportive and creative environment where individuals can explore art as a tool for personal growth, emotional healing, and self-expression. The club's mission is to foster mental and emotional well-being through artistic activities, workshops, lectures, and clinical experiences that allow participants to engage in a therapeutic process. In the short term, the organization aims to offer regular sessions that introduce various art forms, providing participants with space and guidance to express their emotions in a safe and non-judgmental setting. Also, having professional therapists across multiple disciplines lecture during meetings, members will have a unique opportunity to learn what the profession is like. The long-term goal is to inevitably create a close-knit community where like-minded members at UCI can develop their creative skills, gain clinical experience, promote mental wellness, and raise awareness about the benefits of art therapy. The club's audience includes students, faculty, and community members who are interested in the intersection of art and mental health, regardless of their prior experience in art. The organization is dedicated to making a positive impact on the mental health landscape by offering a unique and accessible approach to therapy that combines creativity with emotional support.

name: Creative Writers Guild at UC Irvine
description: We are an organization that promotes and celebrates the processes of creative writing. We recognize the power of narrative in our culture, and our goal is to craft stories, poems, and films that matter.

name: Cricket Club at UCI
description: The Cricket Club at UCI plays and hosts the prestigious OCCA (Orange County Cricket Association) which involves the best cricket playing clubs in Orange County. The tournament is held in the Fall Quarter and Winter Quarter every year and played in the Twenty-20 overs format.  We also play competitive bilateral series games against our arch rivals UC San Diego on non-league weekends.

name: Criminology, Law & Society PhD Program
description: Consistently ranked as one of the top programs in the nation, the Criminology, Law and Society PhD program focuses on the causes, manifestations and consequences of crime; the impacts of crime on society; social regulation and inequality; the civil and criminal legal system; the social and cultural contexts of law; legal institutions and professions; and the interactive effects of law and society. With internationally renowned faculty and interdisciplinary perspectives, the program aims to develop students' theoretical and methodological sophistication to prepare them for faculty positions at major universities and colleges or for research, training, and administrative work in the justice system.

name: Criminology, Law and Society Club
description: The purpose of our Criminology, Law and Society Club is to offer a space of similar majors and interests to students who would like to network with others of the same degree aspiration. We want to provide insight, guidance, and services to support students with their classes as well as a pathway for success. Our goal is to allow students to have an open space to collaborate, study, and hear from guest speakers about career opportunities and their experiences within the field. We decided to create this club as there is no environment for Criminology students to gather and support each other.

name: Critical Theory Emphasis
description: To create a community among faculty and students in or interested in the Critical Theory Emphasis at UCI.

name: Cross Youth Initiative at UCI
description: Cross Youth Initiative at UCI is a dynamic collegiate campus group dedicated to reaching and empowering the next generation through a unique blend of faith and sports. Partnering with faith-based youth organizations, we organize spontaneous sports meetups, competitive tournaments, and engaging sports camps for middle and high school students. Our mission is to inspire and mentor youth by combining athletic activities with the teachings of Christ. College students serve as coaches and role models, building meaningful relationships and providing positive guidance. Join us in fostering a community where sports and spirituality come together to create lasting impacts on young lives through the Cross Youth Initiative. Cross Youth Initiative is a dynamic collegiate campus group dedicated to reaching and empowering the next generation through a unique blend of faith and sports. Partnering with faith-based youth organizations, we organize spontaneous sports meetups, competitive tournaments, and engaging sports camps for middle and high school students. Our mission is to inspire and mentor youth by combining athletic activities with the teachings of Christ. College students serve as coaches and role models, building meaningful relationships and providing positive guidance. Join us in fostering a community where sports and spirituality come together to create lasting impacts on young lives through the Cross Youth Initiative at UCI.

name: Cross-Cultural Center
description: The Cross-Cultural Center is committed to fostering the holistic development of students by fostering an affirming and inclusive environment. This space enables students to explore their diverse social identities, cultivate critical awareness, build a socially just community, foster meaningful relationships, and promote lifelong learning beyond their time at UCI.

name: CrossLife College Fellowship
description: To bring Gospel-loving students together to enjoy fellowship and grow in the Word.

name: Cru
description: We are Cru, a multiethnic community of students and staff passionate about Jesus. We exist to know God better, grow in our faith together, and show the love of Jesus to the world.

name: Cyber at UCI
description: Cyber@UCI is the premier applied cybersecurity education resource at UCI that focuses on delivering cybersecurity education and awareness to the local community and student population. We accomplish this through organizing and hosting weekly meetings, independent student research, and competitions. We provide a space and community for students, staff, and faculty to experiment and learn about cybersecurity however it pertains to their personal and/or professional interests.

name: Cycling Club at UCI
description: Cycling Club at UCI offers resources so as to assist those interested in pursuing mountain biking or road biking as a competitive club sport, recreation hobby, or healthy life style.

name: Data @ UCI
description: Established in 2021, Data @ UCI aims to promote and grow the field of Data Science: providing resources to students who are interested in data or related fields to succeed in college and in their careers. We provide workshops that provide knowledge to supplement analytical skills needed in the industry and research. We are a student-run organization ultimately dedicated to the community of UCI and Orange County.

name: Dean's Ambassadors Council
description: Representing the UCI School of Social Sciences undergraduate students, we strive to promote meaningful interactions between students, faculty, and staff to give back to our Social Sciences community by building a strong progressive environment for our students. Our efforts focus on bringing our community together through various events including: Fall Festivals, Hot Topics Debate, First-Generation Alumni Career Panel, and Dean's Day. In addition, the council operates as the first in-line for assisting in staff events and functions.

name: Delight Ministries at UCI
description: Delight's mission is to invite college women into Christ-centered community that fosters vulnerability and transforms stories.

name: Delta Delta Delta (Tri Delta)
description: The purpose of Delta Delta Delta shall be to establish a perpetual bond of friendship among its members, to develop a stronger and more womanly character, to broaden the moral and intellectual life, and to assist its members in every possible way. It shall also be the purpose of Delta Delta Delta to promote and develop mutually beneficial relationships between the Fraternity and the colleges and universities where the Fraternity has established chapters, to develop qualities of unselfish leadership among its members, and to encourage them to assume, with integrity and devotion to moral and democratic principles, the highest responsibilities of college women.

name: Delta Delta Sigma - Pre-Dental Fraternity
description: The mission of Delta Delta Sigma is to provide students with community service opportunities and guidance towards a career in dentistry.  We aspire to help students build a strong professional foundation with real world, hands-on experiences such as clinical volunteering, mission trips, and health fairs. We urge our members to value the necessity of serving those in underserved communities while also reinforcing academic integrity on the road towards dental school. Members will have the opportunity to network with dental students, alumni, dental professionals, and fellow pre-dentals. Delta Delta Sigma welcomes all students interested in health care professions to attain exposure to the exciting world of dentistry.

name: Delta Epsilon Mu
description: Delta Epsilon Mu is a professional health-interest fraternity at UCI that provides a dynamic educational and social setting for all undergraduates striving toward goals in human and veterinary medicine, pharmacy, dentistry, optometry, nursing, and other health fields.

name: Delta Gamma
description: Delta Gamma offers to women of all ages a rich heritage; continuity based on sound and tested principals of personal integrity, personal responsibility, and intellectual honesty. The object of this Fraternity shall be to foster high ideals of friendship among college women, to promote their educational and cultural interests, to create in them a true sense of social responsibility and to develop in them the best qualities of character.

name: Delta Lambda Chi
description: Delta Lambda Chi aspires to bond dignified individuals who are dedicated to the values of moral excellence and everlasting sisterhood. As we strive to elicit the highest quality in service, leadership, and academic aptitude, we also commit ourselves to experiences that enhance our character and enrich our minds. The memories we share mark an indelible journey through our college years that is symbolic of loyalty, perseverance, and personal achievement. Delta Lambda Chi, Alpha Chapter.   We are founded on February 9, 2002, at the University of California, Irvine. Our motto is "reach for the stars but remain down to earth."

name: Delta Sigma Pi
description: Delta Sigma Pi is a professional fraternity organized to foster the study of business in universities; to encourage scholarship, social activity and the association of students for their mutual advancement by research and practice; to promote closer affiliation between the commercial world and students of commerce, and to further a higher standard of commercial ethics and culture and the civic and commercial welfare of the community.

name: Delta Sigma Theta Sorority Inc.
description: Delta Sigma Theta Sorority, Inc. was founded on January 13, 1913, on the campus of Howard University by twenty-two collegiate women that wanted to use their collective strengths to promote academic excellence and provide assistance to those in need. The Founders of Delta Sigma Theta envisioned an organization committed to sisterhood, scholarship, service, and addressing the social issues of the time. Since its founding, Delta Sigma Theta has become one of the preeminent service-based sororities, with more than 350,000 initiated members and over 1,050 chartered chapters worldwide. In March of 1913, Delta Sigma Theta performed their first of public service by participating in the Women's Suffrage March in Washington D.C. The Xi Omega Chapter was chartered on the UCI campus on May 31, 1980, by fifteen remarkable women. Since its inception, the chapter, consisting of women of higher character, integrity and great accomplishments, has been actively participating in service aimed at the advancement of the African American community. Historically, some of our service includes voter registration drive, educational workshops, cultural awareness workshops, and annual scholarship donations.

name: Demography and Social Analysis MA Program
description: Demography is the scientific study of human population. Because personal behavior "scales up" into population trends, and population trends "scale down" to impact individuals, demography touches all facets of life. This makes demography a versatile tool for analyzing a broad range of social and economic issues. Irvine's Concentration in Demographic and Social Analysis (DASA) offers graduate training in the practical research skills needed to address analytical problems confronting society, business, government, and the nonprofit sector.

name: Dental Volunteers
description: The purpose of this organization is to provide volunteer opportunities for pre-health students who wish to participate in volunteer opportunities, with a focus on dental. Our audience will include students, underserved children, older adults in nursing homes, and other underserved communities. Through volunteering, we will also teach our volunteers dental knowledge such as tray setup, dental instruments, dental etiquette, clinical photography, dental school preparation, and more.

name: Department of Anatomy & Neurobiology
description: The Department of Anatomy & Neurobiology at UCI School of Medicine is a world-leading neuroscience department where discoveries at the molecular, anatomical and physiological levelsare seamlessly integrated to the development of new treatments for neurological diseases.

name: Department of Art History
description: Have you ever looked at a photograph, a painting, a building, a sculpture, or even a billboard advertisement and found it so beautiful or perhaps disturbing that you could not take your eyes off it? While art history is for people who find images compelling and historically important, our program also provides skills that go far beyond the appreciation of art.

name: Department of Biomedical Engineering
description: Inspiring Engineering Minds to Advance Human Health

name: Department of Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering
description: The CBE department offers a vibrant academic community for those seeking educational opportunities in chemical and biomolecular engineering. Our mission is to provide a high-quality education in chemical and biological engineering at the undergraduate and graduate levels to prepare future leaders in chemical, material, biochemical  and biomedical industries, and academia. CBE faculty expertise is broad, with active research programs spanning a wide range of investigation. From the development of novel systems that produce biofuels and commodity chemicals for synthesis of materials and pharmaceuticals; to processes and systems that enable sustainable energy storage and conversion; to the development of nano- and biotechnologies for discovery and design of novel active molecules, materials and devices with applications in sustainable energy, sensing and human health. CBE faculty take great care to ensure that students get a quality educational experience, and they receive among the best teaching evaluations in the school.

name: Department of Comparative Literature
description: Internationally renowned for leadership in the field of continental literary theory, Comparative Literature at UCI today is a place of openness and risk—a spacious department, good for thinking, collectivity, and contestation. Our current interests include the possibilities for engaging in politics broadly speaking, for rethinking the present and unmapping a world that seems to be already mapped through disciplinary structures such as area studies, and for interanimating scholarship, teaching, and activism. Faculty, graduate students, and undergraduates work together in our department to push vocabularies, to create new conceptual frames of reference, and to construct different genealogies. Psychoanalysis, phenomenology, subaltern studies, feminism and queer studies, materialism, critical race theory, de/post/neo/and X-coloniality, globalectics: these are a few of the analytic frames that inform our work. Translation broadly applied enables us to make moves: across languages, media, geographic borders, and political visions. While various faculty work with site-specific literatures and film--from Argentina and other Latin American nations, China and Hong Kong, Europe, Iran, Japan, Kenya, the U.S., and other locations--we don't offer these materials as geopolitically fixed archives. Rather, we place cultural practices within dynamic global exchanges, both historical and contemporary. Through courses, conferences, collaborative projects, and digital media, Comparative Literature at UCI advances critical cosmopolitanism—a kind of worldliness cultivated by creative engagements with power, peoples, and their symbolic practices. We invite you to explore our projects and programs, and hope you will find ways to join us in our ventures.

name: Department of Earth System Science
description: To contribute through research and teaching to a fundamental scientific understanding of the Earth as a coupled system, to train the next generation of Earth scientists, and to inform and educate policy makers and the public-at-large. We envision a society that understands the impact of human activities on the global environment and the interactions within the Earth system that preserve the habitability of the planet.

name: Department of East Asian Studies
description: The graduate program in East Asian Studies at UC Irvine emphasizes rigorous training in language and textual analysis, with equal attention given to the historical, social, and theoretical dimensions of literary and cultural studies. In addition to more traditional vocabularies of criticism and theory, the curriculum encourages exploration of recent challenges to establish conceptual and methodological frameworks. The program builds on the foundation of a faculty whose research interests engage major issues in Chinese, Japanese, and Korean literature and culture, while developing connections with the larger community of scholarship at UC Irvine.

name: Department of Ecology and Evolutionary Biology
