The Outreach Project works with a nonprofit organization called Spirit League to help kids with disabilities to play sports; this project also works with Los Alamitos Lestonnac Free Clinic to allow members to gain regular volunteer hours and help an underserved community. Global Actions gives members an opportunity to travel around the world to learn about other culture's medical practices, volunteer at clinics in the Dominican Republic, Peru, India, Panama, Philippines and many other countries. Mentorship is a chance for members to gain one on one interaction with health professionals of their choice and gain valuable insight into the life of a health professional. Along with these five  projects, IMED brings out special guest speakers throughout the year to learn about all the different possibilities of careers in the health care field.    IMED is a pre-health club which encourages all majors to come check us out!

name: Immortals Dance Crew
description: IDC at UCI aims to promote and celebrate the art of dance, with a specific focus on Jazz, K-pop, and Hip-hop genres. The organization's mission is to provide a supportive and creative community for all UCI students interested in dancing, allowing them to exchange skills, learn from each other, and experience the joy of dancing together. IDC at UCI strives to create a welcoming and inclusive environment that fosters personal growth, friendship, and cultural exchange through the art of dance.

name: Improv Revolution
description: Improv Revolution generates creativity, comedy, and community at and around UC Irvine. Through a positive approach to improvisation, we create opportunities for as many people as possible to engage in the community and grow their confidence on stage. We strive to create smart, unifying comedy that is accessible by all. Our core team auditions quarterly, meets weekly, and performs biweekly. We encourage you to come audition! We also offer free workshops, no audition or experience required, on campus every Friday! Anyone is eligible to drop by. Check out our website at www.improvrevolution.org, give us a follow on our Instagram, Twitter, and Facebook pages, @improvrevolution and @irevuci respectively, to stay updated on our workshops, auditions, and performances!

name: In the Green
description: We empower students to promote sustainable and responsible business.

name: Indian Classical Music Club at UCI
description: ICM@UCI's mission is to provide a recurring space for the growth of a vibrant, passionate community of Indian Classical Musicians and Artists at UCI. Through that space, we aspire to collectively bring out the creative and spiritual beauty of the rich Indian Classical Music tradition, furthering our own individual musical journeys, spiritual growth, and ultimately, our lives.  As we develop, we maintain the bold aim to spread awareness and appreciation of this beautiful art form across the UCI campus, engaging in public performances to spread the richness of the Indian Classical Arts beyond its traditional audience.

name: Indian Sub-Continental Club (ISC)
description: The Indian Sub-continental Club (ISC) at University of California, Irvine has been an influential and active student organization for over two decades. The goal of ISC is to unite the students of UC Irvine whose cultural roots come from that of the Indian Sub-continent: Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, the Maldives, Nepal, Pakistan, and Sri Lanka. Every year ISC holds numerous activities to spread cultural awareness and provide a place where students from similar backgrounds can meet and interact. It also provides an environment to stimulate cultural awareness through various ISC-sponsored activities and events, such as our Culture Show, Diwali celebration, and Holi.

name: Indonesian Students at UCI (ISUCI)
description: We are the Indonesian Students at UC Irvine (ISUCI) and we continually strive to create an inclusive social platform for fellow Indonesian students at the University of California, Irvine. Through our numerous events and networking opportunities, we aim to welcome, guide and grow our members while celebrating the diverse Indonesian culture here in Irvine.

name: Industry Pharmacy Organization at UCI
description: The Industry Pharmacy Organization at UCI is dedicated to advancing the careers of industry pharmacists. IPhO at UCI accomplishes this by providing timely and relevant information that is vital to our members. IPhO at UCI also raises awareness among employers and industry executives about the role that industry pharmacists can play in drug development and appropriate medication use. IPhO at UCI provides targeted resources and coaching to enhance members' continuing education and professional development. IPhO at UCI is also critical in creating opportunities for members to network and exchange ideas with their industry pharmacist peers.

name: Information and Computer Sciences
description: The Donald Bren School of Information and Computer Sciences aims for excellence in research and education.Our mission is to lead the innovation of new information and computing technology by fundamental research in the core areas of information and computer sciences and cultivating authentic, cutting-edge research collaborations across the broad range of computing and information application domains as well as studying their economic, commercial and social significance. The diversity of our collaborations serves to reshape domains as far reaching as education, art and entertainment, business and law, the environment and biological systems, health care and medicine. Consistent with our mission, we are committed to ensuring excellence through inclusion, producing a diverse, educated workforce for advancing technology, stimulating the economy and transferring new technology into the public realm to greatly advance quality of life.

name: InfrasCtrl at UCI
description: InfrasCtrl at UCI empowers underrepresented, small, and student-run businesses through technology. Our mission is to design and develop free websites that help entrepreneurs build legitimacy, increase visibility, and access financial opportunities such as grants and loans. By combining website design, social media outreach, and community collaboration, we aim to bridge the digital divide and promote equitable access to digital tools.

name: Innovation Advisors
description: The Innovation Advisor network is a group of local business leaders who volunteer their time to support the development of the UCI Beall Applied Innovation entrepreneurial ecosystem. The goals of the Innovation Advisor network are to increase the likelihood of success of UCI-affiliated ventures by providing insightful and actionable guidance and mentorship to individuals and teams and to foster engagement between the University and the local entrepreneurial community to accelerate the commercialization of University innovations.

name: INSA Dance Team
description: INSA dance is an exhibition open choreography dance team based at UC Irvine. Founded in 2008, our mission is to share our passion and love for dance with the public. As a family, we uphold our values and the name, I Never Stand Alone.

name: Institute for Clinical & Translational Science
description: The UC Irvine Institute for Clinical and Translational Science (ICTS) is funded by the National Institutes of Health (NIH) under the Clinical and Translational Sciences Award (CTSA) program. Currently, there are more than 50 medical research institutions throughout the United States that receive CTSA program funding. The ICTS functions as a local centerpiece for the national program, and is dedicated to advancing scientific discovery and medical breakthroughs. Collectively, our goal is simple: to accelerate these discoveries from the lab and translate them into life-altering medical care.

name: Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers at UCI - IEEE
description: IEEE at UCI is a premier engineering club working at the intersection of electrical engineering, computer engineering, and computer science.  We provide a place for those who are interested in both hardware and software to consistently meet and develop their skills and passions with others.  There are three ways we do this:  The first is our lab and community room at ICS 225, and it is open every day.  The second is the OPS Program (Open Project Space), a year-long extracurricular program designed to teach programming and embedded electronics to eager and willing students, supporting them every step of the way.Lastly, we serve as the gateway to lifelong membership and community with the greater IEEE community from IEEE Orange County, IEEE Region 6, and IEEE International.  Our mission is to ensure those who come to us have a good time, learn a lot, and find IEEE a place they can belong to for life.

name: Institute of Transportation Engineers
description: The Institute of Transportation Engineers is an international educational and scientific association of transportation professionals who are responsible for meeting mobility and safety needs. ITE facilitates the application of technology and scientific principles to research, planning, functional design, implementation, operation, policy development and management for any mode of ground transportation. Through its products and services, ITE promotes professional development of its members, supports and encourages education, stimulates research, develops public awareness programs and serves as a conduit for the exchange of professional information.

name: Intellectual Property Law Society (IPLS)
description: The Intellectual Property Law Society (IPLS) is dedicated to exploring and promoting academic, professional, and industry issues at the intersection of law and intellectual property—including copyright, trademark, patent, trade secret, and related fields. Through engagement with legal professionals, faculty, and peers, IPLS fosters a dynamic and supportive community for students passionate about intellectual property law.

name: InterAxon at UCI
description: Our mission is to teach students of underserved K-12 Title 1 schools in the Orange County area about Neuroscience and STEM topics. We share our enthusiasm for the brain through our unique lessons and demonstrations. We travel to elementary schools, middle schools, and high schools in disadvantaged areas of Orange County to work with students at schools receiving poor funding in the sciences. Our long term goal is to create and foster interest, excitement, and curiosity about the brain.In addition to visiting K-12 students and hosting events on UCI’s campus, InterAxon prides itself on being an all-inclusive, welcoming organization where anyone interested in science and service can join, regardless of major or year. We truly are one big family and we hope you can join us to meet and make life-long friends along the way!

name: Intercollegiate Athletics/Bren Events Center
description: The Bren Events Center is a full-service, multi-functional venue with a reputation of unparalleled standards for quality service.  The cornerstone of its vision is to maintain 100% complete customer satisfaction at every point of contact.  The Center strives to create a memorable and enjoyable experience for all of its clients and guests.

name: Interdepartmental Neuroscience Program Graduate Program
description: Competitive INP candidates will have had a substantial subset courses covering the following topic areas: neuroscience, biology, biochemistry, psychology, physics, calculus, and genetics. Preference will be given to applicants who have had laboratory research experience.We encourage all well qualified applicants to apply, as we're a very competitive program !

name: Interfraternity Council (IFC)
description: The Interfraternity Council (IFC) serves as the self-governing body for the fraternities at the University of California Irvine. It consists of the Executive Board and the Council. The executive board consists of fraternity members who are elected into their positions by the IFC Council. The Council consists of presidents and delegates from each chapter. Every Monday of the academic year the executive board and council convene for formal IFC meeting at 11 am in the Dr. White Room in the Cross-Cultural Center.

name: International Law Forum
description: The International Law Forum at the University of California, Irvine seeks to foster an engaged community of students passionate about global governance, law, and justice. Our mission is to promote scholarly dialogue and collaboration on issues of international law, politics, and policy by providing students with a platform to research, publish, and debate emerging global legal challenges. Through open discussion, educational programming, and interaction with policymakers and practitioners, we aim to cultivate critical thinking, cross-cultural understanding, and professional development for the next generation of global leaders.

name: International Law Society at UCI - ILS
description: The International Law Society (ILS) at UCI is a forum for discussing topics in international law. ILS seeks to contribute to the academic dialogue at UCI and among other law schools through collaborative events, clinical work, and a supportive curriculum.

name: International Student Excellence Programs
description: International Student Excellence Programs promotes excellence among our international student population through a robust peer mentorship program, individual success coaching, access to resources and opportunities to engage with faculty and alumni with the aim of developing global scholars and leaders.Core Services:Manages International Peer Group Scholars Program (IPG) which matches first-year international students with trained peer mentorsCoordinates Global Leaders (GL) which is a research development program for upperclass international studentsProvides internships for Peer Mentors and Mentor Coordinators who receive on-going training and professional developmentProvides academic monitoring and individual academic success coaching/counseling for program participantsProvides IPG and GL Scholars with access to LARC sponsorships, Zot Initiative (SSI) workshops and ISEP programs that promote community and academic excellenceCoordinates the Intercultural Communication at UCI Workshop Series in collaboration with Academic EnglishFacilitates opportunities for international students to interact with Faculty and Alumni and learn about research and scholarship opportunitiesFacilitates an international student leadership seminar

name: International Student Gathering
description: ISG is an official Christian student group at UC Irvine. We welcome all students: undergraduate and graduate, Christian and non-Christian, and especially international students.  The students in our group come from many countries around the world, including the United States. Our mission is to "love locally, impact globally," in which we seek to create a "home away from home" for students studying in Irvine. We offer weekly Bible studies, as well as special talks and lectures on topics such as the relationship between Science and Faith, evidence for the existence of God, the problem of suffering, and others. We also offer English classes, small group gatherings, fun trips around the SoCal area.

name: InterVarsity Christian Fellowship (IVCF)
description: We are a student-led movement committed to actively pursuing Jesus Christ as a witnessing community.

name: Iranian Student Union (ISU)
description: Iranian Student Union is a campus organization at the University of California, Irvine. ISU hopes to unify Iranian students of UC Irvine in order to form an educational and social environment where Iranians can embrace their culture and history. With UCI located in the most heavily populated Persian community outside of Iran, we hope to spread awareness of our traditions through cultural and social events. Our group aims to bring together Iranian-Americans and non-Iranians alike, to celebrate and embrace our lavish heritage while promoting a strong sense of identity and community. We host many culture nights, charity events, and fundraisers throughout the year, culminating in our annual culture show.

name: Iraqi Student Association
description: The Iraqi Student Association serves as a home for all students to connectand share the rich heritage of Iraq. Our mission is to foster a unified, inclusive environmentthat celebrates the beauty and diversity of Iraqi culture.

name: Irvine Barclay Theatre
description: The mission of Irvine Barclay Theatre is to be a leading cultural presenter featuring the work of diverse and exceptional artists and providing a state-of-the-art venue for community cultural organizations and university programs, thus broadening the scope, availability and appreciation of the performing arts in Orange County.

name: Irvine Chess Club
description: Hello! We're the Irvine Chess Club. Join us to meet and play with fellow chess players from UCI! Beginners, intermediate players, and experts are all welcome. Feel free to check out our discord where we post club announcements, host tournaments, and play/discuss chess: https://discord.gg/dbHGrZYxBp

name: Irvine Consulting Group
description: At Irvine Consulting Group, we are a dynamic team of driven andinnovative students from UC Irvine, united by a shared commitment to bridging the gapbetween academic knowledge and real-world impact. Founded on the vision of makingconsulting accessible to all, ICG provides hands-on client engagements, resources,and professional development opportunities to help students excel in consulting andbeyond.

name: Irvine Hacker Fab
description: The Irvine Hacker Fab is an interdisciplinary engineering student organization aiming to democratize access to semiconductor fabrication through the development of open-source tools and software.

name: Irvine Investment and Trading Group
description: Our mission at Irvine Investment and Trading Group (Irvine ITG) is to empower students with the technical capacities necessary for success in the financial industry. We strive to provide a comprehensive and practical learning experience, tailored to the needs of our members, that will prepare them for their personal and professional ambitions.With a focus on real-world applications and industry-specific knowledge, our development program and specialized sessions offer a unique opportunity to broaden perspectives and deepen understanding of finance as a whole. Through networking events and an inclusive community, we aim to inspire and support our members on their journey to becoming leaders in the financial sector.

name: Italian Studies
description: Teaching and promoting the language and culture of Italy.

name: Ivy Sound at UCI
description: Ivy Sound at UCI is a music-based organization open to all students who are passionate about any aspect of the music industry—whether they aspire to be producers, artists, managers, marketers, audio engineers, music lawyers, or entrepreneurs. Our purpose is to create a space where creativity, collaboration, and ambition come together to help students turn their ideas into reality within the music industry.We aim to empower students to think entrepreneurially, explore their artistic and business potential, and gain hands-on experience that connects them to real opportunities in the music world. Through workshops, showcases, collaborative projects, and social events, Ivy Sound builds a vibrant community where members can grow their skills, form valuable relationships, and have fun in the process.In the short term, our goal is to establish a strong creative network on campus that brings together musically minded students from all majors and backgrounds. In the long term, Ivy Sound seeks to become the central hub for student-driven music innovation at UCI—bridging the gap between campus creators and the larger entertainment industry.

name: J-Fashion Club at UCI
description: J-Fashion Club at UCI is a student-run organization that welcomes undergraduate and graduate students to participate and learn about a variety of different Japanese fashion subcultures. Jfashion Club’s goal is to create a safe space for individuals of all genders, racial, and geographic backgrounds to feel comfortable with freely expressing who they are through makeup and fashion.

name: Japanese Student Association (JSA)
description: The Japanese Student Association at UCI is a multicultural social club dedicated to the exchange of Japanese and American cultures. Here, students have the opportunity to make new intercollegiate friends, celebrate the extensive world of Japanese culture, and even access career opportunities in Japan.

name: Jazz Co-lab
description: The Jazz Co-lab Club at University of California, Irvine (UCI) is dedicated to cultivating a vibrant and inclusive community of dancers and musicians from all majors. Our mission is to foster the art of improvisational jazz dance, nurturing creativity, and igniting the joy of movement among our members. With the dedication and passion of our team, the club envisions becoming a prominent force for artistic expression, creativity, and community engagement within UCI. Our aspiration is to both inspire and be inspired, creating a legacy of rhythm, movement, and unity that transcends boundaries and enriches the lives of all who embark on this dance journey.Together, we dance to the symphony of spontaneity, forging bonds and moving harmoniously towards a future where the echoes of improvisational jazz music resonate through generations. While the concept of live music paired with live dance is as ancient as time itself, the notion of "jazz" took root in the nourishing embrace of the African diaspora. This communal evolution found its initial resonance in the vibrant spaces of New Orleans and Harlem during the 1920s, embodied by the likes of Whitey's Lindy Hoppers and Chick Webb's Orchestra.

name: Jericho House of Prayer
description: JHOP is the contending House of Prayer for the UCI campus and the city of Irvine. We believe that prayer is key to seeing God move in our personal lives and our community. Further, in prayer, we receive God's heart for our community and the grace to be His light and love to those around us. We can't do anything apart from God, and through prayer, we learn to abide in and partner with Him. Our long-term vision is to establish a 24-7 house of prayer and worship in Irvine from which evangelism and outreach will flow.

name: Jewish Law Association
description: MISSION STATEMENT  The Jewish Law Association (JLA) is dedicated to:   -Facilitating meaningful connections between Jewish law students  -Organizing events for the benefit of the membership and the law school community as a whole  -Fostering outreach with the Orange County Jewish legal community  -Exploring the unique legal and cultural aspects of Judaism  -Providing opportunities for tikkun olam (social action)    Membership is open to all current law students, regardless of individual religious affiliation.

name: Jodaiko (Taiko Drumming Ensemble)
description: Jodaiko is a collegiate taiko group from the main campus of the University of California, Irvine. Now in its 34th year since inception, Jodaiko brings the Japanese art of taiko to UCI and the rest of Southern California. The word "Jodaiko" means "passionate drumming" in Japanese, and as a collegiate taiko group, each member must balance their passion for taiko with their desire to pursue an education. Jodaiko takes pride in the diverse cultures, areas of study, and performance experiences each member represents.

name: Judo Club at UCI
description: Our mission is to promote the art of Judo by fostering physical fitness, mental discipline, andcamaraderie, while cultivating respect, resilience, and continuous personal growth within asupportive university community.

name: Jugger at UCI
description: Jugger at UCI exists to provide a space in which UCI students can learn, teach, play, and participate in the sport known as “Jugger”.  This space is meant to form a long-term community in the Irvine area around the sport jugger, as well as providing a new space for socialization and team building.  Jugger at UCI will engage in community outreach to foster engagement and engage students for tournaments and events held around the U.S.

name: Kaba Modern
description: Kaba Modern is a collegiate dance group founded in 1992 by Arnel Calvario. As a proud part of the Filipino-American club, Kababayan, he established the group to perform in various events, such as Philipino Cultural Night and others. As Kaba Modern enters its thirtieth season, we hope to become an official organization on UCI's campus in order to connect with students as well as others in the community. "We are a family of creatives existing to foster a safe and inclusive space for artistic expression, interpersonal connection, & self-discovery. Through collective artistry, dance education, & enriching events, we aim to bridge and positively impact diverse communities, honor the history and heritage of the art forms we practice, & promote intentional movement."

name: Kababayan (Kaba)
description: Kababayan at UCI promotes awareness and enrichment of the Pilipinx/Pilipinx-American culture, tradition and heritage. As a student organization, Kababayan emphasizes the social, cultural, political, academic and community aspects of the Pilipinx/Pilipinx-American experience.

name: Kappa Alpha Psi Fraternity Incorporated
description: Achievement in Every Field of Human Endeavor

name: Kappa Alpha Theta (Theta)
description: Yesterday, today, and tomorrow, Kappa Alpha Theta exists to nurture each member throughout her college and alumnae experience and to offer a lifelong opportunity for social, intellectual and moral growth as she meets the higher and broader demands of mature life.

name: Kappa Sigma (Kappa Sig)
description: The Fraternity should complement and enhance the educational mission of the University of California, Irvine. It is committed to fostering a close cooperative partnership with our school. The Fraternity should promote academic achievement and assist each member in achieving his academic potential. By helping members adjust to the college environment, it helps them pursue their degree goals. Co-curricular activities are valuable alongside classroom experience, so the Fraternity encourages involvement in all aspects of campus life.The Fraternity promotes the ideal of Brotherhood. Creating lifelong friendships is a primary benefit of membership. It fulfills the need to belong to an extended family and often strengthens those personal relationships through shared living situations. Members are expected to care about the welfare of their brothers. Brotherhood is a lifetime commitment, and strong alumni-undergraduate relationships are encouraged for the benefit of both groups.

name: Keebs Club at UCI
description: Help others how you wish you were helped.

name: Kendo Club at UCI
description: Kendo Club at UCI practices the traditional martial art of Kendo: one which practitioners use a wooden sword to strike others. Here, students learn, train, and compete with others at intercollegiate tournaments. Kendo club aims to train body, mind, and character through the way of the sword.

name: KKAP K-pop Dance Team
description: Û╣Ø KKAP K-pop Dance Team, or KKAP, is a dance team composed of a diverse group of people who share a mutual love for K-pop. We strive to create an inclusive and encouraging space where dancers of all levels can learn and express their passion for K-pop through dance.

name: Klesis
description: Klesis is a Christian club at UC Irvine. Klesis welcomes those with a church background as well as people simply interested in talking about spiritual topics, as we believe that college is perfect time to investigate the bigger questions of life and the Christian worldview, and to discover who God is and who He calls us to be. We're also pros when it comes to food, mentorship, growth opportunities, and discipleship. We also love having fun and developing close friendships that can last a lifetime.

name: Korean American Student Association (KASA)
description: The Korean American Student Association at University of California Irvine promotes student involvement in the social, academic, political, and community service aspects of the Korean American community. Our goal is to create a friendly, comfortable, and educational environment for Korean American students.

name: Korean Health Association (KHA)
description: Korean Health Association (KHA) was established back in 1986 for both international and American students at the University of California, Irvine, to serve the following purposes: (1) Offer assistance and consultation to students regarding their future education/career goals. (2) Enable students to help one another reach their education/career goals through various academic and emotional support. (3) Assist students in achieving successful academic endeavors in undergraduate studies. (4) Encourage peer counseling and tutoring among students. (5) Enable students to meet one another. Although KHA concentrates on the members' academic concerns, it also provides opportunities for them to develop life-lasting friendships.

name: Korean-American Scientists and Engineers Association
description: To provide, in the areas of science, technology and entrepreneurship, opportunities for:- International Cooperation- Career Development- Community Service

name: Kristos Campus Missions (formerly Korean-American Campus Mission)
description: A Christian ministry to show the love of Christ on UCI and to the ends of the world. To obey the Great Commission by discipling and mobilizing collegians.

name: La Familia de UCI
description: The purpose of this organization is to increase the retention and graduation rate of the Latine community at UCI, provide a safe space to unpack cultural stigmas and traumas, as well as provide resources to help navigate UCI. This will be achieved through Our Valores: [Goodness], Cultural celebration, and Our Stories. The above-mentioned shall serve as the foundational core values that La Familia will abide by to create a home-away-from-home and create an environment for students to create a chosen family in this new home. This will consist of creating a space of support on campus and a memorable salient time with an emphasis on breaking down stereotypes and prejudices associated with being a person of Latine origin. As we build a home, we strive to address the adversities and hardships from college experiences that Latine face, which this organization will push Latine to work for. This organization will provide resources and reach out to the Hispanic/Latine community. We will serve as an avenue for networking and providing members with enrichment in academics, community service, and social networking-initiated, events, fundraisers, debates/discussions, and functions that have been voted for and or will be voted for by club members during an official club meeting. This will be achieved through Our Valores: Community, Cultural Celebration, and Our Stories. The above-mentioned shall serve as the foundational core values that La Familia will abide by to create a home-away-from-home and create an environment for students to create a chosen family in this new home

name: La Unidad Latina, Lambda Upsilon Lambda Fraternity, Inc.
description: La Unidad Latina, Lambda Upsilon Lambda Fraternity, Incorporated primarily seeks to take a leadership role in meeting the needs of the Latino community through academic achievement, cultural awareness, community service and promotion of the Latino culture and people.

name: Labor and Work Law Society
description: The purpose of the Labor and Work Law Society is to educate members in labor and employment law, as well as the attorney and advocate's role in furthering the advancement of workers' rights nationally and globally; to provide plaintiff and management-side networking opportunities to members; and to engage in solidarity through action to advocate for the dignity of all workers.

name: Lambda Phi Nu
description: Founded at UCI, Lambda Phi Nu is a co-ed business leadership fraternity dedicated to igniting leaders, illuminating communities, and inspiring legacies on and off campus. Our fraternity helps individuals develop an excellent sense of professionalism and social responsibility while upholding high standards of academic excellence. We strive to guide our members toward success in their careers and build upon their commitment to bettering their community. We aim to create an environment for students to develop their leadership potential, grow their understanding of various industries and pathways, and accomplish their goals. At the intersection of business and brotherhood, Lambda Phi Nu cultivates a community for students to be and belong.

name: Lambda Theta Delta
description: Lambda Theta Delta is the only officially recognized Asian American interest fraternity at the University of California Irvine. Founded on March 2, 1983, Lambda Theta Delta is the first and largest Asian-American interest fraternity at UCI.Since its inception at the University of California, Irvine over three decades ago, Lambda Theta Delta has initiated over 1000 members and has become one of the most influential local student organizations in Southern California.Although Lambda Theta Delta is an Asian American fraternity, individuals from all ethnic backgrounds are welcome to join. LTD stays true to its roots by continuing to promote Asian American interests and giving back to the community, while maintaining the strongest and most diverse brotherhood that simply cannot be paralleled.

name: Land Use and Real Estate Law Society
description: The Land Use and Real Estate Society is dedicated to fostering a dynamic and inclusive environment for students interested in the legal frameworks that shape real estate law, real estate development, and land use regulation. Through speaker events, networking sessions, and career-focused workshops, we expose students to the diverse pathways available within real estate law—from transactional work and litigation to zoning and urban planning. Our mission is to equip future attorneys with the knowledge, connections, and confidence to thrive in a complex and evolving legal landscape.

name: Language and Linguistics Club (formerly Syntax PROs)
description: The mission of Language and Linguistics Club is to expose members of the UC Irvine community to the beauty and science of language and its interactions with culture and history. We seek to create an open space for students to discuss any topics in the field of linguistics, from their social impacts to the underlying syntactic structures. The events associated with our club will emphasize linguistic and cultural diversity as well as an increased awareness of the underlying grammatical structures and features of languages other than English.

name: Language Science
description: Department of Language Science

name: Latina Empowerment and Development at UCI
description: Our mission is to empower Latina students and their allies at UCI by connecting them with professional, academic, and leadership opportunities through the Harvard Latina Empowerment and Development (LEAD) network. Our goals include promoting mentorship, access to internships, leadership development, and participation in the annual LEAD Conference hosted at Harvard University. Through these efforts, the LEAD Chapter at UCI aims to create a lasting impact on campus by equipping students with the tools, connections, and confidence to lead and succeed in their chosen fields, while embodying the values of empowerment, education, and community.

name: Latines In Pharmaceutical Sciences at UCI
description: LIPS at UCI will change lives by offering a space and community where Hispanic and other underrepresented/marginalized groups can express themselves and develop leadership and technical skills through opportunities and community support.

name: Latino Business Student Association (LBSA)
description: The Latino Business Student Association is a student-run non-profit organization established in 2003. The purpose of LBSA is to assist its members from various ethnic backgrounds and fields of studies at UCI, to pursue professional skills and careers while raising awareness of the Latinx culture. The organization accomplishes this by focusing on its three pillars: Professional Development, Social Interaction, and Community Service, with a foundation on Academic Achievement.

name: Latino Medical Student Association (LMSA)
description: LMSA recruits and supports individuals in healthcare professions who will strive to improve access to and delivery of healthcare to Latin@s and medically underserved populations.

name: Latinx Law Student Association
description: The Latinx Law Students Association (LLSA) at UCI Law is an all-inclusive organization that is open to any student, regardless of racial or ethnic identification. As law students at the only public law school in Orange County, an area in which the largest ethnic minority group is Latinx, we believe it is particularly important to address the many issues that affect Latinx people at both an institutional level and in the community. Our mission is to confront these issues through community service, mentorship, coalition building, and networking.

name: Latinx Resource Center
description: The Latinx Resource Center (LRC) was founded in 2019 to raise awareness of social, political, economic, historical and cultural realities of the Latinx and Chicanx communities. We accomplish this mission by offering resources, programs, and a space where cultura, arte and academia are interconnected. Our vision is that these efforts will broaden access, increase retention and ensure a clear pathway to graduation through the empowerment of Latinx and Chicanx students.

name: Latinx Student Psychological Association
description: The Latinx Student Psychological Association (LSPA) is committed to providing a multifaceted awareness of both professional and educational resources to enhance the college experiences of dedicated students aspiring to serve underrepresented communities in the mental health arena.   **LSPA is open to all majors and racial/ethnic backgrounds**    LSPA's Mission is to:  Part 1. To facilitate the professional and career development of aspiring psychologists and other service providers who desire an education beyond the baccalaureate degree. Part 2. To assist undergraduates to develop a sense of community, highlighting the value of serving the Latina/o communities and other underserved groups. Part 3. To promote students' educational experiences and expand multicultural awareness and training in the field of psychology.  Part 4. To build a connection between undergraduate students, faculty/ staff, and community leaders, establishing a strong social network, both on and off campus.     Philosophy:  The association will emphasize the value of academics, research, practical experience, leadership, and community service for a complete undergraduate experience. In addition, the cabinet recognizes the value of the five elements for the successful application of graduate school. Through programming, dialogues, workshops and other educational activities, LSPA aspires to assist students to acquire a comprehensive education while attending to the five pillars throughout their experience at UC Irvine.

name: Law Students for Educational Equity at UCI Law
description: LSEE aims to expose law students interested in practicing education law or becoming law school professors/administrators to the necessary resources to succeed.

name: Law Students for Justice in Palestine
description: The purpose of this organization shall be to serve as a hub, on UCI Law’s campus, for education, discussion, and activism in support of the Palestinian right to self-determination, justice, and equality.

name: League of United Latin American Citizens (LULAC) at UCI
description: The Mission of the League of United Latin American Citizens at UCI is to advance the economic condition, educational attainment, political influence, housing, health and civil rights of the Hispanic population of the United States.

name: Learning & Academic Resource Center
description: LARC's mission is to advance academic success through proven active learning strategies, peer-to-peer collaboration, campus partnerships and leadership development.   LARC connects "what to learn" with "how to learn" in a student-centered, collaborative learning experience.

name: Lebanese Social Club
description: The goal of this club is to:  A. To promote the interests of the Lebanese and non-Lebanese students at UC Irvine.  B. To acquaint the UCI community with Lebanon and the Lebanese people, and to promote their culture.           C. To help Lebanese students integrate better into the diverse UCI community by creating an atmosphere of friendship & support.   D. To form a closely knit community on campus.

name: Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender Resource Center (LGBTRC)
description: The UCI Lesbian Gay Bisexual Transgender Resource Center provides a wide range of education and advocacy services supporting intersectional identity development. We foster community, wellness, an open and inclusive environment for lesbian, gay, bisexual, intersex, transgender, queer, asexual, ally, and questioning students, faculty, staff, and the larger campus community. We strive to develop an atmosphere of acceptance and wellbeing in which the campus community can support the academic mission of the university.

name: Leukemia and Lymphoma Society at UCI
description: The Leukemia and Lymphoma Society at UCI is a national organization dedicated to curing leukemia, lymphoma, Hodgkin’s disease and myeloma, and improving the quality of life of patients and their families. LLS at UCI’s mission is to provide a forum for discussion, education, awareness, funding, and support of our shared interest in making an impact in the fight against blood cancer. As well as to provide a place to participate in various interactions such as; service, advocacy efforts, education, fundraising and facilitating events tailored to our organizational interests.

name: Level V Origins
description: Level V Origins is an exhibition dance team that exists to provide the opportunity for those who have never had previous dance experience to explore different forms of dance. Our goal is to develop and hone leadership skills through our shared passion for dance.

name: Liberty Campus Connect at UCI
description: Knowing God and making Him known through Bible study, worship, and Christ-centered community.

name: LikeLion at UCI
description: Our mission is to introduce the fundamentals of coding and programming to students and provide them with hands-on learning, as well as industry experience for the more advanced coders. With the vast library of online LikeLion lectures, we are planning to provide lessons on various fields of coding, including python, java, and UI-UX and general front-end coding. For the members with prior coding background, we will push them to develop projects in a real-world settings to prepare them for the tech industry.

name: Living Stone Christian Fellowship
description: At Living Stone Christian Fellowship, Cantonese is our heart language: LSFers come from wherever Cantonese is spoken! Each year of LSF has a different flavor, contributed by each person's unique story, gifts, pain, brokenness, and dreams. But our focus on Jesus remains the same. We envision LSF to be a safe space for college students (including seekers with questions about faith) to grow in identity, character, and life purpose via experiencing Christ-centered community.

name: Living Water College Ministry
description: Living Water College Ministry is a Mandarin college ministry that exists to love God and love people. Our mission is to share the Gospel and to grow relationships in God and fellowship. We desire to learn and study the Word through Bible study, sermon discussion, and prayer.

name: Long US-China Institute
description: THE LONG U.S.-CHINA INSTITUTE IS DEDICATED TO STUDYING CONTEMPORARY CHINESE SOCIETY, POLITICS, AND CULTURE BY SITUATING CHINA IN HISTORICAL, GLOBAL, AND COMPARATIVE PERSPECTIVE.In the interest of fostering bilateral engagement between China and the U.S., we support scholarship and events that facilitate mutual understanding and that highlight a diversity of voices and disciplinary approaches. We are particularly interested in bridging the gaps between academia, journalism, and the public sector. The Long Institute is additionally dedicated to making knowledge about China accessible to wide audiences. We emphasize public scholarship and are keen to highlight new and emerging voices by supporting graduate student work.

name: Made with Love at UCI
description: Made with Love focuses on organizing craft-based activities in order to give meaningful donations back to the community. We are not only passionate about crafting but also being able to craft with a purpose! We strive to promote self-compassion and compassion for others, while at the same time, bringing awareness to certain issues that have an impact in our own community.

name: MAES Latinos in Science and Engineering
description: To encourage Latinos in STEM and promote unity while developing them as better students, leaders, and professionals.

name: Magic and More at UCI
description: Mission Statement: To foster a community where magic can be taught, learned, and discovered.

name: Magic The Gathering Club at UCI
description: Students who meet to enjoy their mutual love of the Magic: the Gathering card game.We meet in the West Food Court on Tuesdays and Thursdays from 6-10 pm.Make sure to check out our discord (https://www.discord.gg/XMtau5Xu2A) to get the latest information on the club.

name: Management Information Student Society at UCI - MAISS
description: Management Information Student Society's mission revolves around strengthening the business and technology community at UC Irvine. They are an organization with a tight-knit community of students who focus on building themselves professionally. In addition to having a mentorship program and going on retreats, they also code, apply to internships, and get food together! The way that MAISS differentiates itself from other organizations on campus is by having business and tech-related workshops such as intro to SQL/Product Management and tech/non-tech recruitment, and company events from Zillow, Twitter, Visa, and more!

name: Manifest
description: The purpose of Manifest is to create a community of success and result-driven entrepreneurs by focusing on fostering business education among the members. The organization further aims to encourage start-up building by spreading the right entrepreneurial mindset and the motivation to solve real-life market problems by leveraging each other's competencies and sharing of skills.

name: Mariachi Orgullo De UCI
description: MODUCI empowers musicians to continue to show their mexican heritage through Mariachi music fostering appreciation and understanding of cultures within our campus community.

name: Mariners at UCI
description: Mariners at UCI exists to see college-aged students fearlessly change the world.

name: Marketing Association (MA)
description: Established in 2013, the Marketing Association has dedicated itself towards developing the marketing community at the University of California, Irvine. Our diverse and growing organization welcomes Anteaters from all majors and academic levels with a passion or interest in marketing. Together, we aspire to become the forefront of the undergraduate marketing community on campus and in Orange County.

name: Master of Advanced Study in Criminology, Law & Society Program
description: The online Master of Advanced Study (MAS) in Criminology, Law and Society prepares graduates for leadership positions in a range of fields such as corrections, law enforcement, social services, probation/parole, and a variety of public administrative roles. Students graduating from this program are positioned for career advancement as well as further academic endeavors. Ranked #1 for two years in a row by U.S. News & World Report.

name: Master of Computer Science
description: The Master of Computer Science (MCS) is a full-time, 15-month professionally-oriented degree with strong emphases on practical applications and implementation.

name: Master of Embedded & Cyber-physical Systems
description: The Professional Master of Embedded and Cyber-physical Systems (MECPS) is designed to train students in the foundation, skills and hands-on practices of embedded computer and cyber-physical systems design, optimization and evaluation.

name: Master of English Program
description: Master of English ProgramThe Department of English at the University of California, Irvine offers a Master of English program that allows students to pursue their interest in literary and cultural study.  Many of our students are teachers themselves, especially at the junior high and high school level; we also welcome mature students who wish to strengthen their command of literature and hone their skills in critical analysis and communication.  The degree will be of value to those seeking to extend their knowledge and develop their professional expertise; those seeking preparation to enter the teaching profession (including at the community college level); and to those seeking training in critical thinking and communication skills, whether for application in professions other than teaching, as preparation for further graduate studies in the field, or simply out of intellectual curiosity.The program's curriculum reflects UC Irvine's strengths in literary history and criticism, composition and rhetoric, and literary journalism.  Master of English students work closely with the same faculty who teach in our nationally ranked English Ph.D. program, take seminars dedicated exclusively to them, and receive the same MA degree as the department's full-time graduate students, with the exception that foreign language proficiency is not required for the terminal degree.We assume that many students in the program will have full-time employment, and the program is thus optimally designed for part-time enrollment.  Approximately 20 students are admitted each year.  The limited enrollment is intended to ensure small classes and accessible faculty - the essential conditions for intensive literary study.

name: Master of Legal & Forensic Psychology Program
description: The Online Master of Legal and Forensic Psychology (MLFP) program focuses on the intersection of psychology and legal issues, with an emphasis on the use of psychological principles, theories and research to better understand legal processes and systems. One of the strengths of the program is it promotes an interdisciplinary environment devoted to advancing scholarship, testing theories and engaging in public service. Specifically, the program works collaboratively with the Center for Psychology and Law, offering students insightful events and educational opportunities.

name: Master of Public Health (MPH) Program
description: The UC Irvine Master of Public Health (M.P.H.) was established in 2010 as the first professional degree of the Department of Population Health and Disease Prevention, and as an essential component of an envisioned School of Population Health at UC Irvine. The mission of the UC Irvine M.P.H. is to create public health practitioners who are trained to work independently and collaboratively to develop and implement effective strategies to reduce the burden of disease and disability in culturally diverse communities in Southern California and around the world. The MPH curriculum educates students in the global dimensions of public health principles and prepares them to lead and work collaboratively on the assessment of health-risk factors and the management of prevention strategies. In 2012, following a rigorous self-study process and a site visit by experts in the field, the M.P.H. program was accredited by the Council on Education for Public Health (www.ceph.org).

name: Master of Public Policy Program
description: The Master of Public Policy (MPP) program educates the next generation of public policy experts and practitioners to meet the unique challenges of the 21st century. The MPP program prepares graduates for careers analyzing, developing, and advocating for policy solutions. Under the mentorship of top-notch faculty – who are themselves important voices in the local, national and international policy community – graduates of the program hone their basic and applied research skills, sharpen their ability to communicate effectively in the policy world, and tackle some of the most pressing problems in our global society.

name: Master of Urban and Regional Planning
description: The Master of Urban and Regional Planning (MURP) program is a two-year professional degree program, fully accredited by the Planning Accreditation Board (PAB), with an "exemplary record" of curriculum, teaching, and services in the most recent accreditation review (2013-2014). UCI's MURP is consistently ranked as one of the nation's top professional planning programs. We educate aspiring planning professionals to develop and implement equitable strategies to address complex challenges within a diverse society, translate planning knowledge to improve well-being, and engage communities to build a just and sustainable future."

name: Masters in Conservation and Restoration Science
description: The mission of the MCRS Program is to prepare leaders in the fields of environmental science, conservation, restoration, and sustainability by engaging them in active adaptive management experiences.Active adaptive management refers to the process of managing natural resources by (1) collaboratively developing a model for how the system works; (2) developing trials with replication and controls to experimentally evaluate multiple management actions; and (3) modifying future management activities based on results. The idea of active adaptive management provides a coherent link between coursework, fieldwork, and the capstone project.

name: Masters of Science Degree in Biotechnology
description: Biotechnology education

name: Materials Science Club at UCI
description: MatSci@UCI is an academic resource that offers information and networking opportunities to students, who are working, studying, or interested in the field of Materials Science. We provide information about the broad application of Materials Science through detailed presentation in the various fields of engineering and industry. With the participation of upperclassmen, guest speakers, and faculty, we provide a social environment for students to network and utilize their academic resources at UC Irvine.

name: Math Finance Club at UCI - MFC
description: This organization strives to recruit highly quantitative students across campus with the purpose of fostering an interest in Finance and providing a medium for members to navigate their way into the industry.

name: Math Students Federation at UCI
description: A Math students federation provides Lower Level Math courses review session and activities.

name: Mathematical, Computational, and Systems Biology Graduate Program
description: The goal of UCI's program in Mathematical, Computational and Systems Biology (MCSB) is to provide students from a variety of educational backgrounds with Ph.D. training suitable for research careers in the nascent field of Systems Biology. The program emphasizes in-depth classroom study, interdisciplinary research rotations, and individualized advising.

name: Medical Educational Missions & Outreach
description: As the UCI branch of M.E.M.O. (Medical, Educational Missions and Outreach), a 501(c)(3) non-profit, student-run, humanitarian organization that seeks to serve the underprivileged by addressing their medical and educational needs, we raise money and medical supplies to send back to Vietnam. As a whole organization, we are composed of volunteers, students, physicians, and other health professionals. Of the group of volunteers, students from UCI have the opportunity to travel to Vietnam to witness the beautiful impact our help provides. At UCI, M.E.M.O.’s primary goal is to provide medical care and educational opportunities to the underserved in Vietnam and the local community of Southern California. By supplying the underserved with the fundamental needs (health and education) deprived of them by poverty, M.E.M.O. hopes to give them a foundation in which they can raise themselves out of their current living conditions. M.E.M.O. also aims to spread awareness of the abject poverty seen in third world countries to the younger generation in the U.S. to propagate the notion of social responsibility into a brighter future.

name: Medical Equality Operative
description: MÈO aims to enhance access to healthcare within Limited English Proficiency (LEP) Asian communities in the Orange County area. Asian-American communities face unique challenges in accessing healthcare due to their diverse ethnic groups, cultures. With the largest Vietnamese population outside of Vietnam, Orange County has a significant need for culturally and linguistically proficient liaisons to reduce the barriers faced by this community.

name: Medical Experience Though Service in Healthcare
description: MESH at UCI is a student-run organization dedicated to supporting non-profit health clinics in optimizing their services while providing students with the opportunity to gain firsthand exposure to various aspects of the medical field as they pursue careers in healthcare. In addition, MESH collaborates with a range of healthcare-focused non-profit organizations to improve access and resources for underserved communities. The organization seeks to serve as a bridge between understaffed free clinics and UCI students eager to volunteer, while extending its support to non-profit health organizations both locally and globally. By encouraging student participation in health-related service activities, MESH works to raise awareness of the healthcare needs of low-income communities and to equip its members with the leadership and professional experience necessary to make a meaningful impact.

name: Medical Marvels at UCI
description: Medical Marvels at UC Irvine is a chapter of the international pre-health nonprofit Medical Marvels that offers students a community for professional growth and medical exposure.

name: Medics in Armenia - MIA
description: Medics in Armenia is a student organization at UCI. It is meant to educate and train students that are interested and/or are pursing a future in medicine by traveling to Armenia to shadow medical professionals and volunteer at impoverished communities across Armenia. This organization also hopes to guide students in establishing significant connections with those in the medical field by holding meetings throughout the school year with guest speakers such as medical professionals.

name: MEDLIFE
description: MEDLIFE strives to deliver aid to local communities as well as provide for communities abroad in underdeveloped countries including Peru, Ecuador, Tanzania and others that are in dire need of medical aid. With the help of volunteers and MEDLIFE Mobile Clinics, we can deliver primary care services to individuals and families who otherwise lack access, as MEDLIFE believes that access to quality healthcare is a basic human right. MEDLIFE @ UC Irvine plans to give back not only to the local community, but also to international communities in need through volunteer-based service trips.

name: Men's Club Volleyball at UCI
description: The men's club volleyball team at UCI consists of athletes who are passionate about the sport and seek to compete at a high level. We hold our members to high expectations and full commitment as our goal is to represent UCI with honor and pride. The team competes in the SCCVL and other tournaments around the country. We also aim to provide a competitive environment for men to learn and grow in the sport of volleyball, build a brotherhood and friendships that are sustained on and off the court, maintain the legacy that had been established by dedicated members of this program, and compete at the highest level for this sport and hold each other accountable.

name: Men's Club Water Polo at UCI
description: Water polo is a competitive sport in which a team uses their athletic, cognitive, and collaborative skills to beat out their competition. The Men's Club Water Polo at UCI is dedicated to playing a smarter and stronger game. We welcome any dedicated player who wishes to continue their polo career past high school. We are a club that will have fun playing the game we love while working hard and meeting a group of interesting and fun people. New players are always welcome as well!

name: Men's Lacrosse Club at UCI
description: Men's Lacrosse Club at UCI is the official Club lacrosse team for the campus. We compete in the Men's Collegiate Lacrosse Association or MCLA. We are a part of the associations Southern Lacrosse Conference which is arguably the most competitive conference in the association.  We compete against a range of teams such as Long Beach, UCSD and even the Mexico National team. We were even picked to host the MCLA quarter final championships for 2015! If you are interested in becoming a part of our team visit our website or send us an Email.

name: Men's Rowing Club at UCI
description: Men's Rowing Club at UCI is a competitive rowing team that trains year long for its sprint season in the spring. Each year, the crew travels to compete with some of the best crews in the nation and internationally.  Aside from building nationally competitive athletes, we strive to create outstanding and successful students.

name: Men's Soccer Club at UCI
description: The club serves as an opportunity for students to compete at a competitive level representing UCI in US College Club Soccer whilst being able to participate in the campus academic atmosphere to the greatest extent they are so inclined. Furthermore, the club seeks to foster a sense of brotherhood within the team, in order to allow the members to reach greater collective and personal goals.

name: Men's Ultimate Frisbee Club at UCI
description: We are Men's Ultimate Frisbee Club at UCI. We are a competitive club sport and regularly play other schools from California, Nevada, Utah, and Arizona. Irvine Nightlife is a competitive Ultimate Frisbee club looking for new men to join the team. We practice 2 or 3 days a week and travel to tournaments all over California and surrounding states.

name: Merage Business Analytics Club
description: The Merage Business Analytics Club is a student-run organization that aims to help members with networking opportunities, organize small workshops, engage with industry speakers and be a resource for members in the field of analytics and data science.

name: Merage Business and Technology Association
description: BTA is the bridge to the tech industry for graduate students here at Paul Merage School of Business. BTA connects UCI graduate students with opportunities at the forefront of the tech industry, focusing on roles that demand a strong foundation in both business principles and technology. The club strives to effectively leverage internal and external resources such as the career center and alumni, provide unique educational and networking experiences, and prepare members to be leaders in their post-MBA careers.

name: Merage Challenge 4 Charity
description: Merage C4C is a student led 501 (3)(C) non-profit organization for Merage School of Business graduate students . C4C hosts various athletic and social events to raise money for Special Olympics. We also volunteer time to Junior Achievement and Second Harvest Food Bank of Orange County. All proceeds go to these three charities.

name: Merage Consulting Association - MCA
description: The Merage Consulting Association at the University of California, Irvine (UCI) seeks to help students interested in the consulting profession to improve their critical thinking skills using strategic frameworks and creatively solve complex problems in quick fashion.  We are devoted to building relationships between graduate students and professionals within the business consulting world. We achieve this by providing opportunities for students to learn about the accounting consulting profession as well as facilitate recruiting connections, individual growth and knowledge required for success as future business leaders.

name: Merage Entertainment Management Association
description: The Merage Entertainment Management Association (EMA) is a student driven organization at The Paul Merage School of Business geared towards MBA candidates interested in careers within the entertainment media industry from sports and video games to music, film, and television. Our club facilitates networking and information sessions to better educate Merage students about the industry from a management perspective, all while introducing new and exciting career opportunities.

name: Merage Financial Management Association
description: The Merage Financial Management Association @ UCI connects finance students and enthusiasts acrossacademic programs, bridging the gap between MFIN, FTMBA, FEMBA,EMBA, and Undergrads.

name: Merage Golf Club
description: Mission to facilitate a golf community at Merage and provide a friendly environment for those who want to learn more about the game of golf.

name: Merage Healthcare Association (MHA)
description: To empower and prepare the next generation of healthcare leaders and professionals through education, networking, and community engagement. Our mission is to foster a dynamic learning environment that equips students with the knowledge, skills, and ethical values needed to excel in the ever-evolving healthcare and life sciences industries while also promoting collaboration, innovation, and a commitment to improving healthcare access and outcomes within our community.The Merage Healthcare Association offers excellent opportunities for students to learn about management careers in healthcare and the life sciences. By attending the association's networking events, students can connect with Merage alumni working in leadership positions across various healthcare organizations. These events allow students to ask questions about the day-to-day responsibilities of management roles as well as the career paths these professionals took to reach their current positions.Additionally, the Merage Healthcare Association provides students access to relevant industry events where they can gain exposure to the latest healthcare trends and innovations. Attending these events is an excellent way for students to understand the strategic challenges facing healthcare managers and the skills needed to succeed in these roles.We would encourage students interested in healthcare management to get involved with the Merage Healthcare Association. The connections and insights students can gain through this organization are invaluable in learning about the diverse management career options in the healthcare and life sciences industries. Taking advantage of these opportunities will position students for future leadership roles in these rapidly growing sectors.

name: Merage Marketing Association
description: About Us: What is the MMA?  The Merage Marketing Association is committed to:  The professional development of students interested in marketing careers. Increased corporate community awareness of the quality of Merage students. Promotion and development of Merage as an incubator of marketing and strategy talent. Strengthening relationships with alumni in various fields of marketing.  MMA Events are designed to expose members to the myriad of marketing and strategy opportunities available, as well as provide a forum for strong relationship building both within Merage as well as the outside business community.

name: Merage Real Estate Association at UCI - MREA
description: The Merage Real Estate Association (MREA) is an active, student-run organization that complements the real estate MBA program and the Center for Real Estate at The Paul Merage School of Business.  MREA adds value for its student members by offering a variety of educational events and networking opportunities where students learn from and interact with local real estate professionals and alumni.  Additionally, MREA is focused on creating career-oriented opportunities for students who seek careers in the real estate industry.

name: Merage Undergraduate Student Association (MUSA)
description: The Merage Undergraduate Student Association (MUSA) is an independent student organization that collaborates with the Paul Merage School of Business to enhance the student experience. Our main goal is to promote close relationships between the students, staff, and faculty within the Merage school. MUSA also strives to enhance student's academic and professional skills by constructing and facilitating activities that maintains a strong sense of community. Lastly, MUSA serves as a link to represent the interests of the undergraduate students in order to aid their professional development as they integrate the various fields of business into their professional and educational endeavors at the University of California, Irvine.

name: Merage Veterans Association - MVA
description: The Merage Veterans Association at the University of California, Irvine was founded with the intention of helping military veterans from any branch of service and any ally nation as they navigate the MBA timeline. The MVA actively participates in the Orange County community by hosting special events and fundraisers for both military-focused and non-military charities.

name: Merage Women in Business
description: The Women in Business club will promote awareness of issues that arise for women in business and foster support, connection, and advocacy in our community of future leaders through the provision of networking, professional, and personal development opportunities.

name: Metro Theatre Company
description: Our mission at Metro Theatre Company is to provide creative outlets for all undergraduate students interested in theatre and the arts, whether they are an Arts major or not. These outlets are both on stage and behind the curtain as we aim to have everyone majorly involved to be an undergraduate student.

name: Middle Eastern and South Asian Law Student Association
description: The purpose of this organization is to create an affinity group for UCI Law students who identify as Middle Eastern or South Asian and their allies. Specifically, programming would center around the different experiences those students face throughout law school and the legal profession generally. It will also serve as a networking and relationship building opportunity for students who share similar experiences due to their identity.

name: Middle Eastern Medical Honors Association
description: The Middle Eastern Medical Honors Association is dedicated to supporting students on their journey toward a career in medicine. While we focus on empowering students of Middle Eastern descent, our organization warmly welcomes all individuals who share our passion for medicine and community. At UCI, we strive to ease the challenges of a competitive academic environment by fostering a sense of belonging, creating a supportive network of peers, and a family-like atmosphere where students can grow, relax, and thrive together.

name: Migraine Club at UCI
description: The Migraine Club at UCI is dedicated to raising awareness and promoting advocacy for migraine disease by providing educational resources to the campus community. In addition, the club aims to conduct research and support migraine foundations through fundraising efforts.

name: Military Connected Community (formerly Anteater Veteran Association)
description: The Military Connected Community is committed to providing support to our Veterans, dependents, reservists, and otherwise military-connected students. We are continuously looking for activities that will positively affect our organization, and allow our members to be actively involved. These activities include: regular club meetings used as a forum to provide participants with information, resources, and a social outlet; volunteerism with local community groups to provide service that advances the welfare of our university and greater community; and fundraising events to raise money for projects, charity, and organization enhancement.

name: Mind Rush Competition
description: We are an organization that promotes speed thinking and collaboration by solving different puzzles and scavenger hunt activities, as well as connecting students to local opportunities and competitions to strengthen networking within the community. We encourage diversified minds and collaboration between students and stimulate their potential.

name: Mock Trial Support and Hosting Association at UCI
description: MTSHA at UCI is a student‑run organizational body dedicated to supporting the American Mock Trial Association (AMTA) in administering its national competitive framework, which includes Regional Tournaments, the Opening Round Championship Series, and the National Championship Tournament. MTSHA is not a mock trial team and does not participate in competition, case preparation, or advocacy training.

name: Model United Nations (MUN)
description: We exist to to Learn, Educate, Debate, and Explore the principles of the United Nations in a college environment. Our organization simulates the United Nations by recreating UN committees under which students can debate critical world issues to better understand international policies and foreign affairs. In order to achieve this educational goal we hold college and high school conferences and send our travel team around the world to competitive conferences.

name: Modern Completely Insane Anteaters (MCIA)
description: Modern Completely Insane Anteaters, MCIA, is an exhibition dance team that gives its members opportunities to dance, grow, and have fun while upholding the values of respect, family, and its roots.

name: Mood Psychology at UCI
description: Mood Psychology at UCI established in 2019. We dedicate to provide high-quality psychological services for international students, including linking professional psychological counseling resources, holding academic seminars, reaching out with professors, and publishing health-related articles on the social media platform. Since UC Irvine is a diverse environment, we want to create more convenient access for international students who may experience stress from academic, life, new environment. We hope to promote the importance of psychological healthiness and help international students to relieve their stress.

name: Morning Sign Out at UCI
description: The primary purpose of the Morning Sign Out (MSO) campus organization is to promote health and science literacy within the community and encourage positive and thoughtful discussions about the health and science community amongst the public via our online articles and workshops hosted. MSO at UCI aims to contribute to the greater cross-collegiate MSO parent organization.

name: Morse Coda A Cappella
description: Morse Coda A Cappella is an all-inclusive acappella group. We aim to foster a diverse and collaborative community where members can thrive and prosper musically.

name: Movement Exchange at UCI
description: Movement Exchange at University of California, Irvine is a community of globally minded individuals who share a passion for arts, education, and service to their community. Movement Exchange at University of California, Irvine will work in a domestic setting and travel abroad to empower under-resourced youth and communities through the medium of dance.

name: Movimiento Estudiantil Chicanx de Aztlan - MEChA
description: M.E.Ch.A is a political, educational, and cultural organization that focuses on fostering awareness of social justice issues affecting disenfranchised, underserved, and underrepresented communities; particularly the Latinx community. The organization creates various outlets and opportunities for development of educational, cultural, political, and social tools within peers and community, which is essential to fulfill our goals. M.E.Ch.A strives to provide a platform for critical consciousness that focuses on local to global community issues.

name: Multicultural Sorority & Fraternity Council (MSFC)
description: The Multicultural Sorority and Fraternity Council (MSFC) is the governing body for 18 different cultural fraternities and sororities at UC Irvine. The MSFC oversees educational programming and the promotion of the various multicultural fraternity and sorority community at UC Irvine. Groups within the MSFC have ties to Latinx, Asian, Armenian and other various multicultural backgrounds and even ties to the National Pan-Hellenic Council (NPHC).

name: MUSE Magazine
description: MUSE is a student-run magazine at UCI dedicated to amplifying women’s voices at the intersection of business, fashion, and lifestyle. Our mission is to inspire and empower students by showcasing stories of leadership, creativity, and identity, while providing a platform for professional development and self-expression. In the short term, MUSE seeks to publish thought-provoking content and host engaging events that highlight student talent and foster community. In the long term, we aim to establish MUSE as a sustainable, influential publication that bridges style with strategy, empowering students to define success on their own terms and carry these values beyond campus.

name: Musical Improv Collective
description: Our mission is to provide a space where improv and music enthusiasts can learn to fuse the two together and improvise songs and musicals.

name: MusicsAlive at UC Irvine
description: Our mission is to drive access to music education and performance opportunities for all, using our club as a space to destress, relax, and share music with others to heal where medicine cannot.

name: Muslim Law Students Association
description: MLSA will create a safe space and community, advocate for the interests of Muslim law students, and cultivate connections and networks with Muslim attorneys.

name: Muslim Student Union
description: The Muslim Student Union (MSU) at UC Irvine is a religious student organization which seeks to serve the Muslim student community by providing religious services and fostering social, spiritual, educational, and moral development in a way that compels Muslim students to contribute positively and uniquely to the campus community and beyond.

name: Muslim Tech Collaborative at UCI
description: MTC at UCI builds a welcoming community at the intersection of Islam and technology, supporting Muslim and allied students in computer science, data science, engineering, product, and entrepreneurship through skill development, mentorship, spiritual well-being, and service.

name: Mycology Club at UCI
description: Mycology Club at UCI gives students the opportunity to understand and appreciate anoften forgotten kingdom of life; Fungi.
