name: School of Social Sciences
description: To create positive change in society, economies and for human well-being by breaking down traditional barriers and pushing the limits in teaching, research and service.

name: School on Wheels at UCI
description: The mission of School on Wheels is to provide educational support and resources to K-12 students experiencing homelessness within the local community. The organization aims to bridge educational gaps by offering tutoring, mentorship, and academic guidance to students who face significant barriers to learning.

name: Schrödinger's Cast: 30 Plays in 60 Minutes
description: 30/60 is a theatre collective that strives to create truthful, impactful, and experimental theatre in the Neo-Futurist style. Twice a quarter, we perform 30 original plays within the span of 60 minutes, and each performance is unique, meaning no play shall be performed twice. Our shows are committed to artists bringing their true selves to their works, rather than a character or story, as well as bringing the CTSA community together to share the whirlwind experience of being “right here, right now”.

name: Science Olympiad at UC Irvine
description: Our mission is to provide STEM resources and learning opportunities for K-12 students while developing our community members.

name: Scripted Mystery & Immersive Roleplay Society at UCI
description: Providing a communication bridge for students.

name: Sigma Chi (Sig)
description: The purpose of Sigma Chi is a simple one: to help good men become great men by giving them opportunities to build and live their ideals, serve in leadership positions, and engage in positive interaction with those of all temperaments, talents, and convictions, people from all walks of life and backgrounds.  The fundamental purpose of the Sigma Chi Fraternity is the cultivation, maintenance and accomplishment of the ideals of friendship, justice, and learning within our membership. Sigma Chi engenders a lifelong commitment to strive to achieve true friendship, equal justice for all and to realize the fulfillment of learning as part of our overall responsibilities to the broader communities in which we live. We achieve these ideals through the practice of character qualities embodied in our Ritual

name: Sigma Eta Pi - SEP
description: Sigma Eta Pi is a premier co-educational entrepreneurship professional fraternity at UCI, dedicated to fostering a community of passionate and driven innovators and entrepreneurs. Those who have been chosen to join the organization shall preserve and honor the code of the organization and carry forward the values that we hold. Sigma Eta Pi is dedicated to developing human potential by transforming individuals into entrepreneurs who follow their passion, developing lasting connections in the university startup ecosystem, and creating impact through innovative ventures.

name: Sigma Gamma Tau at UCI
description: The mission of Sigma Gamma Tau is to recognize academic and professional excellence in engineering, more notably aerospace engineering. This organization seeks to not only award national recipients but also connect with endeavoring students in engineering to strengthen the academic community and provide opportunities for personal and professional development at UCI and beyond.

name: Sigma Lambda Gamma National Sorority Inc.
description: Sigma Lambda Gamma is a historically Latina, multicultural sorority founded on the five principles of Academics, Community Service, Cultural Awareness, Morals and Ethics and Social Interaction.

name: Sigma Nu
description: To develop ethical leaders inspired by the principles of Love, Honor and Truth. To foster the personal growth of each man's mind, heart, and character. To perpetuate lifelong friendships and commitment to the Fraternity.

name: Sigma Omicron Pi
description: The sisterhood of Sigma Omicron Pi was established at San Francisco State University in 1930 by ten Asian American women pursuing the interest of teaching. They chose the Greek letters, ├Ä┬ú, O and ├Ä┬á to represent themselves as the "Sisters of Pedagogy." The Constitution was derived from an existing "Honorary Society of Education."  The sorority was active in the Asian Community for the next 15 years. At the advent of World War II, the organization was forced to become inactive. In 1946, a group of women from the University of California, Berkeley re-established ├Ä┬úO├Ä┬á on their campus.  The purpose of ├Ä┬úO├Ä┬á is to promote unity, lifelong friendships, leadership, and community service. This organization offers women a supportive network of sisters to achieve academic and social growth. The sisterhood of ├Ä┬úO├Ä┬á provides an environment where sisters may utilize and develop their organizational skills.

name: Sigma Phi Epsilon (SigEp)
description: Building Balanced Men

name: Sigma Pi
description: Sigma Pi is an elite collegiate men's social fraternity founded on the principles of brotherhood, scholarship, sportsmanship, and philanthropy. Sigma Pi strives to be exemplary citizens and gentlemen in our UC Irvine community and outside the community every day and teaches members many important aspects in life to apply it towards their future.

name: Sigma Pi Alpha Sorority, Inc.
description: Sigma Pi Alpha is a Chicana/Latina Sorority. It was founded in the Spring of 1996 at the University of California at Berkeley by nine women who saw the need to create a close network of Chicana/Latinas - Chicana/Latinas who want to make a difference in the community starting with themselves. Sigma Pi Alpha addresses the academic, cultural, communal, and social needs of its members. We pride ourselves on three pillars which are: campus involvement, community service, and sisterhood. We believe "you choose us, we don't choose you".

name: Sikh Student Association at UCI
description: The Sikh Faith is the 5th largest faith in the world, with nearly 24 million followers. Sikhi shares with the world a message of truth, love and justice, remembrance of One God at all times, universal equality- irrespective of race, gender, wealth, religion, origin and social standing. The Sikh Students Association's (SSA) purpose is to unify UC Irvine's Sikh Community through events geared toward seva (selfless service), education and discussion about Sikh history and humanitarian issues facing the Sikh as well as the global community, spiritual experience through keertan (singing of hymns) and paath (prayer), networking with SSAs throughout California through the Sikh Student Collaborative, and social events to build friendships within the club.

name: Skateboarding at UCI
description: By connecting skateboarders at UCI, the club focuses on further Members' skateboarding skills and interests. Resources will be provided to our Members, such as skating competitions and sponsorship opportunities. Further, we aim to benefit our skating community with quarterly fund-raisers and donations. Lastly, we wish to promote skateboarding culture here at UCI.

name: Ski and Snowboard Club
description: Offer fun and welcoming environment on campus where students can bond with people who share an interest in skiing and snowboarding! We prioritize affordable ski trips for the college student!

name: Social Ecology Undergraduate Advising
description: OUR MISSION STATEMENTIn Social Ecology Undergraduate Advising, we provide holistic advising to each student. By interpreting and enforcing both university and school policies, we seek to empower students to make informed decisions about their education. We collaborate with students to set personal, educational, and professional goals and ensure they have the knowledge of and access to resources to achieve those goals. Ultimately, our goal is for each student to become a proactive agent in their educational journey.

name: Social Epidemiology and Research in Community Health Lab
description: The mission of the SEARCH Lab is to provide public health research, professional development, community engagement, and peer health education opportunities to undergraduate and graduate students on campus.

name: Social Policy & Public Service Advocates
description: SPPSA is committed to providing multifaceted awareness of both professional and educational resources to enhance the college experiences of those interested in social policy and public service, specifically in the areas of education, governance, and health, while developing a sense of community amongst students within the major.

name: Social Sciences Academic Resource Center
description: The Social Sciences Academic Resource Center (SSARC) was created in 1992 to assist undergraduate students of the School of Social Sciences to obtain a competitive edge for their post-baccalaureate goals. Grounded in giving students opportunities, defining work ethic, and teaching professionalism, our Center has evolved into a one-stop location to address an entire range of student achievement and academic success, including graduate school admissions, career preparation, internship placement, scholarly promotion, and community.

name: Social Sciences Dean's Ambassador Council
description: Representing the UCI School of Social Sciences undergraduate students, we strive to promote meaningful interactions between students, faculty, and staff to give back to our Social Sciences community by building a strong progressive environment for our students. Our efforts focus on bringing our community together through various events including: Fall Festivals, Hot Topics Debate, First-Generation Alumni Career Panel, and Dean's Day. In addition, the council operates as the first in-line for assisting in staff events and functions.

name: Society for Advancement of Chicanos/Hispanics and Native Americans in Science (SACNAS)
description: SACNAS is a society of scientists dedicated to fostering the success of Hispanic/Chicano and Native American scientists from college students to professionals to attain advanced degrees, careers, and positions of leadership.  The organization serves over 25,000 students and professionals each year with its conference and year-round programs and thrives on the dedication and support of hundreds of volunteers.

name: Society for Women in Marine Science at UCI - SWMS
description: The Society for Women in Marine Science brings together marine scientists of all career levels to discuss the diverse experiences of women in marine science, celebrate the research done by women in the field, and promote the visibility of women in the marine science community.

name: Society of Arab Students (SAS)
description: Society of Arab Students at UC Irvine is a non-religious, non-political multicultural club that engages in activities and events that explore the Arab culture. We aim to provide an opportunity for UCI students to come together through social and cultural events to build a stronger Arab community and raise awareness about our culture.

name: Society of Engineers, Scientists, and Entrepreneurs at UCI
description: The Society of Engineers, Scientists, and Entrepreneurs (SESE) at UCI hosts career fairs and research seminars to empower student engineers, scientists, and entrepreneurs by fostering meaningful connections with industry leaders and academic pioneers. SESE facilitates dialogue between Berkeley’s top engineering talent and influential figures, including Nobel laureates, bridging academia and industry. By consistently delivering exceptional talent to both sectors, SESE plays a vital role in providing resources, career opportunities, and academic pathways, fulfilling its mission to advance the future of engineering and innovation.

name: Society of Graduate Electrical Engineers and Computer Scientists at University of California, Irvine
description: Our goal is to promote the success of students' academic, professional, and socialwell-being. Academically, we bridge a connection between students and the EECSdepartment to encourage cooperation between the two parties. Professionally, wespan our network of students to include industry and academic professionals acrossthe schools of engineering. Socially, we foster a supportive community to engagestudents to establish healthy work-life balances.

name: Society of Hispanic Professional Engineers at UCI - SHPE
description: SHPE at UCI serves to impact the lives of the Latino community, empowering us to achieve our full potential as engineers, scientists, and more through access, support, and development in a STEM education. and career.

name: Society of Iranian Graduate Students (SIGS)
description: Our main goal is to help the Iranian student who are living outside their families to minimum their problems when moving to a new country and also demonstrate the Persian traditions

name: Society of Physics Students
description: Our mission is to be an organization that can help undergraduate physics students academically and to provide a hub where undergraduates of any year can interact with one another.

name: Society of Women Engineers
description: The Society of Women Engineers (SWE) is a not-for-profit educational and service organization that empowers women to succeed and advance in the field of engineering, and to be recognized for their life-changing contributions as engineers and leaders. Founded in 1950, SWE is the driving force that establishes engineering as a highly desirable career for women through an exciting array of training and development programs, networking opportunities, scholarships, outreach and advocacy activities. Mission (adopted in 1986)  -Stimulate and support women of all ages to achieve full potential in careers as engineers and leaders, -Expand the image of the engineering profession as an innovative and driving force in improving the quality of life and, -Demonstrate the value of diversity.    SWE Objectives (adopted in 1950) -Inform young women, their parents, counselors, and the general public, of the qualifications and achievements of women engineers and the opportunities open to them. -Assist women in readying themselves for a return to active work after temporary retirement. -Serve as a center of information on women in engineering. -Encourage women engineers to attain high levels of education and professional achievement.

name: Soka Gakkai - Value Creation Club
description: Fostering a community around self improvement and fulfillment philosophies. Focused on the application of absolute happiness, as an extension of academia, through utilizing principles of self empowerment and retrospective analysis.

name: Sole Rhythms Tap Club
description: Through Sole Rhythms Tap Club, our mission is to provide space for the tap dance community to come together and share their rhythmic exploration.

name: Soon Movement
description: Soon Movement is dedicated to creating movements on campuses through believers who are committed to connecting people to Christ. We know that apart from Christ we can do nothing, therefore we depend on the Holy Spirit to work in and through us to accomplish the work God has placed before all believers; the Great Commission. We are here to win people for Christ, to build them up, and send them out into the world as more fully developed Christ-centered followers.

name: Sorority & Fraternity Life
description: Sorority & Fraternity Life at UC Irvine works with students to create an inclusive environment that challenges members to develop into leaders who uphold the values, oaths, and commitments of their collegiate fraternal organization at UC Irvine. Sorority & Fraternity Life values ongoing relationships with alumni, volunteers, campus administrators, and the surrounding community in order to create meaningful and purposeful undergraduate experiences that foster a commitment to service and lifetime membership.

name: Southeast Asian Student Association (SASA)
description: The Southeast Asian Student Association (SASA) aims to unite and empower the Southeast Asian Community through a commitment to culture, mentorship, and community. We recognize the historical context and social repercussions of the issues within our underrepresented communities. SASA also fosters a safe space to share experiences and to build community consciousness. By coming together, we will strengthen our community.

name: Southern California Health Outreach at UCI
description: At SCHO, we believe health insurance information should be understandable and readily accessible to all. By providing free-of-cost educational materials and informational sessions to underinsured populations, we aim to demystify the enrollment process, help individuals and families navigate the healthcare system, and expand coverage in Los Angeles and beyond.This group is designed to expand access to healthcare primarily under the ACA, but also under Medicare, Medicaid, etc. We will go into the community and assist underserved populations by directly assisting them with signing up for a plan, and keeping in touch with them to ensure no gaps in coverage. We will partner with other community organizations, and student groups on campus to set up educational events and fairs in the community related to healthcare eligibility and enrollment-- and at these events, we will also attempt to insure as many people as possible. In the future, we will design our own procedure for signing up uninsured individuals and compare the efficacy of this process with the standard protocol. We are not doing political advocacy, or health/wellness fairs—we are simply helping people who normally would not access insurance, get coverage.

name: Space Law Society
description: The UCl Space Law Society examines the current laws governing human activity in space and possible future developments. The UCI Space Law Society seeks to familiarize students with this body of law through courses, events, and partnerships with outside organizations.

name: Spanish and Portuguese
description: Our academic mission is to broaden the intellectual and cultural horizon of our students by familiarizing them with the rich traditions and cultural diversity amassed by Spanish speaking communities. Students receive a well rounded education with special emphasis on understanding of cultural differences and the development of independent critical thinking.Our courses cover a wide range of subjects: from literature, linguistics and arts to film and popular culture. While the study of the Spanish language is central to the organization of our curriculum, our students also become aware of the importance of the indigenous cultures of Latin America, the significant contributions made by people of African descent to Latin America and the different traditions and languages that have shaped the history of modern Spain, such as Catalan.

name: Speech and Debate at UCI
description: Foster academic and intellectual debate with students within UCI and amongst the UC's, collaborating with debate clubs of other universities to host tournaments and meets. Harbor discussions between schools of disciplines as well as debate with professionals in their fields upon controversial topics. Educate newcomers and veterans in debating tactics and skills to strengthen public speaking, as well as teamwork.

name: Sports Medicine Club
description: The Sports Medicine Club at UCI (SMED) educates about sports medicine and its associated skills and professions by providing interactive workshops, guest speakers, on- and off-campus volunteering opportunities, and an introduction to the UCI Sports Performance Internship. All meetings and activities provide insight about this multifaceted field that includes but is not limited to pre-health careers, nutrition, psychology, physical therapy, and athletic training. SMED acts as a nexus between learning and socializing with its emphasis on establishing a UCI community bonded by a willingness to help others and passion for athletics. All activities organized by SMED will abide by this purpose.

name: Sprout Up at UCI
description: Sprout Up provides free, youth-led environmental education programs to Kindergarten, 1st and 2nd grade classrooms in public schools located in the Irvine area. Our college student-instructors teach children vital concepts in environmental science and sustainability during the earliest stages of their educational development, cultivating the next generation of passionate caretakers of the earth. Through activities, experiments, and discussions, we get kids thinking in new ways about the world that surrounds them, inspiring them to bring the message of environmental stewardship home to their families and friends. In this way, we strive to promote sustainability throughout our many communities, from the youngest members of society up.

name: Steel Bridge at UCI
description: The student-led Steel Bridge at UCI project forms part of an inter-collegiate competition, hosted by the American Institute of Steel Construction (AISC), that challenges students to design, fabricate, and construct a model steel bridge. This technical project serves as a way for civil engineering students to demonstrate their critical thinking skills, work collaboratively with others, and implement their engineering knowledge to achieve a common goal of completing a large scale bridge. By utilizing basic tools that range from angled grinders to CAD to building techniques and methods, the Steel Bridge at UCI team aims to provide students with hands-on engineering experience that supplements the technical lessons learned from university to help them develop into professional engineers.

name: Strategic Communications & Public Affairs
description: Strategic Communications & Public Affairs collaborates across campus and the health system to advance UCI's reputation, mission, priorities and values through storytelling and relationship building.

name: Strategy and Operations Management Association at UCI Merage (formerly Merage Operations Management Association at UCI - OMA)
description: Our mission is to empower UC Irvine Merage graduate students to achieve their career aspirations in corporate strategy, business development, and operations management.

name: Structural Engineering Association of Southern California Student Chapter at UCI - SEAOSC
description: The SEAOSC Student Chapter at the University of California, Irvine aims to cultivate the next generation of structural engineers by fostering professional growth, technical excellence, and community engagement. Our mission is to bridge the gap between academia and industry through networking events, technical workshops, mentorship, and hands-on learning opportunities. By promoting collaboration, innovation, and ethical practice, we strive to inspire students to advance the built environment and contribute meaningfully to the field of structural engineering.

name: Strut
description: Strut is committed to exploring, training, and celebrating heels dance while honoring its roots in jazz and embracing its influence within today’s commercial dance industry. By blending historical awareness with contemporary practice, we provide dancers with the tools to develop strong technical foundations, versatile performance skills, and authentic self-expression.We strive to cultivate confidence, artistry, and body awareness, recognizing heels dance as both a powerful art form and a source of personal empowerment. Through technique classes, choreography workshops, industry masterclasses, showcases, and community-building events, Strut creates an inclusive space where dancers of all identities and experience levels can thrive.Our mission extends beyond the studio. Strut prepares members to enter the commercial dance world with artistry, professionalism, and confidence, while also cultivating skills that carry into everyday life—self-expression, resilience, and leadership. We believe heels dance is more than a performance style; it is a vehicle for empowerment and connection, capable of shaping how dancers see themselves and how they engage with the world. By fostering an inclusive and supportive community, Strut equips its members not only to thrive in their craft but also to contribute meaningfully to the cultural landscape of dance at UCI and beyond.

name: Student Achievement Guided by Experience (SAGE)
description: The SAGE Scholars Program is a competitive 2-year leadership development and business acumen training program that supports high-achieving, economically disadvantaged students. Students in the program are equipped with tools to invest in their future through access to internships, graduate school planning, career exploration, leadership training and scholarship opportunities.

name: Student Alumni Association
description: The Student Alumni Association serves as a liaison between UCI's student and alumni groups, creating opportunities to network, interact, and strengthen ties to the university.

name: Student Coalition for Ochem Readiness and Excellence
description: Our mission is to provide free mentorship to students who are currently in the Chem 51 series at UCI.

name: Student Government - Student Media
description: The Mission of Student Government & Student Media is to represent the interests of the student body through initiatives, programs, and services that enrich students' lives. Our overall Vision is to be the standard – the premier Student Government & Student Media in the nation. Through this Vision, we will continuously seek to be Relevant, Influential, Innovative, and Independent. In addition, our Values will focus on Dedication, Integrity, Communication, Cooperation, and Enthusiasm as we seek to meet our Mission and Vision every day.

name: Anteater TV
description: AnteaterTV: Visual Media created for students, by students. Anteater TV is the only student-run visual media organization on the UCI campus. ATV strives to create fun and engaging entertainment, produce professional documentaries, cover events and share community knowledge at UCI through our production of written, photo, and video content.

name: Anthology Yearbook
description: Welcome UCI students, staff, faculty, and especially the Class of 2022 to our award winning yearbook page! The 2020 UCI Anthology Yearbook was officially inducted into the Walsworth Gallery of Excellence. It is a prestigious honor to reach the top echelon as one of the most distinguished yearbooks in the country. Join us in celebrating this huge accomplishment as we commend our team's outstanding work and commitment to excellence.

name: Student Health Center, Dental Clinic
description: The Dental Clinic prides itself on providing high quality dental care to the campus community in a professional, caring and friendly environment. Our staff includes dentists, specialists and hygienists with years of experience who provide a full range of general dentistry procedures. Please feel free to call the Dental Clinic for further information or to make an appointment.  Student Health Center Dental Clinic is a Delta Dental preferred provider.We look forward to serving your dental needs!

name: Student Healthcare in Practice
description: Student Healthcare In Practice (SHIP) is an undergraduate organization at UCI, that primarily staffs and oversees free health clinics in Orange, CA. We strive to not only bring awareness to the socioeconomic disparities in healthcare but also to directly make a difference in the healthcare industry by serving underserved communities and providing quality healthcare for free. Together, our SHIPmates strive to show that healthcare is a right, not a privilege.

name: Student Life and Leadership
description: Student Life & Leadership supports the intellectual, personal, social and professional development of all students. Student Life & Leadership offers education and skill development opportunities that enhance academic success and prepare students for their leadership roles in a diverse, dynamic, and global society.

name: Student National Medical Association @ UCI (SNMA)
description: The Student National Medical Association at the University of California, Irvine (SNMA@UCI) is part of the nation's oldest and largest student organization focused on the needs and concerns of medical students from marginalized communities. SNMA is committed to supporting current and future underrepresented minority medical students, addressing the needs of underserved communities, and increasing the number of clinically excellent, culturally competent and socially conscious physicians.National membership includes more than 7,000 medical students, pre-medical students, residents and physicians. For more information visit www.snma.org.

name: Student Outreach and Retention (SOAR)
description: The mission of the Student Outreach and Retention (SOAR) Center, at UC Irvine is to cultivate a community of authentic student  leaders that aspire to develop innovative, student-initiated outreach and retention programs that foster critical dialogue, mentorship and shift the educational paradigm to improve college access, readiness, and retention rates for historically marginalized communities in higher education. SOAR is a dynamic space that empowers student scholars through praxis to advocate and develop a transformative and equitable educational environment where students can use their education as a vehicle for social impact.

name: Student Pharmacist Class Cabinet 2029
description: The purpose of SPCC2029 shall be to:1. Provide a forum for all students to express their needs and concerns.2. Recognize and address these needs and concerns by acting as mediators between allstudents, faculty, and staff and/or act as a repository of resources for the students.3. Represent all students enrolled at UCI and their interests internally within the UCIcommunity and externally.4. Enrich the academic, professional, and social experiences of all students enrolled at UCIthrough initiatives, services, and events.

name: Student Society of Health-System Pharmacists at UCI
description: The purpose of  SSHP at UCI shall be:To make students aware of pharmacy practice in health systems; provide information to students about career directions in and credentials needed for pharmacy practice in health systems; and encourage membership and participation in the CSHP and ASHP as a student and upon graduation.

name: Student Success Initiatives
description: Housed within the Division of Undergraduate Education, Student Success Initiatives (SSI) aim to provide students the personal, academic, and professional support and development to thrive and succeed at UCI and beyond. SSI is a learning community that empowers students to be productive and engaged in their academic careers and personal endeavors.

name: Students Advocating For Immigrant Rights and Equity (SAFIRE)
description: The purpose of S.A.F.I.R.E. at UCI is to empower, provide resources and create a safe environment for Undocumented/DACA/Non-DACA/AB 540 students and those impacted by immigration policies. In collaboration with allies, faculty, family, and friends, our vision is to raise awareness and highlight the social, political, and economic issues the undocumented community faces on campus and beyond. Finally, S.A.F.I.R.E at UCI seeks to incorporate and celebrate the spectrum of identities, experiences, and stories of undocumented people.

name: Students for Global Peacebuilding
description: Students for Global Peacebuilding (SGP) promotes citizen education and action about peacebuilding initiatives.  It engages communities on and off campus to enhance the role of citizen peacebuilding locally and globally. It conducts training workshops and organizes service learning opportunities where there is a need for peacebuilding.

name: Students For Industrial Organizational Psychology (SIOP)
description: The Students for Industrial-Organizational Psychology (SIOP) intends to provide students exposure to I/O psychology and prepare our members for their post-baccalaureate aspirations as they venture into their post-graduate lives.

name: Students For Socialism at UCI
description: Students For Socialism is the student affiliate of the Party for Socialism and Liberation, a national organization involved in a wide range of struggles, from local battles over affordable housing and racist police brutality, to the fight for a higher minimum wage and union rights, to the global issues of imperialist war and environmental destruction. SFS seeks to merge the struggles of oppressed and exploited people with the fight for socialism. We are united in our belief that capitalism—a system where all wealth and power is held by a small group of billionaires and their state—is the source of the main problems confronting humanity today. It must be replaced by socialism, a system where poor and working people control all the wealth and power of society, using it to plan for and meet the needs of the people and planet.

name: Students for the Exploration and Development of Space at UC Irvine
description: We wish to create a space within the academic community where students with STEMinterest can gain hands-on experience as well as prepare for their future careers and globalopportunities for conferences and projects while promoting an interest in space exploration anddevelopment. Also provide project opportunities at a lower risk environment. We strive topromote interdisciplinary approaches to the projects and research included in the new spaceindustry. We want to show that the modern space field does not include only aerospaceengineering but also various STEM fields. Overall, we would like to bring an inviting andinclusive SEDS chapter to UC Irvine for students of all levels.

name: Students Providing Aid at UCI
description: SPAid (Students Providing Aid) at UCI is a fully student-run organization dedicated to improving global health by empowering college students to create and distribute child-friendly first aid kits. Focused on helping children in rural and underserved communities worldwide, we aim to close healthcare access gaps through collaboration, education, and strategic partnerships.

name: Survivor at UCI
description: The mission of Survivor at UCI is to foster a dynamic and inclusive community that promotes strategic thinking, teamwork, and personal growth through engagement with the game of Survivor, based on the classic CBS series of the same name. The organization aims to provide students with opportunities to develop leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills by participating in interactive challenges, social strategy simulations, and collaborative events. By welcoming students of diverse backgrounds and experience levels, the Survivor Club seeks to create a supportive environment that encourages creativity, resilience, and meaningful connections, while offering both recreational enjoyment and skill-building experiences that extend beyond campus life.

name: Sustainable and Just Future at UCI
description: Sustainable and Just Future at UC Irvine aims foster the environmental education-to-action pipeline by inspiring and equipping the next generation with the tools and knowledge needed to become climate solutionists.

name: SWANA Health Alliance
description: The S.W.A.N.A Health Alliance shall: 1) Provide awareness and educational resources towards health issues in SWANA populations2) Act as an academic and social support system for pre-health students in navigating their academic and occupational careers3) Provide resources that may prepare students for personal statements, research or professional school applications4) Encourage student involvement and promote service activities via club events Inspire club team members to implement meaningful, creative, and service-oriented projects.

name: Swim Club at UCI
description: Swim Club at UCI is a club sport that is dedicated to providing UCI students with a casual and competitive swim community. Regardless of your level of swim experience, our club is ready to help you develop your swim endurance and refine your competitive stroke technique. We regularly compete in regional swim competitions throughout California as a member of the CISCA league. Thanks for reading, and we hope to see you on the pool deck soon!

name: Swing Dance at UCI
description: Swing Dance at UCI aims to provide a place for individuals to come together, learn to swing dance, and have fun dancing all on campus. We do this by hosting weekly lessons and social dances to give everybody, beginner or advanced, a chance to learn and improve on existing skills while meeting people with similar interests in a friendly social dance environment. Swing Dance at UCI focuses on the art of Lindy Hop: a high energy dance developed in the late 20's that is still popular in many places today.

name: Sword at UCI - Belegarth Medieval Combat Society
description: We promote the fun and safe sport of simulated medieval combat using foam padded swords. Game play emphasizes sportsmanship and inclusivity, with a focus on safety and the development of medieval arts and sciences in accordance with the rules set forth by the national organization Belegarth.

name: Synapse at UCI
description: Our organization supports individuals with brain injuries and raises awareness while also informing a wider community. We aim establish a network of passionate student leaders at UCI to achieve our mission.

name: Syrian American Medical Society
description: Syrian American Medical Society Mission Statement for the student chapter:  In SAMS effort to get students more involved in its mission we are planning to launch a pilot student chapter in UCI. The main objective of establishing student chapters is the creation of a sustainable network for student participation in SAMS activities. Our aim is to create opportunities for student involvement in SAMS at both national and international level with the ultimate goal of expanding SAMS membership to a younger demographic, providing students with impactful volunteer opportunities, and creating a pipeline for SAMS leadership.

name: Table Tennis Club at UCI
description: The Table Tennis Club at UC Irvine actively competes in the Southern California Division in the National Collegiate Table Tennis Association (NCTTA). We welcome all players who are just starting or who already play at a competitive level.

name: Tabletop Club at UCI Law- TCUL
description: The purpose of this orginization is to create a space for hobbyist and casual board game enthusiast to connect and socialize at UCI Law.

name: Tabletop Games Club
description: The purpose of the Tabletop Games Club @ UCI is to connect people with a shared passion for board games and tabletop RPGs (like the popular Dungeons & Dragons).  Whether you're a board game enthusiast, a GM looking for players, or just someone who is interested in learning more about playing tabletop games and meeting new people, the club has something for everyone. Tabletop games are a great way to bring people together. We strive to create a safe space where every person feels welcome and is able to have a great time playing games and making new friends.

name: Taekwondo at UCI - Club Sport
description: The Taekwondo Club at UCI is a competitive club sport affiliated with the PacWest Collegiate Taekwondo Conference and the National Collegiate Taekwondo Association (NCTA). Our club was founded in 2006 by hardworking alumni who recognized that UCI needed a Taekwondo sports club. We train under Coach David Kwak throughout the entire academic year at the Anteater Recreation Center (ARC). We offer men’s and women’s World Taekwondo (WT) Olympic sparring and forms, competing at both the collegiate and national levels. So, here we are with open arms for anyone interested in taekwondo! No prior experience needed!

name: TAG Smash Melee at UCI
description: Our club organizes weekly and quarterly tournaments/events for Nintendo's "Super Smash Bros. Melee" game title. The club is meant to foster friendly competition while allowing players with a love for the game to develop lasting friendships. In addition, we provide opportunities for our members to become club officers and develop event organization, communication, and troubleshooting skills.

name: TAG Smash Ultimate Club at UCI
description: Have fun, play Smash, meet new people. We have weekly events. Tournaments almost every meeting

name: Taiwan National Organization (TNO) at UCI
description: Providing useful information and services to all the Taiwanese students. Enhancing the connections between the members promoting Taiwanese culture.

name: Taiwanese American Organization (TAO)
description: The Taiwanese American Organization (TAO) at University of California, Irvine is an organization that provides a friendly welcoming community to Taiwanese Americans, those with Taiwanese cultural interests, and anyone else. Through weekly social activities, TAO connects people of Taiwanese heritage while introducing Taiwanese culture, history, and cuisine. TAO also works as a bridge for its members to connect with Taiwanese affiliated organizations in the greater Orange County to build greater community among Taiwanese Americans throughout the area.

name: Tau Beta Pi (National Engineering Honor Society)
description: To recognize academic achievements and strive to foster the growth of leaders in engineering.

name: Tau Sigma National Honor Society at UCI
description: Tau Sigma is an academic honor society designed specifically to recognize and promote the academic excellence and involvement of transfer students.

name: Tax Law Society
description: The Tax Law Society's goal is to create a tax community at UCI to provide information, networking, and career advancement in the area of tax law.

name: Teachers of Tomorrow (TOT)
description: Teachers of Tomorrow provides ways to learn more about getting involved in education. We offer a variety of academic and social activities to meet other students who are planning careers in education. General Meetings include: special presentations by the School of Education, guest speakers, job offers, work-field experience opportunities, and general overviews of credential programs, teacher testing, and graduate school programs. Because education policies are changing all the time, this club is a great resource in finding up-to-date information on current issues. TOT at UC Irvine welcomes students of all majors, concentrations and grade-levels who are interested in the field of education.

name: Technology Law Society
description: The purpose of this organization is to explore academic and career issues related to the intersection of technology, science, and law and to help those interested in the field to get to know one another better outside the classroom.

name: Teddy Bear Hospital USA at UCI
description: The Teddy Bear Hospital USA is an undergraduate-led organization working alongside medical students interested in Pediatrics, current UCI/CHOC Pediatric residents, and the local community to promote medical communication and reduce clinical anxiety in kids. Our events take place at elementary schools, where the kids act as parents who bring in their "teddy bear kids" to different mock hospital booths. They treat their teddy bears, learn about patient care, and discover careers in medicine.

name: TEDxUCIrvine
description: In the spirit of ideas worth spreading, TED has created a program called TEDx. TEDx is a program of local, self-organized events that bring people together to share a TED-like experience. Our event is called TEDxUCIrvine, where x = independently organized TED event. At our TEDxUCIrvine event, TEDTalks video and live speakers will combine to spark deep discussion and connection in a small group. The TED Conference provides general guidance for the TEDx program, but individual TEDx events, including ours, are self-organized.This independent TEDx event is operated under license from TED.We bring together our community's leading thinkers and doers to share ideas that matter in any discipline.

name: Tender Night Music Club at UCI
description: We are a group of UCI students with a strong passion for music. We have weekly live performance on campus and special events cooperated with other UCI's clubs. Our music styles include Popular, Rap, R&B, EDM, etc. We welcome all music lovers to participate in our weekly workshop(Vocal, Instrument) and become one of our big family.

name: Tennis Club at UCI
description: Tennis Club at UCI is a student-run sports organization that promotes tennis throughout the UCI community. We aim to provide a relaxed, social atmosphere for all our members at recreational practices, social events, as well as multiple tournaments.  We are also proud to sponsor a competitive team that participates in USTA Tennis on Campus, competing in both regional and national level tournaments throughout the country.  The Tennis Club at UCI prides itself in its inclusivity of welcoming players of all levels, as well as its promotion of developing social connections through the same love for the sport.

name: Thai Culture Association at UCI
description: Thai Culture Association at UCI comprises of members of various ethnicity with one common goal: to spread the love of Thailand. TCA is dedicated to preserving culture, honoring traditions, giving back to the community, and adhering to all the values from which Thailand's culture was born. Through a constantly active effort to unite people through community service and community participation, people from every ethnicity are welcome to join TCA as they learn to appreciate the many wonders of Thailand.

name: The Antweavers
description: Our goal is to foster a creative environment for students to learn and teach the art of crochet, knitting, embroidery, and other handcrafts. We hope to donate our group projects to local charities as well as hold workshops to teach various crafts (crochet, knitting, embroidery, and etc).

name: The Beautiful Mind Project at UCI
description: The Beautiful Mind Project aims to promote well-rounded and intersectional understandings of mental health in the UC Irvine community, which includes the Muslim community and other student organizations. The Beautiful Mind Project aims to transcend socio-cultural, political, and physical barriers of stigmatization, while also advocating for social justice initiatives that affect these marginalized communities. The Beautiful Mind Project seeks to accomplish this goal by utilizing Islamic principles as a source of and inspiration for mental wellness. By providing diverse, accessible resources, the Beautiful Mind Project advocates for its members a lifestyle that emphasizes the delicate balance between mental, spiritual, and physical health.

name: The Center for Health Care Management and Policy
description: Our mission is to build stronger ties with the health care community in Orange County and beyond by engaging our partners in collaborative research and education efforts as well as community service programs. Our current activities are in two main areas: Organize annual conference and speaker series to promote discussion of health care economics and current health policy issues.  Contributing to the health care focus within UCI's MBA programs and Executive Education department.

name: The Department of Anthropology
description: Understanding how the social world works.

name: The Fear-Eaters at UCI - TFEUCI
description: A place for people to consume, discuss, discover, learn about, and engage with the horror genre in its many mediums. This includes, but is not limited to films, tv, books, manga, anime, video games, and internet-based mediums. We encourage anyone with any level of 'horror knowledge' or interest in the genre to join us as we dive deep into all things, scary, campy, and weird!

name: The Forge at UCI
description: Empowering builders and changemakers to connect, experiment, and launch ventures that make a real difference. The Forge champions authenticity, mutual support, and the kind of progress born from passion rather than posturing. It is the goal of The Forge to connect project-starters and students set on creating something impactful. A community focused on taking the fluff out of business and entrepreneurship organizations to provide a clean space for people that want to support each other. Value will come with effort and time, so The Forge seeks to give back what members put in, creating an organization that is built around those who join.

name: The Green Initiative Fund
description: Working to ensure undergraduate students are able to create innovative and sustainable projects on our campus.

name: The Patient Project
description: Our mission is to find strength with conversation, community, and, ultimately, patience. We began with the idea of waiting with patients in the hospital waiting room - because no one should have to watch the clock alone. We host speakers and workshops to explore medical narratives, host weekly student-led volunteering at local senior centers, offer pre-health mentorship resources, and also provide other local volunteering opportunities. This is the opportunity to inspire meaningful change through conversational care. See www.patientproject.org for an overview of our core initiatives: conversational care, community journal, and campus collaborations. IG: @patientprojectuciemail: patientproject@uci.eduFB: The Patient Project - UCI

name: The Paul Merage School of Business, PhD in Management
description: The PhD program in the Merage School of Business at the University of California, Irvine offers degrees in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, Marketing, Operations and Decision Technologies, Organization and Management, and Strategy. Our faculty members in these areas publish in high impact business journals such as those on the Financial Times journal list. They also hold positions as journal editors and members of editorial boards, as well as leadership positions in professional business academic associations. We encourage you to explore the profiles of our faculty on our website to get an understanding of their ongoing research. Doctoral education is central to the mission of the Merage School of Business, and faculty members closely mentor PhD students. At the UC Irvine Paul Merage School of Business, applicants to the PhD program are considered carefully as individuals and future research partners. While past performance in business and academic careers are part of this consideration, so is a holistic view of the applicant. Our aim is to assess applicants' full potential to become valued members of the Merage network of global scholars. UC Irvine and the Merage school share a commitment to inclusive excellence. To support initiatives aimed at increasing the future diversity of business school faculty, UC Irvine will waive the PhD application fees for applicants who meet university-wide criteria and for students who have participated in programs focused on diversity. Please feel free to ask about application waivers. We fully fund all admitted students for five years, including a tuition waiver and a stipend to cover living expenses, as a teaching or research assistant. Additionally, we offer very affordable student housing including options for student with and without families. This financial package allows PhD students to fully focus on their research, setting them up for success as future faculty members.Year after year, the Merage School and its programs consistently place among the top rankings nationally and globally. Worldwide, aspirational business leaders choose the Merage School, realizing that this unique combination of curriculum, career advancement, collaboration and most importantly – culture – is nearly unparalleled in peer institutions.The University of California, Irvine is located in sunny Southern California, which allows you to live and study in a beautiful coastal location. Enjoy many nearby opportunities for recreational and cultural activities including beaches, skiing, and hiking, which you can take advantage of during Southern California's average of 281 sunny days per year!

name: The Philosophy Club
description: The Philosophy Club is an open and free space for all students interested in Philosophy. We host a wide array of events on several issues pertaining to Philosophy. Our goal is to transcend the boundaries of academic philosophy and open the space for all issues that foster our growth as inquirers. Moreover, we wish to provide a safe, supportive and welcoming environment for all students. We will maintain trust and an ethos of respect for differing viewpoints. Members are expected to be considerate, open-minded and patient when expressing their views and responding to points-of-view with which they disagree. We aim to have a diverse approach to texts and cultivate an inclusive outlook towards philosophical discussion.  Events, text-based discussions, movie nights, talks, and membership is open to any and all UCI students. No prerequisite knowledge of Philosophy is necessary. Our discussion and events include introductions to initiate students into the topic. To become official members of the club, please attend the club events and approach the team.For Fall 2024 we will be hosting general meetings at 6pm on Mondays.

name: The Shifa Society of Muslim Pre-Health Students
description: The Shifa Society of Muslim Pre-Health Students is a student organization dedicated to the pre-health professional development of members through the abridgment of deen (Islamic religion) with dunya (worldly life) to foster a community of successful health professionals and sustainable Muslims.

name: The Student Pharmacist Class Cabinets (Class of 2026)
description: 1.  Provide a forum for all students to express their needs and concerns.2. Recognize and address these needs and concerns by acting as mediators between faculty and staff and/or act as a repository of resources for the students.3. Represent all students enrolled at the UCI School of Pharmacy and their interests internally within the UCI community and externally.4. Enrich the academic, professional, and social experiences of all students enrolled at the UCI School of Pharmacy through initiatives, services, and events.

name: The Student Pharmacist Class Cabinets (Class of 2027)
description: The Student Pharmacist Class Cabinets (Class of 2027), also known as SPCC2027, aims to serve the students of Doctor of Pharmacy (PharmD) program Class of 2027 as their main student body.

name: The Student Pharmacist Class Cabinets (Class of 2028)
description: The purpose of SPCC Class of 2028 shall be to:1. 2. 3. 4. Provide a forum for all students to express their needs and concerns.Recognize and address these needs and concerns by acting as mediators between allstudents, faculty, and staff and/or act as a repository of resources for the students.Represent all students enrolled at UCI and their interests internally within the UCIcommunity and externally.Enrich the academic, professional, and social experiences of all students enrolled at UCIthrough initiatives, services, and events.

name: The Supper Club
description: We meet regularly to cook and share food with a story. If you're interested in cooking or dining with us, please refer to our website.

name: The William F. Buckley Society. Intercollegiate Studies Institute at UCI
description: The William F. Buckley Jr. Society is a community dedicated to the art of debate and the pursuit of truth through Socratic education, critical thinking, and open discourse.

name: The Women's Network
description: Here at the Women's Network, we are committed to fostering a supportive, non-competitive environment where women uplift one another through intentional communication and meaningful networking. Our mission is to empower women to achieve professional success while cultivating and celebrating their ambition every step of the way.

name: The Young Americans for Freedom at UCI
description: The Young Americans for Freedom at UC Irvine stands as a blazing torch of conservative activism, fearlessly defending the sacred right of free speech, upholding the unyielding pillars of individual liberty, free enterprise, traditional values, and a resolute national defense. In a world shadowed by censorship and conformity, we ignite the Anteater spirit with unapologetic courage, rallying students to champion truth through bold engagement, and forge a legacy of freedom that echoes across generations.

name: Theme Park Engineering & Design Club at UCI - TPED
description: TPED at UCI aims to bridge the gap between engineering, design, and storytelling by fostering an interdisciplinary community of students at UC Irvine. TPED at UCI encourages creativity and problem-solving through workshops, projects, and competitions and offers professional development opportunities by connecting with industry experts and Imagineering professionals.

name: Themed Entertainment Association @ UCI
description: The Themed Entertainment Association aims to introduce people to the professional side of the themed entertainment industry and incubate the existing passions and interests of said industry. While the group is professionally driven, it also welcomes fans of themed entertainment. TEA also wishes to connect other individuals with a greater community that shares the common interest of enjoying and wishing to pursue themed entertainment.

name: Theta Tau
description: Theta Tau is the nation's oldest and largest Fraternity for Engineers. Theta Tau's mission is to develop Engineering Leaders for Service, Professionalism, and Brotherhood.

name: Tomo No Kai (Tomo)
description: In 1977, Tomo No Kai, Association of Friends, was founded as a Japanese/Japanese American social club for UCI students and Staff. It then expanded from being a social club and prides itself in being involved both culturally and in the community. Tomo No Kai members are encouraged to meet others of various backgrounds to develop friendships and support one another. These friendships are strengthened by different social activities such as bonfires, midnight fast food runs, and retreats. Tomo No Kai has also participated in events sponsored by various Nikkei clubs from other schools and throughout the UCI campus. Besides social participation, Tomo also promotes cultural awareness through annual events such as our Mammoth/Manzanar retreat and Cultural Night. Tomo No Kai also holds an annual Day of Remembrance program which commemorates and educates future generations about internment of the Japanese-Americans during World War II. At Tomos general meetings, guest speakers are occasionally invited to speak about significant issues pertaining to the Japanese American community. Members are also encouraged to attend JA conferences such as the JACL Youth Conference. Tomo's dedication to promoting cultural awareness is enhanced by their sister organization Jodaiko (UCI's taiko group), who exemplifies the performance art that is Japanese taiko. Tomo No Kai is the Japanese/Japanese American organization on UC Irvine's campus. It is a place where people can go to make new friends, hang out, serve the community, and participate in many more activities. Japanese culture is a large focus of our organization, and throughout each school year, we have various events that aim to enrich our members with Japanese-American culture. Some of our biggest events during the year are Ballin' at the ARC (basketball tournament), Day of Remembrance (in honor of those interned), Cultural Night (a time to celebrate the beauty of Japanese culture), and our annual Mammoth/Manzanar Trip which gives Tomo No Kai's members a first-hand look at an internment camp. We work closely with Jodaiko and hope to promote Japanese culture and awareness.

name: Totes4Kids
description: Our mission statement is to allow underprivileged children from various child care facilities across Southern California receive relief, a medium of expression, and emotional support. We aim to accomplish this goal by providing these children with access to personalized tote bags, essential supplies, and notes of encouragement.

name: Transfers in BioSci
description: TBS@UCI is an organization dedicated to supporting new and continuing transfer students in the Charlie Dunlop School of Biological Sciences by offering mentorship, community, and opportunities to build up and strengthen themselves, the School, and the UCI community.

name: Triangle Fraternity
description: The purpose of Triangle shall be to maintain a fraternity of engineers, architects and scientists.  It shall carry out its purpose by establishing chapters that develop balanced men who cultivate high moral character, foster lifelong friendships, and live their lives with integrity.

name: Triathlon Club at UCI
description: Triathlon Club welcomes student athletes to train and race together. We encourage participation from all levels of athletic ability. We embrace the multisport lifestyle, emphasizing on three main principles: swim, bike, run!

name: TRIO Scholars
description: The TRIO Scholars Program at UCI – Student Success Initiatives – is a federally funded TRIO Program, awarded by the U.S Department of Education, that was established in 2015. Funded under Title IV of the Higher Education Act of 1965, Student Success Initiatives provides opportunities aimed at enhancing students' academic development, assisting students with their academic progress, and motivating students towards the successful completion of their post-secondary education. TRIO Scholars at UCI (SSI) is funded at $220,000+ annually. Housed within Student Success Initiatives in the Division of Undergraduate Education, TRIO Scholars offers approximately 140 participants academic, social, personal, and career advising and support from orientation until graduation. Participation is based on eligibility requirements.

name: True Jesus Church Irvine Campus Fellowship (TJCICF)
description: TJC ICF is a small but close-knit Christian campus fellowship centered around weekly Bible studies. We also have different activities and outings throughout the year aimed at edifying one another. The campus fellowship is created by members of True Jesus Church and is directly affiliated with church. Beliefs include Water Baptism, Holy Communion, and Footwashing being directly related to one's salvation; keeping the Sabbath (Saturday) holy under grace; praying earnestly for the Holy Spirit and speaking in tongues.

name: Turkish Student Association at UCI
description: The purpose of this organization is to promote Turkish language and culture at the University of California, Irvine (UCI), and to unite Turkish speakers, those who identify as Turkish, and all who would like to learn about Turkish language and culture, regardless of their background.

name: Turning Point USA at UCI
description: We are a conservative youth- organization committed to identify, educate, train, and organize students to promote principles of freedom, fiscal responsibility, free markets, and limited government.

name: U See Eyes (Pre-Optometry Club)
description: The U See Eyes pre-optometry club is designed to help prepare students for admission into optometry school and build a network between members. We aim to provide members with the resources and support to become a competitive applicant through volunteering, shadowing and internship opportunities, leadership, and up-to-date information about the field of optometry. U See Eyes also provides the opportunity for members to meet other aspiring students and connect with each other as well as with current optometry professionals.

name: U.S. Army Reserve Officers' Training Corps
description: Our mission as student leaders at the University of California, Irvine, is to provide cadets the necessary skills and leadership training to become officers in the United States Army, Army Reserve, or Army National Guard; to develop the future officer leadership of the U.S. Army; and to motivate young people to become better citizens.

name: UC Irvine Anteater Band
description: The main purpose of the Band is to support the UC Irvine's Division I intercollegiate athletic teams, be a positive representative of the University and the Athletics department on campus and in the community.

name: UC Irvine Athletics
description: The mission of Intercollegiate Athletics at the University of California, Irvine is to facilitate and enrich the education and personal growth of its students through their participation in competitive NCAA Division I athletics. Intercollegiate Athletics is committed to the welfare of student-athletes and staff, and advocates an environment that promotes excellence in athletic and academic performance, sportsmanship, diversity, and gender equity. Intercollegiate Athletics also supports the University of California's mission of public service and serves to generate a unifying spirit among students, faculty, staff, and alumni that transcends communities, cultures, and generations.

name: UC Irvine Joe C. Wen School of Population & Public Health
description: With a larger and more diverse undergraduate program than almost any other in the country, Wen Public Health is dedicated to the achievement of health equity for all populations through research, practice, and scholarship, to reduce the burden of disease and disability in culturally diverse communities in Southern California and around the world.

name: UC Irvine Spirit Squad
description: The UC Irvine Spirit Squad consists of a co-ed cheer and dance team that represents the highest standard of collegiate spirit leaders. As a UC Irvine Spirit Squad member, you will be directly representing the University of California, Irvine, and UC Irvine Athletics. The main objective of the UC Irvine Spirit Squad is to support all UC Irvine Division I intercollegiate athletic teams, with an emphasis on Men's and Women's Basketball, and serve as University ambassadors to the community.  This can come in the form of campus appearances to support University objectives, or attending community events as part of our community outreach mission. You will have the opportunity to work with other talented performers and choreographers to create and maintain a quality, highly-respected spirit group.

name: UC PRIME Pre-Health Pathways
description: The mission of UC PRIME Pre-Health Pathways (UC3P) is to cultivate a diverse and inclusive community of future healthcare leaders who are equipped with the knowledge, support, and opportunities needed to excel in the health professions. Through our innovative cohort model, we aim to amplify social capital, fostering connections and collaborations that enrich students' experiences and broaden their horizons. UC3P is committed to providing specialized resources that address the unique challenges students may face. Our mission is to bridge the opportunity gap, empowering every student to reach their full potential and contribute meaningfully to the field of healthcare.

name: UCI 3+2 Engineering Program
description: The UC Irvine 3+2 Engineering Program is a two-year academic program that allows students to obtain both a B.S. degree from their home institution and a M.S./Ph.D. degree from the University of California, Irvine while experiencing both the academic and social lives of American students.

name: UCI CalTeach
description: UCI CalTeach is a program for undergraduate science and mathematics majors interested in exploring a career in education. Through our coursework, students learn teaching skills and practice these methods in local K-12 classrooms. CalTeach offers a unique opportunity for students to complete a bachelor's degree concurrently with a California single-subject teaching credential in just four years! The single-subject teachingcredential is for teaching in middle school or high schools only. UCI CalTeach is jointly sponsored by the Schools of Biological Sciences, Physical Sciences, and Education.

name: UCI Campus Recreation
description: To encourage all anteaters to live a fun, active, healthy lifestyle!

name: UCI CampusGroups Tech Support
description: We provide technical support of the CampusGroups platform at UCI.

name: UCI CARE
description: UCI CARE provides free and confidential support services to members of the UCI community who have been impacted by sexual assault, relationship abuse, family violence and/or stalking.  Programs and services are available to people of all identities and regardless of status. UCI CARE aims to end these forms of power-based personal violence by engaging the campus community in education, programming, and transformative action.

name: UCI Center for Student Leadership
description: The Center for Student Leadership is the central hub of student leadership at UCI. The CSL has been designed to support student leadership programming across the campus by serving as a connection point between students seeking opportunities to develop and apply leadership skills and faculty and staff who oversee leadership and development opportunities.The CSL is committed to supporting every student on their leadership journey from orientation through graduation.

name: UCI Chemistry
description: The Department of Chemistry is committed to providing undergraduate and graduate students with world-class education and training while pushing the frontiers of knowledge through cutting-edge research.We are committed to excellence through inclusion and diversity. We welcome, respect, and are strengthened by our diversity as women, men, and people of all gender identities, gender expressions, and sexual orientations. We benefit from our common humanity, as well as our differences in race, ethnicity, age, national origins, socioeconomic backgrounds, abilities, religions, and points of view.

name: UCI College Corps
description: UC Irvine is proud to be among 45 statewide campuses selected for the inaugural #CaliforniansForAll College Corps program.Students who are accepted into the College Corps program at UC Irvine for the 2022-23 academic year will engage in community-serving opportunities while also receiving financial compensation and other benefits.Governor Newsom's unprecedented investment in college service aims to create debt-free college pathways for low-income students to tackle our greatest challenges and serve our communities.  Led by California Volunteers and the California Office of the Governor, the College Corps program has three priorities across the state:To engage college students in meaningful service to build leadership and civic responsibilityTo promote academic success and economic well-being with students from diverse backgroundsTo support the work of community-based organizations in key local priorities, food insecurity and climate action.

name: UCI Compass Community of Practice
description: At UCI, we’re fostering a data culture that enhances the entire student experience through data-driven decision-making. Through the implementation of a community of practice framework, we are empowering all faculty and staff with cutting-edge tools, immersive workshops, compelling case studies, and peer support forums that address technical systems/software/concepts.

name: UCI Counseling Center
description: Mission The UCI Counseling Center is committed to delivering quality services that help students achieve optimal mental health for academic success, personal growth, and increased capacity to cope with the stresses of being a university student. The Counseling Center also provides training and learning opportunities to prepare future leaders in mental health and other service-oriented positions.VisionThe vision of the Counseling Center is to elevate the student experience and create pathways to success through a wide range of multiculturally based clinical, outreach, prevention, and training services. The Counseling Center is guided by the following values:Values:•	Service •	Community•	Inclusion & Advocacy•	Integrity & Accountability

name: UCI DigiFilm
description: UCI DigiFilm is the hub for diverse voices, diverse stories and creative film production. The Minor in Digital Filmmaking gives students across campus the skills to create sophisticated time-based media projects and learn advanced skills in film production at UC Irvine. The program is a hybrid of traditional and creative approaches with emphasis is on the production of new films for delivery online. With the Minor, Undergraduate students have the opportunity to produce their own works that contribute to the future of film as an art form.

name: UCI Dining Services
description: To provide all our customers with a first in class experience and the highest quality services and programs that ease a student's transition through the university and in the community.

name: UCI Division of Continuing Education
description: The UCI Division of Continuing Education (DCE) is dedicated to serving our global student community by providing highly valued, innovative and practical learning experiences that promote personal and professional success at any stage of life. With a commitment to integrity, quality, accountability, and personal leadership, our team fosters an inclusive, collaborative environment to empower and transform the lives of our students and each other.

name: UCI Division of Continuing Education - Education Department
description: The UCI Division of Continuing Education (DCE) is dedicated to serving our global student community by providing highly valued, innovative and practical learning experiences that promote personal and professional success at any stage of life. With a commitment to integrity, quality, accountability, and personal leadership, our team fosters an inclusive, collaborative environment to empower and transform the lives of our students and each other.

name: UCI DREAM Center
description: The UCI DREAM Center’s mission is to support those impacted by the immigration system and who experience educational barriers as a result of their immigration status through advancing systemic change, deconstructing oppressive policies, and fostering community. We work towards personal growth, collective healing, and visible change. The DREAM Center is a welcoming space for all students, staff, and faculty.

name: UCI Esports
description: UCI Esports was the first official esports program at a top tier research institution, and is regarded as one of the best and most comprehensive in the world. UCI is building a global hub for esports - where academia and industry collaborate to improve competition, advance research, engage diverse communities, create entertainment, and launch careers.

name: UCI Global Cultures
description: “The mission of the Global Cultures group is to foster a deeper understanding and appreciation of diverse cultures across the world.  Through interdisciplinary study, open dialogue, and experiential learning, we aim to promote global awareness, empathy, and cross-cultural collaboration.  By exploring the rich traditions, values, and histories of various societies, we prepare students to be culturally competent leaders and engaged global citizens, committed to fostering inclusivity and mutual respect in an interconnected world.”

name: UCI HD-CARE
description: UCI HD-CARE is a University of California Irvine support group with one primary goal:To advance Huntington's Disease research and clinical care at UC Irvine.

name: UCI International Center
description: The International Center facilitates international engagement at UCI to enhance the academic and personal experience of the international community. The International Center staff is committed to serving the campus community through advising, immigration services, programming, advocacy, and outreach.

name: UCI Labor Center
description: Welcome to the UCI Labor Center! Workers are at the center of our outward-facing programs, research, and labor education. Through our work, we tackle the economic and social challenges facing working people and their families, raise up their accomplishments, and connect to their struggles for dignity and respect on the job.

name: UCI Law Admissions
description: UCI Law seeks to create the ideal law school by training lawyers for the practice of law at the highest levels of the profession.  The law school has a national reputation, with renowned professors and administrators drawn from the finest law schools in the country.

name: UCI Libraries
description: - Partner with the UCI community to advance transformative research, teaching and learning excellence, and high-quality patient care by embedding experts and resources where knowledge is created and connections happen.- Preserve the cultural/historical/scientific record and ensure that services and collections express excellence in scholarship.-  Leverage expertise and resources to provide an inclusive environment that promotes intellectual pursuit and creativity while instilling strong information research skills and a thirst for knowledge that will last a lifetime.- Teach critical thinking and evaluation skills to prepare students for lifelong learning, success in their future careers, and to be informed citizens in our world.

name: UCI Math Graduate Programs
description: UCI Math Graduate Programs

name: UCI Neurodiversity Support Group
description: We are the UCI Neurodiversity Support Group. Neurodiversity describes the notion that people interpret and interact with the world in diverse ways, that there is no one single right way to think, learn, or behave, and that the spectrum of this diversity should not be viewed as deficits. The goal of the UCI Neurodiversity Project is to support the efforts of neurodiverse or neurodivergent individuals to succeed in the physical sciences. We seek to promote the success of neurodiverse individuals in the physical sciences. This group is inclusive of students and postdocs at all levels and seeks to provide support to those that identify as having neurodivergent traits, including autism spectrum disorder (ASD), attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), and other neurological or developmental disorders or learning disabilities.

name: UCI Office of the Ombuds
description: The Office of the Ombuds pledges to:•	Adhere to the Standards of Practice of the International Ombuds Association, which consist of the principles of confidentiality, informality, impartiality and independence•	Be committed to the pursuit of equity and fairness•	Provide all members of the UCI community a safe place to talk about concerns, explore options, and make informed decisions•	Persist in building and preserving collaborative relationships with whom we work•	Identify campus trends and provide upward feedback•	Hold ourselves to the highest ethical standards to earn and maintain the trust and respect of those we serve

name: UCI Office of Undergraduate Admissions - Campus Representative Program
description: The purpose of this organization shall be Campus Representatives are students affiliated with the Office of Undergraduate Admissions. Campus Representatives share their unique student experiences through campus tours, college fairs, student and counselor panels, and campus-wide yield events. Our mission is to provide up-to-date information about UC Irvine to enhance the guest experience and welcome any and all to feel safe and informed, creating a positive, lasting impression of the university.

name: UCI Paul Merage School of Business
description: Develop globally-competitive transformational leaders in a diverse, collaborative, student-centric community where academic excellence and practical application coalesce.

name: UCI Police Department Community Service Officers
