description: Our Mission, Vision, and Values at the UCI Police Department are the guiding principles we rely upon to effectively serve our community.Our dedicated personnel are the foundation of our department. Our values are demonstrated by their daily service and actions through prevention, intervention, education, and enforcement. Our mission,"To serve in partnership with our community, supporting a safe and inclusive University" fully embraces our community oriented policing philosophy and brings that philosophy to reality through partnerships and service. Our vision leads our personnel to strive for only the highest standards of ethics and excellence in all they do.

name: UCI Program in Public Health Student Volunteer Core
description: The mission of the Public Health Student Volunteer Core (PHSVC) is to serve our community partner organizations and the UCI campus to improve community health and well-being. The PHSVC is an organization aimed at mobilizing students for Public Health research and volunteer opportunities. PHSVC originated from Dean Bernadette Boden-Albala's student research group called the Social Epidemiology and Research in Community Health Lab. There are many community-based research projects and Public Health campus initiatives spearheaded by Dean Boden-Albala that are great opportunities for students who are interested in peer to peer health education, social epidemiology, cardio-metabolic disease prevention, health equity, community health, community-engagement, community-based participatory research and working with grass-roots community organizations.

name: UCI Public Safety Advisory Committee
description: The Public Safety Advisory Committee (PSAC) proactively seeks the advice and counsel from a diverse group of community members regarding issues that impact the safety and quality of life of students, faculty, staff, and visitors of the UCI campus and Medical Center.

name: UCI Samueli School of Engineering
description: About the SchoolFounded in 1965, the Henry Samueli School of Engineering educates more than 4,600 students (3,728 undergraduates and 961 graduates) with an integrative approach that blends fundamentals, research and hands-on experience. The school's aim is to unleash innovation, create opportunities and inspire ingenuity. The Samueli School's faculty members are leaders in their disciplines who have achieved worldwide recognition for their research and dedicated teaching. The school includes six academic departments: biomedical engineering; chemical and biomolecular engineering; civil and environmental engineering; electrical engineering and computer science; materials science and engineering; and mechanical and aerospace engineering. Under the leadership of Dean Gregory Washington, the school pursues research that is timely, socially responsible and cutting edge, and works in partnership with industry and state and federal agencies to promote the transfer of research to applications that benefit society. Current research thrusts include Communications and Information Technology, Energy and Sustainability, Human Health, and Advanced Manufacturing and Materials.MissionTo advance engineering discovery through the creation of original scholarship and research applied to societal grand challenges, to educate and train the next generation of global engineering innovators, and to provide a technological edge to industry by facilitating technology transfer and talent acquisition.VisionWe aspire to be among the premier public engineering programs in the nation, while continuing to emphasize a personal approach that is distinctive in fostering human connections and rich in experiential learning opportunities. We aim to be a top-25 school at the forefront of cultivating knowledgeable, passionate engineers dedicated to solutions-oriented engineering.

name: UCI Samueli School of Engineering Professional Programs
description: To advance engineering discovery through the creation of original scholarship and research applied to societal grand challenges, to educate and train the next generation of global engineering innovators, and to provide a technological edge to industry by facilitating technology transfer and talent acquisition.Our Professional Programs do this by going beyond technical training and preparing graduates for employment in industry. We equip students to maximize career opportunities.The UCI Samueli School of Engineering offers two professional degrees. The Master of Engineering, which offers three concentrations in Biomedical Engineering, Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, and Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering, and the Master of Embedded and Cyber-Physical Systems.

name: UCI Scholarships
description: To support the University of California, Irvine and its diverse, talented, and ambitious student body by cultivating scholarship opportunities to further individual growth and interests that meets the societal needs. Through engagement with students, as well as collaboration with campus and community partners, the Scholarships Unit strives to support access to a world class education.

name: UCI School of Medicine - Communications
description: The UCI School of Medicine Communications and Public Relations department is a full-service communications support team working on behalf of the Office of the Dean. We are responsible for overseeing and implementing communications to media and internal stakeholders, including faculty, staff and students, and to the community as a whole.

name: UCI Staff Assembly
description: Statement of purpose: The purpose of Staff Assembly is to promote the interests of the staff and to bolster communications between staff and the administration; To provide input to the decision-making process on issues affecting staff and the University; and to support and develop activities which serve UCI, the community, and the University.

name: UCI Student Affairs
description: Student Affairs is dedicated to enriching the student experience from outreach and orientation through graduation by providing comprehensive programs, services, and opportunities for students to    Complement and enhance their academic success    Prepare for leadership in a global society    Develop and strengthen personal, social, and professional skills    Support their physical and mental health and wellnessStudent Affairs serves to support the University of California's mission of teaching, research, and public service, and to enhance the quality of student life, leadership and character excellence.The division also serves to promote the general welfare of the campus community within the framework of the UCI values of respect, intellectual curiosity, integrity, commitment, empathy, appreciation and fun.

name: Student Life and Leadership
description: Student Life & Leadership supports the intellectual, personal, social and professional development of all students. Student Life & Leadership offers education and skill development opportunities that enhance academic success and prepare students for their leadership roles in a diverse, dynamic, and global society.

name: UCI Esports
description: UCI Esports was the first official esports program at a top tier research institution, and is regarded as one of the best and most comprehensive in the world. UCI is building a global hub for esports - where academia and industry collaborate to improve competition, advance research, engage diverse communities, create entertainment, and launch careers.

name: UCI Student Center & Event Services
description: To enrich the student experience by offering an inclusive space designed for interaction, learning, and engagement. Provide exceptional event services and employment opportunities that support the broader educational goals of our campus community.

name: UCI Student Housing
description: Student centered communities that promote academic success, safety and wellness, personal development, and engagement.

name: Graduate and Family Housing
description: Student Housing strives to create student centered communities that promote academic success, safety and wellness, personal development and engagement.

name: Palo Verde Housing Community
description: Student Housing strives to create student centered communities that promote academic success, safety and wellness, personal development and engagement.

name: UCI Study Abroad Center
description: The mission of the Study Abroad Center is to foster a culture at UCI in which study abroad is expected and achievable for all students.The Center assists students in participating in programs abroad that offer unique academic opportunities, international learning and personal development while making progress toward their UCI degree. We also support our international reciprocity and exchange students so as to enhance their academic and personal experiences in the U.S. We aim to ensure that our students' study abroad experiences help them affect positive change in the world, both locally and globally.

name: UCI Sue & Bill Gross School of Nursing
description: At the UCI Sue & Bill Gross School of Nursing, we dedicate ourselves to the education of nursing professionals who will improve patient care and promote population health, locally and globally.  We strive to produce leaders in research, education, and clinical practice who will champion collaborative, compassionate, and interdisciplinary evidence-based practice.

name: UCI Susan Samueli Integrative Health Institute
description: To transform healthcare through the practice of integrative health by conducting rigorous research, promoting evidence-based treatment modalities, educating the public on wellbeing practices, providing individualized, patient-centered clinical care and providing services to the community that focus on obtaining optimal health.

name: UCI Sustainability Resource Center
description: The UCI Sustainability Resource Center (SRC) is a hub for students, providing resources, education, and programming to forward environmental balance, economic vitality, and social equity. Students, as well as campus and community partners, are invited to share a platform from which to address the root causes of ecological disruption, deepen understandings of the interdependence of all life, and engage the challenges and solutions of sustainability in a campus, community, and global context.

name: UCI Transfer Center
description: The Transfer Student Center (TSC) works with all transfer students to facilitate their transition and overall success at UCI. The Transfer Student Center directs students to appropriate campus programs and services. We also organize weekly workshops, provide formal and informal mentoring, and provide students with a space for studying. The Transfer Student Center strives to foster a sense of community among the transfers at UCI and advocates for them in order to enhance their academic and social experience. TSC works closely with Tau Sigma National Honor Society and provides guidance in this organization’s work to advocate and support transfer students at UCI.

name: UCI Transportation & Distribution Services
description: Transportation and Distribution Services does much more than just sell parking permits. T&DS has an environmental commitment and legal mandate to reduce greenhouse gas emissions from all vehicles traveling on and around the UCI campus. This commitment is at the heart of every program and service we offer. Programs to reduce costs and emissions benefit our customers and our campus community in many ways, although some are not readily apparent. Some programs offer direct subsidies or reduced costs, and other save resources in other ways, and, ultimately we all benefit.

name: UCI, The Paul Merage School of Business, Specialty Masters Program
description: Agility is key to survival in our rapidly changing global economy. The Paul Merage School of Business develops and equips leaders with critical business and leadership skills needed to succeed through programs that are continually adapted to address the ever-changing social, technological and economic opportunities and challenges in our digitally driven world. We offer four dynamic Specialty Masters programs: Master of Professional Accountancy, Master of Finance, Master of Science in Business Analytics and Master of Innovation and Entrepreneurship that focus on creative and critical thinking skills, strategic decision-making, leadership, innovation, and collaboration through in-class and on-site experiences with real-world business problems.

name: UCI-OC Alliance
description: The mission of the UCI-OC Alliance is to advance UC Irvine as a Latino/a-thriving university through engaging and supporting Latino/a students, faculty and staff. Established in 2021, the UCI-OC Alliance supports UC Irvine as a Hispanic-thriving university. The UCI-OC Alliance serves Orange County by connecting local leaders and businesses with UC Irvine to advance Latino/a students through:MentorshipsScholarshipsInternshipsProgram supportCorporate partnershipsSpecial events and initiativesNetworking opportunities

name: Undergraduate Business Association (UBA)
description: The Undergraduate Business Association (UBA) at UC Irvine is a student-led organization open to all students regardless of major and year. UBA aims to provide students with countless opportunities to explore career interests in business from a variety of industries through our professional events and to foster personal and professional development through our mentorship programs and social events. UBA's executive board reflects a diverse background of individuals who strive to make sure every UBA member has a pleasant and rewarding experience.

name: Undergraduate Finance Association
description: The Undergraduate Finance Association strives to assist students in attaining their career goals in the financial field. We are a professional student organization dedicated to providing students with the knowledge, resources, and opportunities that will allow them to excel in the field of finance. Our members hail from a wide range of disciplines, such as Business and Quantitative Economics, Math, and Engineering, as well as Accounting and Management. Our members have the chance to interact with speakers and peers who share a similar passion for finance. UFA provides students with a unique education and networking opportunities, which will dovetail them into successful interviews and work performance at financial firms.   Our mission is to provide students with the necessary tools and skills to secure internships and begin their careers in the finance industry. We ensure appropriate guidance for students to reach their specific goals through: Seeking internship opportunities within and outside our corporate network  Providing networking and recruitment opportunities with the local insurance, consulting, and investment community, including investment funds, financial advisors, banks, and investment banks Incorporating different levels of involvement ranging from workshops to hands-on student management of an Investment Fund Taking advantage of the knowledge and guidance of Paul Merage faculty MBA student advisors.   We work closely with the UCI Career Center, Paul Merage Business School, and the UCI Economics Department to create professional, educational, and networking opportunities for our members.

name: Undergraduate Mathematics Committee (formerly Faces in Mathematics)
description: Undergradute Mathematics Committee’s mission is to foster and sustain an inclusive community for all undergraduates interested in pursuing mathematics at University of California, Irvine.

name: Undergraduate MD-PhD Society at UC Irvine
description: The Undergraduate MD/PhD Society (UMPS) at UC Irvine is a chapter of a student-led 501(c)(3) nonprofit dedicated to empowering all undergraduate students—especially those who are underserved or underrepresented—to pursue MD/PhD, MD, PhD, and other graduate-level careers in medicine and science. With over 1,200 members across UC San Diego, UCLA, and UC Irvine, UMPS provides clinical training, research preparation, mentorship, and leadership opportunities to help students thrive on their path to advanced study.

name: Undergraduate Public Health Association at UCI
description: The purpose of the Public Health Association is to explore and raise awareness of various occupational paths  related to the field of public health, and to allow those interested in public health to meet other students with similar class schedules and career interests. Unique volunteer and internship positions are also promoted to members.

name: Undergraduate Research Opportunities Program (UROP)
description: UROP’s mission is to help integrate undergraduate students into UCI’s vibrant research culture. By motivating undergraduates to participate in faculty-mentored research projects and creative activities, UROP offers students the chance to personalize and expand their education while developing skills that will serve them throughout their lives and careers. Through our support, we strive to make research accessible and attainable to students of all backgrounds and fields of study. UROP empowers students to collaborate with their peers, faculty, and industry representatives, working to cultivate a diverse community by equipping students with the academic, personal, and career readiness skills needed to succeed at UCI and beyond.

name: Undergraduate/Undeclared Advising Program
description: The Undergraduate/Undeclared Advising Program assists new first-year and lower-division transfer students without a declared major in fostering a successful transition to UCI and creating informed decisions about their educational and career goals.Students who enter UCI as first or second-years may be uncertain about what major to choose and may not feel ready to declare. Such students may choose to participate in the Undergraduate/Undeclared Advising Program.In order to make an informed decision and foster clear educational and career goals, students not only have to know about the degrees UCI has to offer, but also be aware of their own abilities and interests. Students in the Undergraduate/Undeclared Advising Program participate in a variety of programs that are designed to provide students with the information and experience they need to make the most of their academic career at UCI.DON'T BE UNPREPARED… BE UNDERGRADUATE/UNDECLARED!

name: Underground AZN Players
description: Underground AZN Players at UCI is the first student-run AANHPI theatre company spotlighting Asian American, Asian, Native Hawaiian, and Pacific Islander artists in the Anteater community in three ways:1) Producing live theatre performances – including fully staged productions, new play readings, and special workshops showcasing diverse “AZN” voices – for the entire UC Irvine community. 2) Advocating on behalf of students for increased representation of AANHPI artists and narratives in CTSA’s mainstage productions and programming, as the only student-run Asian-American and Asian Affinity Drama Group at UCI Arts.3) Creating events and conversations around socio-political intersections of culture, new performance practices, and authentic storytelling in collaboration with other student groups, faculty initiatives, and professional theatre companies. Through our annual AANHPI Theatre Festival & Open Mic, as well as new play development and fully student-initiated programming, Underground AZN Players continues to celebrate and uplift cross-cultural work across the entire UC Irvine campus, bringing “AZN” student groups and our allies into a safer and stronger community, together.

name: Underground Scholars Initiative
description: Our aim is to outreach to and increase retention rates of formerly incarcerated UCI students by connecting them with the resources, and information that may help to increase those students' prospects of success. We strive to provide a space of solidarity, encouragement, wellness, and growth. We only have the insurance provided by the university. We are affiliates of the Underground Scholars Initiative at Cal Berkely, UCLA, and UC Davis.

name: Underground Scholars Program
description: The UCI Underground Scholars Program creates a pathway for incarcerated, formerly incarcerated and system-impacted individuals into higher education.

name: Underrepresented Genders in Physics and Astronomy (UNITY) (formerly Women in Physics and Astronomy at UCI)
description: Underrepresented Genders in Physics and Astronomy (UNITY) is a representative body for all folks whose gender identities and/or experiences of gender have been historically marginalized in physics and astronomy at the undergraduate and graduate levels and beyond. Our overarching goal is to create a more diverse community and a supportive environment in physics and astronomy at UCI.

name: Underwater Robotics Project at UCI
description: The mission of the Underwater Robotics Project at the University of California, Irvine is to design, build, and operate autonomous underwater robotic systems in the Robosub International Competition while providing students with rigorous, hands-on experience in robotics, autonomy, and engineering systems.The organization aims to advance student education in mechanical, electrical, and software engineering through real-world application, interdisciplinary collaboration. URP @ UCI seeks to foster innovation, technical excellence, teamwork, and professional development while representing UCI in the global robotics community.

name: Unheard Cries at UCI
description: We strive to put a dent in Middle Eastern and African poverty by providing humanitarian aid and tools for empowerment.

name: UNICEF (United Nations Children's Fund) at UCI
description: UNICEF at UCI is a branch of a larger student-led grassroots movement by the United Nations Children's Fund [UNICEF]. At UNICEF at UCI, there are ample numbers of opportunities to advocate, aid and raise awareness for underserved children and mothers throughout the community and around the world.  UNICEF works in more than 190 countries and territories to save and improve children's lives by providing health care and immunizations, clean water and sanitation, nutrition, education, emergency relief and more. UNICEF at UCI upholds these values and goals through community service, fundraising, and awareness on our campus and local community. Together, we are working toward the day when ZERO children die from preventable causes and every child has a safe and healthy childhood without exploitation, discrimination or violence.

name: UniConn
description: At UniConn, our mission is to create meaningful connections that empower students to thrive academically, socially, and personally. We provide a safe and inclusive platform where students can build friendships, find compatible roommates, join communities, and discover opportunities that reflect their identities and interests. By bridging the gaps between people, organizations, and resources, UniConn strengthens campus life and fosters a culture of belonging, collaboration, and growth.

name: Unique Representation of Movement (formerly Urban Motus)
description: Unique Representation of Movement (URMO) is a family dedicated to growth and individual expression through movement. Our goal is to uphold the history of dance culture and our team's passion for artistry in an inclusive space to foster the purest representation of ourselves.

name: United Korean American Leaders
description: Our mission is to gather as many members around us who are Korean or those who are interested in the culture of Korea and help them find people who share the same hobbies or interests and support them with many different events.

name: United Nations Association of the United States of America at UCI
description: Our chapter of UNA-USA will be committed to educating ourselves and others on the goals of the United Nations and localizing these goals to our community. Through collaboration and community service, we will spread our knowledge and insight to better support those in need.

name: United States Institute for Theatre Technology Student Chapter at UCI
description: The purpose of this organization is to promote technical theatre education through lessons, mentorship, workshops, and hands-on practice. We aim to provide opportunities for professional development, networking, and education. In providing hands-on technical education, we also aim to support the production of student produced shows by providing technical work and support for under supported productions.

name: Uniting Voices (UV)
description: Founded in 1994, Uniting Voices has grown from cultural-club choir to the premiere all-gender a cappella group at UCI. Inspired by the power of storytelling and diversity, their talent and hard work have taken them far beyond their humble roots. In just the last few years, the group has been a three-time Best A Cappella Group winner in UCI's annual talent show, Soulstice, a two-time competitor in the Los Angeles A Cappella Festival (LAAF), and the first group to advance to the ICCA Semifinals in UCI Aca-History. In the past years, the group's performances have earned them Best Overall Performance and People's Choice at Soulstice as well as multiple placements in the ICCA Semifinals. As they reach new heights, Uniting Voices continues to captivate audiences with their diverse strengths and shared passion for creating art through a cappella.

name: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles at UCI (formerly UAVs at UCI)
description: We are a club dedicated to creating a welcoming community of RC aviation enthusiasts and beginners at the University of California, Irvine.Our aim is to make it easy for students to find a place where they can hang out, connect with fellow enthusiasts, and take to the skies with their UAVs. Whether you're an experienced pilot or new to the hobby.

name: Urban & Environmental Planning & Policy PhD Program
description: Today's complex environmental, social and urban issues are best understood by researchers who can work across disciplinary boundaries, and who understand the relationship of research to action. The Urban and Environmental Planning and Policy (UEPP) doctoral program at UCI trains scholars in the analysis of social problems related to the built, natural, and institutional environments. The UEPP Ph.D. is based on the department's internationally prominent research and teaching strengths in environmental policy, urban and community development and design.

name: Urban Planners of Color
description: UPOC seeks to enrich the educational experience for students in the MURP program at UCI by serving as a liaison between student members of color and the professional and academic communities of planning. UPOC's core values are passion, fun, innovation, intellectualism, curiosity, collaboration, and community service.

name: Urban Studies Student Association (USSA)
description: The purpose of Urban Studies Student Association is to create a support system for UCI undergraduate students who are interested in the field of Urban Studies. USSA strives to provide its members with educational networking opportunities and professional development to enhance their academic experience at UCI.

name: Venture Capital Society at UCI
description: To educate and empower UCI students by providing practical experience, mentorship, collaboration with industry professionals and networking opportunities in the venture capital field, thereby enhancing their understanding and engagement in the private equity ecosystem.

name: Vermillion Vocalists
description: Established in 2009, Vermillion Vocalists, also known as VeVo, is a coed a cappella group at the University of California, Irvine dedicated to musical excellence. They are comprised of diverse and talented individuals, united with a shared passion, dedication, and love of music-making. Likewise, they have a similarly diverse taste in repertoire, ranging from classic hits to today's chart toppers in genres such as pop, hip hop, and R&B.

name: Vertical Flight Society at UCI
description: As a student chapter of The Vertical Flight Society at UCI, we aim to bridge the gap between industry and academia by hosting guest speakers, networking events, company tours, technical workshops, and student competitions. VFS is an international non-profit organization working to advance vertical flight technology. We aim to engage and educate student members in this field, preparing them for careers as professional engineers. We are committed to cultivating leadership skills and encouraging innovation, creativity, and teamwork among our members.

name: Veteran Services Center
description: The Veterans Services Center (VSC) supports the success of all military-connected students, including veterans, reservists, National Guard, active duty, and their dependents.

name: Video Game Development Club
description: The Video Game Development Club (VGDC) at UC Irvine is devoted to providing community and resources to student game developers. We facilitate opportunities to explore their interests and passions through quarterly student-led game projects, game jams, department workshops, industry speakers, social activities, hardware, and software resources. Whether acting on an interest, or in pursuit of a career, all are welcome, as each and every voice is valuable and contributes to making games what they are.

name: Vietnamese Student Association (VSA)
description: VSA strives to preserve and promote the Vietnamese culture at UCI through creative and entertaining weekly meetings and by offering a wide range of social and cultural activities geared towards varying member talents and interests.

name: Violence Intervention & Prevention Program (VIP)
description: In collaboration with UCI CARE, the Violence Intervention and Prevention (VIP) program is an ongoing initiative that enables SFL members to come together and educate themselves on and support their chapter on topics related to harm-reduction and power-based violence. Representatives from each fraternity and sorority act as VIP Chairs to facilitate various awareness programs for their chapter members and for the overall community. Through activities, conversations, and guest speakers, VIP Chairs will explore topics including bystander intervention, healthy relationships, trauma-informed response, and university resources.The VIP program is comprised of community leaders committed to personal growth and empowerment but individuals who are trained by campus and community professionals who develop practical experience in counseling and educational programming.

name: Visions for Change-VZNS
description: The mission of Visions for Change is to provide a platform for mentors and mentees to work together in a family-like structure to propose and implement advocacy projects that promote sustainability, student wellness, and positive change for UCI students. Mentors and mentees will have the creative freedom to pitch and develop project ideas to make a change in students' undergraduate experience. Our club prides itself on promoting student wellness and fostering a supportive community where members can develop their interpersonal and professional skills. The skills that mentors and mentees will learn through this program can be applied in all careers, while also giving them the opportunity to contribute to initiatives that they are passionate about. In addition to project development, club members will have the opportunity to participate in professional development workshops, in addition to collaborating and learning from UCI staff and other professionals to gain information regarding ways to enhance the quality of their advocacy projects. Overall, all members of Visions for Change should be working towards addressing short-comings in the UCI undergraduate experience and work towards eliminating these through heart-felt and well-developed community-based projects.

name: VocaLotus A Cappella
description: VocaLotus is a diverse, coed a cappella group at the University of California, Irvine. Our goal is to grow and perform in a collaborative and uplifting singing environment, while creating a close-knit community.

name: Voces
description: Through a wide selection of diverse repertoire, Voces aspires to inspire audiences twelve months a year. Our choirs travel throughout the LA area and Orange County area singing in churches, public stages, and high schools, acting as university ambassadors and inspiring through music. During the summer, members have the opportunity to travel internationally and experience musical and cultural immersion, displaying their passion for music and bringing their musical gifts home to the UCI community.

name: Volunteer Income Tax Assistance at UCI
description: VITA at UCI offers free income tax return assistance to those in need in the community. We provide assistance to people in need, including low-income people, limited English-speaking people, people with disabilities, and senior people. We serve UCI students, staff, and the nearby communities in need of tax assistance. We help people to correctly file their income tax returns and to understand their tax benefits, which help people to keep their hard-earned money because of our free tax filing service and being able to use every available tax benefit. We also offer UCI students opportunities to contribute to the community and gain hands-on experience.

name: Wayfinder Incubator
description: Wayfinder is a highly structured incubator, through UCI Beall Applied Innovation, that connects UC-affiliated startups with essential resources needed to launch, grow and succeed.Housed inside the Cove @ UCI, our collaborative team of business leaders, entrepreneurs, investors and technology transfer experts eat, sleep and drink innovation. Using our combined experience, we help fine-tune a strategic process that leads innovation with both commercial promise and the potential to meet real needs, from formation to funding.

name: Innovation Advisors
description: The Innovation Advisor network is a group of local business leaders who volunteer their time to support the development of the UCI Beall Applied Innovation entrepreneurial ecosystem. The goals of the Innovation Advisor network are to increase the likelihood of success of UCI-affiliated ventures by providing insightful and actionable guidance and mentorship to individuals and teams and to foster engagement between the University and the local entrepreneurial community to accelerate the commercialization of University innovations.

name: We (Skin)Care at UCI
description: We (Skin)care at UCI is an organization that is passionate about educating students on the necessity of skincare as a form of self-care. With in-depth research and guidance on the wide range of skincare products offered by many brands, we hope to promote positive changes in students' everyday skincare and self-care behaviors. In order to do this, we will arrange for guest speakers to educate our members, have a strong social media presence to publicly promote our beliefs and skincare tips, and provide members with the opportunity to practice good hygiene and skincare habits.

name: Well-being and Nutrition Club at UCI
description: We wanted to create a space where students from all backgrounds could come together and collaborate on recipe sharing, healthy snack making, goal setting, learning about our beautiful bodies, and finding balance among the chaos of student life. Being in University can make it extremely difficult to find a place where we can center ourselves. It can quickly become overwhelming adhering to the demands of school, family, society… you name it. Don’t jeopardize the connection you have with yourself!We encourage you to step back, and explore the principles of nutrition and its relationship to wellbeing. Through us you will enjoy learning about balanced dieting and clean produce, gut health, emotional growth, culture, and self love. We hope to implement some of the science based principles we have been practicing that will promote your definition of happiness and wellbeing.

name: Wellness, Health & Counseling Services
description: The mission of the Wellness, Health & Counseling Services cluster is to support the campus' goal of being first in class by providing services that support students' physical and mental health and wellness to enhance their academic success. We believe that academic excellence is facilitated when students have a strong mind, a healthy body, an enlivened spirit and a clear aspiration, nurtured in a supportive environment.

name: West African Dance Group at UCI - WADG
description: The West African Dance Group (WADG) was founded by beautiful, illustrious, and creative African women on the UCI campus in 2008. WADG dancers are a mix of dancers from different African diaspora. We are an organization that embraces our culture and beauty while exuding and promoting confidence through movement. Our take on Afro-Fusion/ Afrobeat dance makes us feel empowered and is our gift to ourselves and others.

name: West Coast Credible Messengers at UCI
description: West Coast Credible Messengers at UCI is dedicated to fostering positive change and reducing recidivism by empowering individuals with lived experiences in the criminal legal system to become credible messengers of hope, inspiration, and transformation. Through mentoring, education, and community engagement, we aim to break the cycle of incarceration and support individuals in leading productive and fulfilling lives.

name: Women and Youth Supporting Each Other (WYSE)
description: WYSE mentors provide group and one-on-one mentoring by meeting individually with their assigned mentee(s) for a portion of the weekly group session as well as calling their mentee(s) once a week and going on outings.  Each weekly session provides education using the WYSE Curriculum which is made up of three units: Self Awareness and Self-Confidence Building, Sexual Health and Decision Making, and Broader Womxn's Issues and Future Options.   The WYSE mission is to provide girls with the information, resources, and support necessary to make informed decisions about relationships, sexuality and their futures and to create community change.   WYSE mentors at Scholarship Prep in Santa Ana.

name: Women in CyberSecurity Student Chapter at UCI - WiCyS
description: The mission of the WiCyS Student Chapter is to build a community within the University of California Irvine (UCI) that promotes women's education, participation, and leadership in the field of cybersecurity. The WiCyS Student Chapter is organized with the following purposes: 1. To decrease the gender disparity in cybersecurity.2. To provide education, mentorship, and networking support to students through the WiCyS community.3. To promote and recruit women in cybersecurity workforce through UCI.

name: Women in Information and Computer Sciences
description: Our vision is to encourage women to pursue a college degree and a successful career in the the fields pertaining to Information and Computer Sciences, and to provide them with the support to achieve these goals.

name: Women in Law Association
description: To provide active members with opportunities to learn about women in the legal field, law enforcement, and related fields as well as current issues. To provide an engaging setting for members to meet others with similar interests and/or career goals. And to provide a safe environment for individuals to feel comfortable and supported while learning and participating in all aspects of the organization.

name: Women in Leadership at UCI- WIL
description: Women in Leadership is an undergraduate student organization whose purpose is to bring together a community of students at UCI that is interested in the opportunities and potential of women in leadership and business. Open to all majors and backgrounds, our club provides opportunities for our members to connect with successful leaders in our society from a wide variety of fields. Empowering women to believe in themselves and their dreams, our club also promotes leadership opportunities for members to give back to the community.

name: Women in Science Society
description: The mission of this organization is committed to establishing an environment of motivation and mutual support for women pursuing their degree in the sciences, technology, engineering, and mathematics by providing, networking, service, camaraderie, and leadership opportunities for our members.

name: Women in Technology at UCI
description: To create a supportive community that recognizes and brings awareness to gender imbalances surrounding women with careers in technology, and to develop innovative approaches and solutions by connecting, empowering, and developing women together. Open to faculty, students, and staff. All individuals are welcomed.

name: Women's Basketball Club at UCI
description: The Women's Basketball Club at UCI is a welcoming space for all UCI students who share a passion for basketball. We are dedicated to fostering an environment where members can learn, improve, and enjoy the game together. We strive for the best in both sports and academics, encouraging members to exceed in both aspects. Through the Women's Basketball Club at UCI, we endeavor to create an environment where growth, passion, and unity flourish. Our commitment to basketball and each other is reflected in our shared journey of self-discovery and athletic achievements.

name: Women's Gaming Club at UCI
description: The Women’s Gaming Club is a community dedicated to supporting female gamers and game developers, encouraging them to share their unique experiences in gaming and their expertise in game development. The club was founded with the mission of challenging stereotypes and biases against women in gaming communities, as well as addressing the underrepresentation of female developers in the gaming industry. We aim to create a welcoming and inclusive environment where women can express themselves freely and contribute to the world of games.Women’s Gaming Club regularly organizes activities like game creation events (e.g., Game Jams), providing opportunities for collaboration and growth. Additionally, we plan to invite accomplished female professionals from renowned gaming companies to UCI for guest lectures, where they can share their insights and career experiences.We warmly welcome individuals of all genders, nationalities, and cultural backgrounds to join us, share their thoughts and ideas about gaming, and contribute to fostering diversity in the gaming industry!

name: Women's Lacrosse Club at UCI
description: The Women's Lacrosse Club at UCI team is a competitive club sports team governed under the US Lacrosse Women's Collegiate Lacrosse Associates (WCLA) and the Western Women's Lacrosse League (WWLL). The team competes against other universities in California, Nevada, and Arizona and welcomes players of all skill levels, from beginner to advanced. Our mission is to bring women together to share social and athletic experiences while balancing academics as well.

name: Women's Law Society at UCI Law School (WLS)
description: The mission of the Women's Law Society (WLS) is two-fold: to promote the academic, personal and professional development of women law students, and to encourage thoughtful discussion of issues related to gender, law and society. WLS furthers these goals by hosting a speaker series; providing mentoring and academic and career development workshops; and connecting students with other organizations in the community focusing on women's issues. WLS is open to all law students.

name: Women's Rowing Club at UCI
description: The Women’s Rowing Club at UCI is a highly competitive program built on teamwork, focus, and determination. Our dedicated and passionate athletes compete against collegiate teams nationwide, while our novice squad welcomes those with no prior rowing experience. Immersed in this ambitious and supportive environment, our student-athletes develop not only as competitors, but as distinguished individuals prepared to excel both on and off the water.

name: Women's Rugby Club at UCI
description: The object and purpose of the Club is to promote knowledge and understanding of the sport of rugby within the UC Irvine community and to create a fair and safe playing environment within the rules and regulations of the game.

name: Women's Soccer Club
description: Women's Soccer Club is an intercollegiate team in a competitive league (USCCS & NIRSA soccer) that plays against teams all across California, Arizona and Oregon. This club allows girls who have an interest in soccer to compete in a challenging environment, while making strong bonds with teammates.

name: Women's Ultimate Club (formerly Women's Ultimate Frisbee Club at UCI)
description: Women's Ultimate is a competitive frisbee team that travels to different colleges to compete in tournaments. We welcome players of all levels who are interested in learning the sport, even if throwing a disc is unnatural for you! Our club is about the love of the game and having fun! Expect a great outdoor workout while meeting new people and learning a new sport.

name: Women's Volleyball Club
description: We provide a competitive environment for women who wish to play volleyball in college without the time demands of a collegiate varsity (NCAA) team.  We encourage the improvement of every player while providing a positive experience for coaches and players to push each other and have fun.

name: Women's Water Polo Club at UCI
description: What: A competitive women's water polo club working to enhance the experience of its members in a team directed environment.  For: Girls with or without previous experience in the sport of water polo and wish to enhance and continue their experience in a fun and competitive atmosphere.

name: Womxn's Center for Success
description: The Womxn's Center for Success at UC Irvine advances gender equity by raising consciousness on social justice concepts, fostering personal growth, building community connections, encouraging identity development and increasing access to resources that support holistic wellness.

name: Wushu Club at UCI
description: At UCI, the Wushu club aims to foster a competitive, yet inviting environment for Wushu athletes of all skill levels. Wushu, as practiced at UCI, is a non-contact Chinese martial art, emphasizing on coordination and performance. Wushu represents a collection of all Chinese martial arts, but often, the term is used to refer to the more-modern styles of its traditional counterpart, Kung Fu. For more information stop by to try out the sport first hand (no club fees for the first practice!).

name: XI ISLE Chinese Drama Club at UCI
description: To create a space for Chinese-language performance, cross-cultural storytelling, and collaborative theatrical production. We hope to stage original or adapted works, organize workshops, and build a community for students interested in exploring identity and culture through performance. And we have completed a comedy production on a stage at UCI that drew an audience of over a thousand people.

name: Ye Olde Theatre Eaters
description: To make Shakespeare and classical theatre accessible, understandable, and enjoyable to everyone.

name: Yugioh Club at UCI
description: We are an organization that allows for people to meet, play, and discuss the Yugioh trading card game. We are open to all players, from casual to competitive, and aim to foster a welcoming environment where we can have fun and enjoy the game as a community.

name: Zamana at UCI
description: Zamana at UCI is an award-winning Bollywood Fusion dance team that participates in circuit competitions across the nation. Along with a foundation in Bollywood, the team incorporates a variety of different styles, including hip hop, bhangra, jazz, kuthu, contemporary, and classical. Founded in 2009, Zamana has performed at prestigious events across the country, and has been invited to audition for America's Got Talent. Check us out on Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, or YouTube for more information!

name: ZotBins
description: ZotBins is an innovative smart waste bin system designed to optimize waste management efficiency and promote sustainable practices. By collecting and analyzing data on waste diversion rates—specifically, the proportion of incorrectly placed trash items relative to the total waste volume (e.g. glass bottle in the trash bin instead of recycle bin)—we aim to enhance campus-wide waste management practices.

name: Zotbotics (formerly ZOTBotics' Introductory Training (ZIT) at UCI)
description: The purpose of Zotbotics is to provide a community where students interested in the field of robotics can work on fully functional robots and apply their skills in mechanical engineering, electronics, and computer science.

name: Zotckets
description: Zotckets is a student-led organization dedicated to encouraging students to explore engineering through hands-on experience in rocketry. Our goal is to help students design, manufacture, and launch their own L1 rockets, enabling them to receive certification. Through club-facilitated workshops and events, we aim to create a community where students can engage in a meaningful project alongside their peers, enhance their resumes, and pursue their professional or personal goals. Anyone is welcome to join the club, regardless of experience or major, as we aim to create a community that caters to students from diverse backgrounds. In the long term, we plan to expand our organization into an interdisciplinary club that fosters innovation in rocketry across various STEM fields.

name: Zotcon at UCI-Anime Convention Club
description: ZotCon's top priority is to create a safe space for anyone who enjoys Japanese mainstream culture. Our mission is to let anyone and everyone who are interested, ranging from students just dipping their toes into Japanese culture to those who have dedicated their lives researching and experiencing it, come together and express themselves and their love for the culture in any way or form.

name: ZotFunder
description: Join UCI students, faculty and programs as we power ideas and passion projects that make a difference. Fund your project of choice today to make it a reality.

name: ZotLabs
description: ZotLabs is a student-run organization that aims to develop industry-level products and services for the use of students and faculty. Building not only the software, but the infrastructure behind our services-offering students the opportunity to gain experience in IT, programming, and machine learning.
